If I'd known you couldn't take a joke, I'd have been a damned fool to bother you.” “Hmph!” A’qi threw the scissors onto the table and commanded with a stern face, “Go and open the door. I'm leaving.”

黄仪一言不发，乖乖地去开了门，放阿七走路。这一下陈世龙却受罪了，使尽吃奶的力气，才能把笑声憋住，直到黄仪走得远了，他才掩着嘴，溜了出来，急急忙忙弄到后面的废园中，捧着肚子，纵声大笑。如果照以前的脾气，陈世龙一定会把黄仪的这个笑话，散布出去，自从跟了胡雪岩，学到了许多人情世故，了解这必成黄仪深讳之事，不但不能讲出去，最好连黄仪面前，都要装作不知其事。不然便要遭忌，俗语说的“是非只为多开口”，正指此而言。然而难题仍未解决，阿七仍旧会来，看她号为“水晶”，表里通明，好象胸无城府，想不到撒泼放刁，也绝得很，那条“烟熏鼠穴”之计，十分厉害，不能听其自然。这样就还是只好跟黄仪去商量。他特别谨慎，怕自己脸上的神色有异，也怕黄仪的心情还未能平贴，当时便不去找他，一个人出后门寻朋友一起吃晚饭，回列丝行，才踱到黄仪那里“打听消息”。

Without a word, Huang obediently opened the door and let her go. Now Chen suffered: it took every ounce of strength to suppress his laughter. Only after Huang had gone well away did he slip out, covering his mouth, and hurry to the neglected garden behind the building. There he clutched his stomach and laughed aloud. In the old days, he would certainly have spread this story at Huang's expense. But he had learned much about human relations from Hu and understood that Huang would desperately want to conceal it. Not only must he keep it to himself; he should preferably pretend ignorance even before Huang. Otherwise he would earn his resentment. This was precisely what the saying meant: trouble comes from talking too much. Yet his problem remained. A’qi would still come. With a nickname like Crystal, she seemed transparent through and through, as though she had no hidden designs. Yet she had proved remarkably skilful at troublesome tricks. Her plan to smoke him out of his hole was formidable and could not be ignored. He must consult Huang again. Taking particular care that his face betrayed nothing, and allowing time for Huang's feelings to settle, he did not seek him immediately. He left by the back door, found a friend to dine with, and only after returning to the firm strolled over to inquire about the news.

“怎么样？”他装得若无其事地，“你是怎么把她弄走的？”“我告诉她，你跟阿珠的亲事，是我做的媒，我有责任。劝她以后不要来找你的麻烦。”“她怎么说？”“这个女人，坏得很！”黄仪恨恨地说，“她说有什么私房钱，托你替她放息。又说，要抽回本钱，最好跟你见个面。总而言之，言而总之一句话：贱货！没有男人不过门。”听他此刻的话，想起他当时咆哮如虎，而结果如丧家之狗的神情，前后映照，使得陈世龙的肚肠根痒不可当，差点又笑出声来。“事情真麻烦了！”黄仪又说，语气倒是平静了，见得他已好好想过，“现在已经不是躲的事。”“怎么呢？”“她到大经来寻你，有我在，总可以把她挡回去。就怕她不来，到处去放谣言，说你欠了她的钱，避不见面，逼得你非出面跟她理论不可。”黄仪抬眼望道，“你想这个女人坏不坏？”照阿七的为人，还不至于这么坏！不过她如缠住不放，而自己又始终避不见面，怨恨交加，象她这样的女人就很难说了！因此，陈世龙吸着气，搓着手，显得颇为不安。“好好一头亲事，不要坏在她手里！她现在逼得你没路走，世龙！你要早点想办法。”

“Well?” he asked as though nothing had happened. “How did you get her to leave?” “I told her I'd arranged your match with A’zhu and had a responsibility. I advised her not to trouble you again.” “What did she say?” “A thoroughly bad woman!” Huang said bitterly. “She claimed she'd entrusted savings to you to lend at interest. She wanted her principal back and thought it best to see you. In short, to put it briefly—she's a cheap creature who can't live without a man!” Listening, Chen recalled how Huang had roared like a tiger and ended like a beaten stray. The contrast with his present words made laughter rise irresistibly in his belly. He almost let it escape. “It's become a real problem,” Huang continued more calmly, showing that he had considered it. “Hiding won't be enough now.” “Why?” “If she comes here, I can keep her away. The danger is that she stops coming and spreads rumours everywhere: you owe her money and refuse to see her. Then you'll have to appear and argue with her.” Huang looked up. “Isn't she a bad woman?” Chen did not think her character quite so bad. But if she persisted and he continually avoided her, resentment might build. Then, with a woman like her, who could say? He drew a breath and rubbed his hands uneasily. “Don't let her ruin a good marriage,” Huang warned. “She's leaving you nowhere to turn. You must find a solution soon.”

“是啊！我现在不就是在向黄先生讨教？”黄仪点点头，一双眼睛突然变得深沉，沉思了好一会，才慢吞吞地开口：“办法是有一个。‘量小非君子，无毒不丈夫’，要想一劳永逸，唯有这条路好走。”看样子是极狠的一着，陈世龙催他：“黄先生，你说，是怎么一条路？”“听说你跟县衙门的刑名师爷很熟？”“熟也不太熟。不过打着胡先生的旗号去，可以说得上话。”“这就行了！”黄仪很轻松地，“阿七不是本地人，原籍高邮。你去托刑名师爷弄张牌票出来，转她个‘流娼’的罪名，递解回籍，滚她拉块妈妈咸鸭蛋！”

“Yes. Isn't that why I'm asking your advice?” Huang nodded. His eyes suddenly grew intent, and he considered for some time before speaking slowly. “There is one way. ‘A small-minded man is no gentleman; a man without ruthlessness is no man.’ If you want to settle it once and for all, this is the only road.” It sounded like an exceptionally cruel measure. Chen urged him to explain. “What road, Mr Huang?” “I hear you know the county yamen's legal adviser well?” “Not very well. But with Mr Hu's name behind me, I can obtain a hearing.” “Then it's simple!” Huang sounded quite relaxed. “A’qi isn't a local. Her native place is Gaoyou. Ask the legal adviser to get a warrant issued, have her charged as an itinerant prostitute, and send her under escort back to her home district. Pack her off, damn her!”

想不到是如此一计，实在太狠毒了一些，陈世龙心里暗暗吃惊，原来黄仪是这么一个人！以后共事，倒要好好防他。“怎么样？”黄仪催问：“我是为你设想，非如此不足以放心！”“是，是！我知道黄先生完全是为我。不过，”陈世龙亦颇多急智，把这重公案扯到了郁四身上，“其中碍着郁四叔，旁人不知道是我们出的花样，只当郁四叔放不过这样一个人，传到江湖上，郁四叔的声名不好听。”“那不要紧。”黄仪拍着胸说，“郁四叔问起来，我替你一力承当。”就表面看，黄仪这样够朋友，再不领情受教，就变成半吊子了。陈世龙十分机警，用欣然的语气答道：“黄先生这样子帮我的忙，还有什么说？我明天就去办。”这当然是敷衍，陈世龙决不会照他的话去做的。一个人静下来想想，原意托黄仪帮忙，谁知越帮越忙，反倒额外添了些麻烦。所以心中甚为不快，早早上床睡了。

Chen had never expected such a plan. It was far too vicious, and he was inwardly shocked. So this was the sort of man Huang was! He would have to be careful in their future dealings. “Well?” Huang pressed. “I'm thinking of you. Nothing less will make you safe.” “Yes, yes. I know you're doing it entirely for me. But...” Chen was quick-witted too and shifted the difficulty onto Yu. “There's Uncle Four to consider. People won't know we're responsible. They'll think he can't let this woman go. If that spreads through our circles, his reputation will suffer.” “Don't worry.” Huang struck his chest. “If Uncle Four asks, I'll take full responsibility.” On the surface, Huang was proving such a good friend that refusing his advice would make Chen seem foolishly ungrateful. Chen was shrewd enough to answer with apparent pleasure. “With you helping me like this, what more could I ask? I'll attend to it tomorrow.” This was merely to put him off. Chen had no intention of following the advice. Reflecting alone, he felt that he had asked Huang for help only to gain more trouble, with additional complications he had never needed. Thoroughly unhappy, he went to bed early.

第十七章｜CHAPTER SEVENTEEN

刚睡下不久，小徒弟来敲门，送来一封夜班航船刚刚带到的信，信是胡雪岩寄来的，拆开一看，寥寥数语，只说得知郁四有伤子之痛，深为惦念，特地抽空，专程到湖州来一趟，慰唁郁四，发信以后，即日下船。这一下，陈世龙的愁怀尽夫，有胡雪岩到，凡事都不碍了。一觉好睡，第二天一早，悄悄到码头上去等，等到十点多钟，将胡雪岩等到了。泊舟下碇，搭好跳板，陈世龙先到船上，笑嘻嘻叫过一声：“胡先生：”接着又说，“没有想到胡先生会来，真是太好了。”听他这样说法，便知自己这一趟适逢其分，有什么事要自己来料理，胡雪岩便点点头说，“我是包了一只船夹的，只有三天的工夫。来，你坐下来，我们先细谈一谈。”

Chen had not been in bed long when a young apprentice knocked and brought him a letter just delivered by the night passenger boat. It was from Hu Xueyan. In a few brief lines, Hu said that he had heard of Yu Si's bereavement and was deeply concerned. He had made time for a special journey to Huzhou to offer his condolences and would take a boat the very day he sent the letter. All Chen's worries vanished. With Hu coming, nothing need trouble him any longer. He slept soundly, then slipped down to the wharf early the next morning to wait. It was after ten when Hu arrived. Once the boat had anchored and the gangplank was in place, Chen went aboard. “Mr Hu!” he called with a smile. “I never expected you to come. This is wonderful.” His manner told Hu that he had arrived at just the right moment: something needed his attention. He nodded. “I've hired a boat for the journey, and I have only three days. Come, sit down. Let's go through everything first.”

这一谈便长了，由郁四丧子谈到他的家务，由阿七谈到自己的麻烦，由自己又谈到黄仪。自然，也谈到郁四尽释前嫌，替自己出面办喜事，如何会亲送聘金，以及阿珠的娘要替女儿办嫁妆，婚期得延到明年。结语是：“我一切都要请胡先生来作主。”“想不到我一走，出了这么多花样！”胡雪岩紧皱着眉，想了好半天才开口：“你的喜事，怎么样都可以，慢慢再说。你郁四叔搞成这样子，倒有些伤脑筋了。他的大小姐我没有见过，你看她为人如何？天性厚不厚？”“阿兰姐的精明强干，早就有名的。天性呢，”陈世龙出语很谨慎，“自然不会太薄，郁四叔只有这么一个女儿。”“现在是唯一的亲骨肉了！我想，她不会不孝顺，也不敢不孝顺。”最后一句话，骤然难以索解，细想一想，才察出这句话中的分量，如果阿兰姐敢于不孝顺老父，胡雪岩以父执的资格，一定会出来说话。至少限度，他会劝郁四，一个沙壳子都不要给阿兰姐，“嫁出的女儿泼出的水”，阿兰姐在娘家硬争是争不到财产的。

The conversation proved a long one. From Yu's loss of his son, Chen passed to his household troubles; from A’qi to his own difficulties; and from himself to Huang Yi. Naturally, he also told Hu how Yu had put aside all past grievances and undertaken to arrange Chen's wedding, how Yu had formally met the bride's family and delivered the betrothal money, and how A’zhu's mother wished to prepare her daughter's dowry, which meant postponing the wedding until the following year. He concluded, “I must ask you to decide everything for me.” “Who would have thought so many complications could arise the moment I left?” Hu frowned deeply and considered for some time before speaking. “Your wedding can be arranged one way or another. We can discuss that later. Your Fourth Uncle Yu's situation is more troublesome. I've never met his daughter. What do you think of her? Is she naturally kind?” “Sister A’lan has long been known for her intelligence and ability. As for her nature...” Chen chose his words carefully. “Surely she can't be too unkind. She's his only daughter.” “And now his only surviving child. I don't think she would fail in her duty to him—or dare to.” The last words were not immediately clear. On reflection, Chen understood their weight. If A’lan dared to mistreat her elderly father, Hu would certainly intervene as her father's friend. At the very least, he would advise Yu not to give her a single copper. “A married daughter is water poured away”: however fiercely she fought at her parents' home, that would not secure her the property.

“胡先生，”陈世龙忽有灵感，“你何不帮郁四叔把家务料理一下子？”胡雪岩沉吟不语，显然是觉得陈世龙的提议，不无考虑的余地。照他的性情，以及与郁四的交情来说，不能不管这桩闲事，只是不管则已，一管就要弄得漂漂亮亮，三天的工夫来不及，就算再加一两天，未见得能料理清楚，而上海、杭州的事却要耽误，变成“驼子跌跟斗，两头落空”，不智之至。“还有，”陈世龙又说，带些愁眉苦脸地，“阿七是个麻烦！从前我不伯她，随她怎么好了！现在我不能跟她一起在烂泥塘里滚。胡先生，你看我该怎么办？”这就是“混市面”的人的苦衷！人之好善，谁不如我？略有身价，总想力争上游，成为衣冠中人，但虽出淤泥，要想不染却甚难，因为过去的关系，拉拉扯扯，自己爱惜羽毛不肯在烂泥塘里一起打滚，无奈别人死拉住不放，结果依旧同流合污。胡雪岩对这一点十分清楚，当然要替陈世龙想办法。郁四的家务是个难题，陈世龙的麻烦又是一个难题，两个难题加在一起，反激出胡雪岩的灵感，站起身来说：“走！我们上岸。”

“Mr Hu,” Chen said, struck by an idea, “why not help Fourth Uncle put his household affairs in order?” Hu considered in silence. Clearly, the proposal deserved thought. Given his own temperament and his friendship with Yu, he could hardly stand aside. Yet once he intervened, he must see the whole affair properly settled. Three days would not be enough; even another day or two might not suffice. Meanwhile, business in Shanghai and Hangzhou would suffer. Like a hunchback taking a tumble, with both ends left in the air, he would fail on both fronts. That would be foolish indeed. “And there's A’qi,” Chen added with a troubled face. “She's a nuisance. I wasn't afraid of her before; she could do as she pleased. But now I can't go rolling in the mud with her. What am I to do?” Such was the predicament of men who had made their way on the streets. Who did not wish to better himself? Once a man had acquired a little standing, he wanted to rise and become respectable. Yet emerging from the mud without a stain was difficult. Old connections tugged at him. He might value his good name and refuse to roll in the mire, but others clung to him and would not let go; in the end he remained involved in the same disreputable ways. Hu understood this thoroughly and would naturally find a way to help Chen. Yu's household was one difficult problem, Chen's predicament another. Together, the two suddenly gave Hu an idea. He stood up. “Come. Let's go ashore.”

看他欣然有得的神情，陈世龙知道他又要出“奇计”了，便笑嘻嘻地问道：“胡先生，你一定又有啥人家想不到的主意，好不好先讲给我听听？”“没有啥不好讲的。”胡雪岩说，“我想叫阿七‘船并老码头’。”陈世龙一愣，再细想一想，不由得衷心钦服，郁四少不得阿七，是他早就深知的。现在硬生生的拆散，完全是阿兰姐夫妇在捣鬼。倘能破镜重圆，且不说阿七这方面，起码郁四的心情，就不会这么颓丧。当然，自己的麻烦，就此烟消云散，更不在话下。“胡先生！真正是，有时候我们看事情总不够透彻，自己不晓得什么道理？现在我懂了，差的就是那一层纸，一个指头可以戳破的，我们就是看不到！”“你不要恭维我。事情成不成，还不晓得。等我先去探探口气。”胡雪岩说，“先去看你郁四叔。”

Seeing the pleased look of discovery on Hu's face, Chen knew that another ingenious plan was forming. “Mr Hu,” he asked with a smile, “you must have thought of something nobody else would imagine. Could you tell me first?” “There's no reason not to. I mean to have A’qi moor her boat at the old landing.” Chen was startled. Then, thinking it through, he felt profound admiration. He had long known that Yu could not do without A’qi. Their enforced separation was entirely the work of A’lan and her husband. If the broken mirror could be made whole again, then, quite apart from A’qi's feelings, Yu would at least cease to be so dejected. Naturally, Chen's own troubles would vanish too. “Mr Hu, sometimes we fail to see things clearly and can't understand why. Now I know. There's only a sheet of paper between us and the answer, thin enough to pierce with a finger, yet we simply can't see it!” “Don't flatter me. We don't know yet whether it will work. Let me first find out how matters stand. We'll go and see your Fourth Uncle.”

于是陈世龙上岸，在码头上雇了两乘轿子，一直抬到郁四家。陈世龙先下轿，一直奔了进去，只见郁四一个人在喝闷酒，叫应一声，接下来说：“胡先生来了！”郁四顿有惊喜之色，“在哪里？”他站起身问。“从船上下来，就到这里，他是专程来看四叔的。”正说到这里，胡雪岩已经走进二门，郁四急忙迎了上去，执手相看，似乎都有千言万语，不知从何说起？好半天，胡雪岩才说了句：“四哥，你不要难过！”不说还好，一说正说到郁四伤心之处，眼泪簌簌地流个不住，顿足哭道：“做人真没有意思！”接着又哽哽咽咽，断断续续地说，不逢知己，连痛哭一场都不能够。自己有多少心事，无人可诉，这份苦楚，一时也说不尽。如今交代了胡雪岩，便要辞掉衙门里的差使，找个清静地方去吃素念佛，了此余生。“四哥，四哥！”胡雪岩连声叫唤，“不必如此，不必如此！”就这样解劝着，他半搀半携地把郁四扶到里面，接着阿兰姐出来拜见，虽是初见，久已闻名，她知道这是自己父亲的一个很够分量的朋友，所以礼数甚恭，好好敷衍了一阵，接着重治酒肴，留客便饭。

Chen went ashore and hired two sedan chairs at the wharf to carry them straight to Yu's house. Getting out first, he hurried inside and found Yu drinking alone in low spirits. He greeted him, then announced, “Mr Hu is here!” Delight and surprise instantly appeared on Yu's face. “Where?” he asked, rising. “He's come straight here from the boat. He made the journey especially to see you, Fourth Uncle.” As Chen spoke, Hu had already entered the inner gate. Yu hurried to meet him. They clasped hands and looked at one another, each seemingly with a thousand things to say and no idea where to begin. At last Hu said, “Brother Yu, don't grieve so.” Until then Yu had held himself together. Those words touched the heart of his sorrow, and tears streamed down his face. Stamping his foot, he cried, “There's no point in living!” Between broken sobs, he went on: without a true friend, he could not even have a proper cry. He had so much on his mind and nobody to tell; all his suffering could not be expressed at once. Now that Hu had come, he would explain everything to him, resign his post at the yamen, and find somewhere quiet to eat vegetarian food and recite the Buddha's name for the rest of his days. “Brother Yu, Brother Yu! There's no need for that!” Hu kept repeating. With these consoling words, he half supported and half led Yu indoors. A’lan came out to greet him. Although they had never met, she had long heard his name and knew that he was an influential friend of her father's. She was therefore scrupulously courteous, attending to him for a while before having fresh dishes and wine prepared and asking him to stay for a simple meal.

胡雪岩在席问只听郁四诉苦，很少说话，一则是要多听，二则此时也不便深谈。等郁四倾吐了心里的愁郁，精神显得振作了些，他才说道：“四哥，我有几句心腹话想说。”“噢！”郁四懂了他的意思，“到我钱庄里去坐。”到了聚成钱庄，郁四那间密室里没有第三者，两人靠在烟榻上，聚首密谈，胡雪岩的第一句话是，“四哥，阿七到底是怎么回事？”“唉！”郁四长叹一声，又息了好一会才说：“我不晓得从何说起？这件事……”他摇摇头，又叹口气。察言观色、这没有说完的一句话是：这件事我做错了。有此表示，见得胡雪岩的那句话一针见血！这就用不着再迂回试探了，“四哥，”他开门见山地说：“我替你把阿七弄回来！”一听这话，郁四仰直了头看着胡雪岩，仿佛弄不懂他的意思，当他在说笑话，当然不会是笑话！胡雪岩从不说这些笑话的，就算是笑话，他也相信胡雪岩有把笑话变成真事的手段。要考虑的只是自己这方面。

At the table, Hu listened to Yu's complaints and said little. He wanted to hear more, and this was not the place for a confidential discussion. Only after Yu had poured out his distress and begun to look somewhat revived did Hu say, “Brother Yu, there are a few things I'd like to say in confidence.” “Ah!” Yu understood. “Let's go and sit at my bank.” At Jucheng Bank, with nobody else in Yu's private room, they reclined together on the opium couch and spoke quietly. Hu's first question was, “Brother Yu, what exactly happened with A’qi?” Yu gave a long sigh, then paused for some time. “I don't know where to begin. This affair...” He shook his head and sighed again. From his expression and manner, Hu could complete the unfinished sentence: I was wrong. Clearly, his question had touched the sore spot. There was no need for further indirect probing. “Brother Yu,” he said plainly, “I'll get A’qi back for you.” Yu raised his head and stared, as though he could not understand and thought Hu must be joking. But of course he was not. Hu never joked about such things. Even if it were a joke, Yu believed he had the means to make it real. He needed only to consider his own position.

“难处也很多……”“不！”胡雪岩打断他的话说，“四哥，你不要管这些个。你说的难处，我都知道，第一，怕阿兰姐跟阿七不和，第二，怕阿七心里有气，故意拿跷。这些都不是难处，包在我身上，安排得妥妥帖帖，只看四哥你自己。如果你一定要唱一出《马前泼水》，那就不必再谈。否则，一切归我来办。你倒说一句看！““有你这样的好朋友，我还说什么？”“那就行了，我就要你这一句话，你请躺一躺，我跟世龙说句话，马上就回来。”于是胡雪岩离榻而起，把陈世龙找到，拉至僻处，密密嘱咐了一番，等陈世龙领计而去，他才回到原处。

“There would be a great many difficulties...” “No!” Hu interrupted. “You needn't concern yourself with those. I know the difficulties you mean. First, you're afraid A’lan and A’qi won't get on. Second, you're afraid A’qi is still angry and will deliberately make herself difficult to please. Neither is a problem. Leave them to me, and I'll arrange everything properly. It depends only on you. If you're determined to act out Water Spilled Before the Horse and refuse to take her back, there's nothing more to discuss. Otherwise, leave it all to me. Tell me what you think.” “With a friend like you, what more can I say?” “That's settled, then. Your word is all I need. Lie here and rest. I'll have a word with Shilong and come straight back.” Hu rose from the couch, found Chen, and drew him aside to give him detailed instructions in private. Only after Chen had left to carry them out did Hu return.

“四哥，”他说，“我话先说在前面，谈到你的家务，只怕我言语太直，你会不会动气？”“这叫什么话？你我的交情，哪怕你就责备我不是，我也要听你的。”“既然如此，我就老实说了，你那位令嫒，大家都说她厉害得很，可有这话？”“有的。”郁四点点头，“我也在防她。”“至亲骨肉，时时刻刻要防备，那就苦了。打开天窗说亮话，人为财死，鸟为食亡，为来为去，为两个钱。我劝你不如趁此机会分家。女儿也得一份，叫她不必再想东想西，岂不爽快吗？”“嗯，嗯！”郁四慢慢点头道：“这倒也是个办法。你再说，你总还有话。”“分家也有个分法。”胡雪岩说，“我先要问你，你自己总也有过打算？”

“Brother Yu, let me say this first. If I speak too bluntly about your family affairs, will you be offended?” “What a thing to ask! With our friendship, even if you reproached me outright, I should listen.” “Then I'll speak frankly. Everyone says that daughter of yours is extremely formidable. Is it true?” “Yes.” Yu nodded. “I'm on my guard against her myself.” “It's a miserable thing to have to guard against your own flesh and blood all the time. Let's speak openly. Men die for wealth as birds die for food. Whatever the twists and turns, it's all about money. I advise you to take this opportunity to divide the estate. Give your daughter a share too, so that she needn't keep scheming. Wouldn't that settle things neatly?” “Yes, yes.” Yu nodded slowly. “That is one way. Go on. You must have more to say.” “There are different ways to divide an estate. First I must ask whether you've made any plans yourself.”

“我哪里有什么打算？阿虎一死，我的心冰凉，恨不得出家做和尚！他们怎么说，怎么好，反正我都丢开了，随他们去搞。不过，”郁四顿了一顿，显得有些激动，“小和尚一来，听说了他的情形。我心里才高兴了些。今天，你路远迢迢抽出工夫来看我，想想这个世界上也还有些好东西。说句实话，到现在我才稍微有点做人的乐趣。”这才真的是肺腑之言，胡雪岩觉得很安慰，也越觉得要替他尽心，“四哥，”他说，“承蒙你看得起我，我倒不能不多事了，索性变得深些。府上的事，要通盘筹划，麻烦虽多，不能怕事，挺一挺胸，咬一咬牙，把它一起理清楚了，好不好？”“好啊！”郁四很兴奋的回答，他自己也盘算过家务，但越想越头痛，始终鼓不起勇气来清理这一团乱丝，现在听胡雪岩这样说法，先就如释重负，心里好过得多。“那么，一样样地谈。我先请问，你衙门里的差使，将来怎么样处置？”

“What plans could I have? When A’hu died, my heart turned to ice. I wished I could become a monk. Whatever they said was good enough for me. I'd abandoned everything; they could do as they pleased. But...” Yu paused, visibly moved. “When Little Monk came and I heard how he was getting on, I began to feel a little happier. And today you've made time to travel all this way to see me. It makes me think there are still some good things in this world. To tell you the truth, only now am I beginning to find a little pleasure in being alive.” These were words from the heart. Hu felt comforted and all the more determined to do his utmost. “Brother Yu, since you think so well of me, I can't avoid taking a hand. I might as well go further. We must plan for the whole household. However many difficulties there are, we mustn't shrink from them. Straighten your back, grit your teeth, and let's untangle everything at once. Shall we?” “Yes!” Yu answered eagerly. He too had tried to plan for his household, but the more he thought, the worse his head ached. He had never found the courage to sort out that tangled skein. Hu's words alone lifted a burden from him, and he already felt much better. “Then let's take things one at a time. First, what do you intend to do about your post at the yamen?”

户书是世袭的差使，因为手中有一本将全县田地业主、座落、亩数、赋额记载得明明白白的“鱼鳞册”，这就是世世代代吃着不穷的衣食饭碗。如果阿虎不死，自然归他承袭父职，现在膝下无子，即令将来有后，要把儿子教养成人，是二三十年后的事。渺焉无凭，作不得那佯不切实际的打算，所以郁四曾经一度想辞差，这是绝少有的事，通常总是有亲子则亲子承袭，否则就收个螟蛉子，甚至高价顶让，改姓承袭。此刻当然已不作辞差打算，但究竟应该如何处理？郁囚却一时不得主意。遇见胡雪岩，他就懒得去伤脑筋了，直截了当地摇摇头：“我不晓得。”“好，我再请问第二件。”胡雪岩说，“你那令媳，你又如何替她打算？”

The revenue clerk's post was hereditary. In his hands was a fish-scale register, recording every landowner in the county, the location and acreage of each holding, and the tax assessed on it. This provided an inexhaustible livelihood from generation to generation. Had A’hu lived, he would naturally have succeeded his father. Now Yu had no son. Even if he later had another, it would take twenty or thirty years to bring the child to manhood. Such a distant and uncertain prospect could not form the basis of a practical plan. That was why Yu had once considered resigning, an exceedingly rare step. Ordinarily, a natural son inherited the post; failing that, the clerk adopted a son. He might even transfer it for a high price, with the successor changing his surname before taking over. Yu no longer meant to resign, but what should he do instead? He could not decide. With Hu there, he could not be bothered to rack his brains. He simply shook his head. “I don't know.” “Very well. My second question concerns your daughter-in-law. What arrangements do you intend to make for her?”

“这件事我最为难！”郁四放下烟枪，矍然而起，“你想想，今年才十九岁，又没有儿子。怎么守法？”“她自己的意思呢？”“她当然要守。”“守节是越守越难。尽有守到四十出头出了毛病的！四哥，我说句老实话，我们又不是啥书香门第，不妨看开些，再说，为儿子挣座贞节牌坊，还有点意思，没有儿子，没有希望，守不守得住，且不去说它，就算守着了一座贞节牌坊，有啥味道？”“你说得透彻。我主意定了，还是劝她嫁的好，有合适的人，我把她当女儿嫁出去，好好陪嫁。不过，”郁四皱眉又说，“万一她一定要守，怎么办？”这当然只好成全她的志向，为她在族中选一个侄儿过继为子，然而将来又如何呢？有郁四在自然没有话说，倘或三年五载以后，郁四撒手归西，则孤儿寡妇，难保不受人欺凌。

“That is my greatest difficulty!” Yu put down his opium pipe and sat up abruptly. “Think of it: she's only nineteen, and she has no son. How can she remain a widow?” “What does she want herself?” “Naturally, she wants to remain faithful to her husband.” “The longer a widow keeps that vow, the harder it becomes. Plenty have held out until their forties and then faltered. Brother Yu, let me speak frankly. We aren't some great scholarly family. We can afford to take a broader view. Besides, earning a chastity arch for a son to be proud of has some point. With no son and nothing to look forward to, leave aside whether she could keep the vow: even if she won her arch, what pleasure would it give her?” “You put it clearly. I've made up my mind. We'd better persuade her to remarry. If there's a suitable man, I'll marry her off as my own daughter and give her a good dowry. But...” Yu frowned again. “What if she insists on remaining a widow?” Naturally, they could only respect her wishes and choose a nephew from the clan for her to adopt as a son. Yet what would happen afterwards? While Yu lived, there would be no difficulty. If he died in three or five years, however, the widow and her fatherless child might well be bullied.

这些难处，胡雪岩早就替他想到了，“凭四哥你在外头的面子，百年以后，不怕没有人照应府上。不过清官难断家务事，你们自己族里要出花样，外人就很难说话了。”胡雪岩先这样把症结点明，然后才替他划策。胡雪岩的想法，如果阿虎嫂愿意守节，应该有个在郁四身后可以朋料她的人，这个人就是未来的当家。郁四得找一个年轻、能干而最要紧的是忠厚的人，收为义子，改姓为郁，不必顶他的香烟，只是继承他的世袭差使。此人受恩所须报答于郁四的，就是将来照应阿虎嫂母子，以及阿七可能为郁四生下的小儿女。这是面面俱到的办法，郁四完全同意。难题是这个可以“托孤”的人，不容易找，在户房中，郁四虽有些得力的帮手，但不是年龄太长，早已生儿育女，不可能做人家的螟蛉，便是虽有本事，人品不佳，有郁四在，不敢出什么花样，郁四一死，必定难制，托以孤儿寡妇，会变成羊落虎口。“世上无难事，只怕有心人，好在这事也不急，你慢慢留心好了。”

Hu had already considered these difficulties for him. “With your standing outside the family, Brother Yu, there will be no shortage of people to look after your household when you're gone. But even an upright magistrate finds family disputes hard to judge. If your own clansmen cause trouble, outsiders can scarcely intervene.” Having identified the heart of the problem, he explained his plan. If A’hu's widow wished to remain unmarried, there must be someone to look after her after Yu's death: the future head of the household. Yu should find a young, capable man who was, above all, honest and kind, adopt him as a son, and have him take the surname Yu. He need not carry on Yu's ancestral line; his role would be to inherit the hereditary post. In return for this favour, he must undertake to care for A’hu's widow and her adopted son, as well as any young children A’qi might bear Yu. The plan covered everything, and Yu agreed entirely. The difficulty lay in finding someone to whom orphans could be entrusted. He had able assistants in the revenue office, but some were too old, already with families of their own, and could hardly become another man's adopted son. Others had ability but lacked character. While Yu lived, they would not dare misbehave; once he died, they would surely be uncontrollable. To entrust widows and orphans to them would be to put sheep into a tiger's jaws. “Nothing is impossible to a determined man. Fortunately, there's no hurry. Keep your eyes open and take your time.”

忽然，郁四很兴奋地欲有所言，但刚抬起身子，便又颓然倒下，摇摇头自语：“不行！不行！”胡雪岩倒有些困惑，想想自己的办法，没有什么行不通的，随即问道：“怎么说不行？”“我倒想到一个人。”郁四慢吞吞地说：“只怕你不肯。”这一说胡雪岩才明白就里，“大概你是看中了世龙？”他问。“不错。”郁四说，“他是你得力的人，你没法放手的。”“这倒是实话。不过你的事也要紧，果真世龙自己愿意，我也不便反对。”“那再谈吧！”郁四怕他为难，自己收篷，顾而言他，“你再说说看，我分家的事怎么样？”

Suddenly, Yu looked excited and seemed about to speak. He had scarcely raised himself, however, before sinking back dejectedly. “No, no,” he muttered, shaking his head. Hu was puzzled. He could see nothing impracticable in his plan. “Why do you say no?” “I've thought of someone,” Yu said slowly. “But I'm afraid you wouldn't agree.” Now Hu understood. “You mean Shilong?” “Exactly. He's a great help to you. You couldn't let him go.” “That's true. But your affairs matter too. If Shilong himself really wished it, I could hardly object.” “We can discuss that another time.” Afraid of putting Hu in a difficult position, Yu drew back and changed the subject. “Tell me more about dividing my estate.”

“女儿原是分不着的，不过家私是你所挣，你愿意怎么样用，谁也管不着你。我的意思，你先提出一笔来给女儿，也是你们做父女一场！”话说得很含蓄，意思是这一来可以绝了阿兰姐觊觎娘家之心，省去多少是非。郁四本来当局者迷，一直以为女儿是一番孝心，现在才有些明白，觉得此举是必要的，所以连连点头：“我分一百亩田，提两万现银给她。也要把话说明白，叫他们夫妇拿良心出来。”说到这样的活，胡雪岩不便接口，停了一下说：“此外你应该作三股派，阿虎嫂如果一定要守，自然该得一股，阿七将来会有儿女，也该得一股，另外一股留在你自己手里，慢慢再说，有这一股在手里，大家都会孝顺你，千万不要分光！还有一层，等分好了，一定要禀请官府立案，以绝后患。”

“A daughter would ordinarily receive no share. But you've earned the property yourself, and nobody can tell you what to do with it. I suggest setting aside a sum for her first, in recognition of the bond between father and daughter.” Hu put this delicately. He meant that it would end A’lan's designs on her parents' property and prevent a great deal of trouble. Too deeply involved to see clearly, Yu had always supposed that his daughter acted from filial devotion. Only now did he begin to understand. Seeing the necessity, he nodded repeatedly. “I'll give her a hundred mu of farmland and twenty thousand taels in ready silver. And I shall speak plainly: she and her husband must show some conscience.” Hu could not readily respond to such words. After a pause, he went on. “Divide the rest into three shares. If A’hu's widow insists on remaining unmarried, she naturally deserves one. A’qi will have children in future, so she should have another. Keep the third in your own hands and decide what to do with it later. While you have that share, everyone will treat you dutifully. Whatever you do, don't give it all away! One more thing: once the division is settled, you must ask the authorities to put it on record, to prevent trouble later.”

“这我懂！我都依你的话做。现在，”郁四很吃力地说，“只怕阿七心里还在怪我。““这是免不了的。”胡雪岩有意隐瞒阿七对陈世龙的那段情，而且还说了一句假话，“阿七其实还念着你的好处。你就算看在我的面上，委屈些！回头阿七要发牢骚，哪怕给你难看，四哥，你都要忍一忍。““她是那样子的脾气，我不跟她计较。”郁四说道：“照你的意思，等下我要眼她见面，在哪里？”“等世龙回来再说。此刻你先过足了瘾，回头好有精神应付阿七。”“应付”是句双关语，郁四会心一笑，听他的话，抽足了鸦片，静待好事成双。郁四也不知他葫芦里卖的什么药？心里悬念而好奇，但不能不沉着处之，微微一笑，抛开阿七，问起胡雪岩自己的事。

“I understand. I'll do everything you say. Now...” Yu spoke with difficulty. “I'm only afraid A’qi still blames me.” “That's unavoidable.” Hu deliberately concealed A’qi's attachment to Chen and even told a lie. “She still remembers your kindness, really. For my sake, put up with a little humiliation. If she complains later, or even makes you look foolish, Brother Yu, you must bear with her.” “That's her temper. I won't take it to heart. From what you say, I'm to see her shortly. Where?” “We'll discuss that when Shilong comes back. For now, satisfy your craving, so that you'll have the energy to deal with A’qi later.” “Deal with” carried a double meaning. Yu gave an understanding smile, smoked his fill of opium as advised, and waited for good things to come in pairs. He had no idea what Hu had up his sleeve. Anxious and curious though he was, he must remain composed. With a faint smile, he dropped the subject of A’qi and asked about Hu's own affairs.

这就有得好谈了。胡雪岩与尤五之间的秘密，特别是关于小刀会的内幕，他在陈世龙面前都是守口如瓶，而对郁四却无须隐瞒。并头低语，声音低到仅仅只有两个人听得见，郁四一面打着烟泡，一面侧耳静听，觉得惊心动魄，对胡雪岩更加另眼相看了。“想不到你有这一番经历！”听完了他说，“说得我都恨不能象你这样去闯闯码头。”见他受了鼓舞，胡雪岩正好趁机劝他，“四哥，这几年是一重劫运、惊天动地的日子，我不相信在劫难逃这句话，只觉得一个人要出头，就在这个当口。人生在世，吃饱穿暖，糊里糊涂过一生，到闭眼的那一刻，想想当初，说不定会懊悔到这世界上来一遭，这就没啥意思了！”“是啊。”郁四答道，“人死留名，豹死留皮，总要做件把别人做不到的事，生前死后，有人提起来，翘一翘大拇指，说一声‘某人有种’，这才是不辱没爷娘！”听这语气，胡雪岩想起从嵇鹤龄那里听来的一句成语，脱口说道：“老骥伏枥，志在千里‘，四哥，你果有此心，眼前倒有个机会，可以做一番事业。”

There was plenty to discuss. Hu had kept his dealings with You Laowu, particularly the inside story of the Small Swords Society, strictly secret even from Chen. With Yu, however, there was no need for concealment. They put their heads together and spoke so softly that only the two of them could hear. As Yu prepared the opium pellets, he listened intently. The account startled and thrilled him, and he regarded Hu with still greater respect. “I never imagined you'd been through all this!” he said when Hu finished. “It makes me wish I could go out and try my fortune in different places, as you have.” Seeing him encouraged, Hu seized the opportunity. “Brother Yu, these years are a time of great calamity, when the world is shaken to its foundations. I don't believe in saying that doom is inescapable. I think this is precisely the moment for a man to distinguish himself. If he spends his life fed and clothed, muddling through without a thought, he may look back as he closes his eyes and regret ever having come into the world. What would be the point of that?” “Exactly. A man leaves his name as a leopard leaves its skin. We must do one or two things others cannot do, so that, in life and after death, people will raise a thumb at the mention of our names and say, ‘That man had courage.’ Then we won't have disgraced our parents.” His tone reminded Hu of a saying he had heard from Ji Heling, and he repeated it at once. “‘An old steed in the stable still dreams of a thousand-mile journey.’ Brother Yu, if that's truly your ambition, there's an opportunity before you to accomplish something.”

“噢！你说。”“你们湖州办团练，听说赵景贤是个角色，你如果能够帮他办好了，保境安民，大家提起你来，都要翘大拇指了。”郁四不响，只是双眼眨得厉害，眨了半天，忽然抛下烟枪，坐起身来说：“你说得对！要人要钱，我尽我的力量。不过我不便自己凑上门去。倒不是要他来请教我，是怕人说我高攀，想挤到绅士堆里，自抬身价。”“这也不是这么说法。守土之责，人人有分！”胡雪岩略停一停说，“我来安排，叫王大老爷来跟赵景贤说，那样，四哥你面子上也过得去了。”“好！你去办，我只听你的招呼就是。”说着，他下了炕床，关照聚成的人备饭，兴致极好，迥不是以前那种垂头丧气的颓唐之态。

“Oh? Tell me.” “They're organising a militia here in Huzhou. I hear Zhao Jingxian is a capable man. If you help him make a success of it, protecting the district and keeping the people safe, everyone will speak of you with admiration.” Yu said nothing. He blinked rapidly for some time, then suddenly put down his opium pipe and sat up. “You're right! Men or money, I'll provide all I can. But I can't very well go offering myself. It isn't that I want him to come begging for my advice. I'm afraid people would say I was reaching above my station, trying to push my way among the gentry and raise my own standing.” “That's hardly the way to look at it. Everyone has a duty to defend the district.” Hu paused briefly. “I'll arrange it. I'll ask Prefect Wang to speak to Zhao Jingxian. That will preserve your dignity as well.” “Good! You arrange it. I'll wait for your word.” He got down from the couch and told the bank's staff to prepare a meal. His spirits were excellent: the former dejection and listlessness had completely disappeared.

刚刚拿起酒杯，陈世龙赶到，冲胡雪岩点了点头，坐下来一起吃饭。郁四知道他是安排好了，只不知道他是如何安排？跟阿七见了面，自己该说些什么？心里痒痒地却不便问，那酒就吃得似乎没啥味道。“少喝两杯！”胡雪岩说，“回头再吃。”郁四听这话，便喝干了酒，叫人拿饭来吃。吃完，一个人坐在旁边喝茶，静候胡雪岩行动。“我们走吧！”“慢点。”郁四到底不能缄默，“到哪里？”“到大经丝行。”胡雪岩说，“我请阿七来碰头，你躲在我后房听，说什么你都不必开口！等我一叫，你再出来。”“出来以后怎么样？”“那……”胡雪岩笑道：“你们两个人的事，我怎么知道？”这句皮里阳秋的谐语，表示接下来就是重圆破镜，复谐好事。郁四听了当然兴奋，急着要走。

They had just raised their wine cups when Chen arrived. He nodded to Hu and sat down to eat with them. Yu knew that the arrangements were complete, but not what they were. When he saw A’qi, what should he say? He was burning to know, yet could hardly ask. The wine seemed to have lost its flavour. “Don't drink too much,” Hu said. “There'll be more later.” At that, Yu drained his cup and asked for rice. When he had finished eating, he sat to one side with his tea, waiting for Hu to act. “Let's go.” “Wait.” Yu could no longer keep silent. “Where?” “To the Dajing Silk Firm. I've asked A’qi to meet me there. You can hide in the back room and listen. Whatever is said, don't speak. Come out only when I call.” “And what am I to do then?” “Well...” Hu laughed. “That's between the two of you. How should I know?” The teasing words concealed their meaning: the broken mirror would be made whole, and the couple reunited. Naturally, Yu was excited and eager to leave.

三个人一起出了聚成钱庄，却分两路，郁四跟胡雪岩到大经，陈世龙别有去处，他第一次受计所办的是“调虎离山”，赶到老张那里，报告胡雪岩已到湖州，说跟郁四有要紧话在大经商谈，不便让黄仪知道，嘱咐老张夫妇，借商谈陈世龙的亲事为名，把他邀到家，把杯谈心，务必绊着他的身子。这样做的用意，就因为阿七要到大经来，怕跟黄仪遇到，彼此不便。敲开阿七家的门，她是诧异多于一切，瞪着一双水汪汪的眼睛，只说了句：“是你！”“是我。”陈世尤平静地说，“无事不登三宝殿！”“有事？哼！”阿七冷笑：“你是卑鄙小人，良心叫狗吃掉了！”“怎么好端端骂人？”“为什么不骂你！”阿七一个指头，戳到他额上，使劲往后一揿，指甲切入肉里，立刻便是一个红印。“不要动手动脚！”陈世龙说，“胡先生从杭州来了，他叫我来请你过去，有话跟你谈。”“你还想来骗人，真正良心丧尽了。你自己躲我，还不要紧。你叫黄仪来打我的主意，拿我送礼，讨他的好！”阿七越说越气，大声骂道：“你替我滚！我不要看你。”

The three left Jucheng Bank together but went separate ways. Yu accompanied Hu to Dajing; Chen had another destination. His first assignment had been to “lure the tiger away from the mountain.” He had hurried to Old Zhang and reported that Hu was in Huzhou and had important matters to discuss with Yu at Dajing, matters Huang Yi ought not to know about. Old Zhang and his wife were to invite Huang to their home on the pretext of discussing Chen's marriage, drink and talk with him, and make sure they kept him there. The purpose was to prevent an awkward meeting between Huang and A’qi when she came to Dajing. Now Chen knocked at A’qi's door. Her chief feeling was astonishment. Staring at him with her limpid eyes, she said only, “You!” “Yes, me,” Chen replied calmly. “One doesn't visit the temple without a reason.” “A reason? Hmph!” She gave a cold laugh. “You're a despicable creature. The dogs have eaten your conscience!” “Why start abusing me out of the blue?” “Why shouldn't I?” She thrust a finger against his forehead and pushed hard, her nail digging into his skin and leaving a red mark. “Keep your hands to yourself! Mr Hu has come from Hangzhou. He sent me to ask you over. He wants to talk to you.” “Still trying to deceive me! You really have no conscience left. Avoiding me yourself is one thing. But you sent Huang Yi to make a play for me, handing me over as a present to win his favour!” Growing angrier as she spoke, she shouted, “Get out! I don't want to see you.”

这一说，陈世龙想起那天的光景，忍不住纵声大笑。“你还笑！有啥好笑？”“我笑他癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉。差点眼睛都被戳瞎。”“ 咦！”阿七秋波乱转，困惑地问：“难道他还好意思把这桩‘有面了’的事告诉你听？”“他怎么会告诉我？我在间壁楼梯下面张望，亲眼看到的。”陈世龙又说，“阿七，你想想，我怎么会捉弄你？我们是熟人，而况你又有私房钱叫我替你放息，我捉弄了你，不怕你跟我逼债？”听这一说，阿七有些发窘，破颜一笑，故意这样说道：“对！我就赖你欠我的钱，不听我的话，我就去替你‘卖朝报’！”“好了，好了！”陈世龙问：“你要不要换件衣服？如果不换，我们此刻就走。”“真的胡老板要见我？”阿七答非所问地：“ 他有啥话要跟我谈。”“我不晓得，不过，我告诉你，他现在鸿运当头，照顾到哪个，哪个就有好处。你听我的话，跟我走！”陈世龙把她打量了一番，虽是家常打扮，风韵自胜，使又说道：“这样也蛮漂亮，不要换衣服了。”阿七听他的话，嘱咐了她所用的那个爱打瞌盹的小大姐当心门户，跟着陈世龙出门，巷口雇一顶小轿，一直抬到大经丝行。

This reminded Chen of the scene that day, and he could not help laughing aloud. “You dare laugh? What's so funny?” “I'm laughing at a toad longing to eat swan's flesh. He very nearly had his eyes poked out.” “Oh!” Her eyes moved restlessly as she asked in puzzlement, “Did he really have the nerve to tell you about that glorious achievement?” “How could he tell me? I was watching from under the stairs next door. I saw it with my own eyes. Think about it, A’qi. Why would I play a trick on you? We're old acquaintances. Besides, you've entrusted your private savings to me to put out at interest. If I wronged you, wouldn't I be afraid of your pressing me for the money?” She looked a little embarrassed, then smiled. “Exactly! I'll make out that you owe me money. If you don't do as I say, I'll broadcast it all over town.” “Enough of that. Do you want to change your clothes? If not, let's go now.” “Mr Hu really wants to see me?” she asked instead of answering. “What does he want to say?” “I don't know. But I can tell you this: his luck is riding high. Anyone he looks after benefits. Take my advice and come.” He looked her over. Even in her everyday clothes, she had an unmistakable charm. “You look very pretty as you are. Don't bother changing.” She did as he said. After telling her sleepy young maid to keep an eye on the house, she went out with him. At the end of the lane they hired a small sedan chair, which carried her straight to Dajing.

“越来越年轻了！”胡雪岩迎着她，便先灌了句米汤，接着取出一个外国货的錾银粉镜，这是特地叫陈世龙向阿珠借来的，“没啥好东西。郁四嫂，千里鹅毛一点心，你将就着用。““多谢胡老板，不过，你的称呼，不敢当。”“不是这话。不管你跟郁四哥生什么闲气，我总当你郁四嫂！”“我哪里高攀得上他们郁家？胡老板，多承你抬举我，实在对不起，要叫你骂一声‘不识抬举’了！”听她的口风甚紧，胡雪岩不敢造次，一面请她落座，一面向陈世龙使个眼色，暗示他避开。“那么，我走了！”陈世龙说，“阿七，明朝会！”“慢点。”胡雪岩故意问一句：“你到哪里去？是不是阿珠在等你？”这还用思索？当然是实实在在地答应一个：“是！”“将来又是个怕老婆的家伙！”胡雪岩望着陈世龙的背影，轻轻说了句，偷眼看阿七的脸上，是爽然若失的神情，便知自己这番做作不错。要先把陈世龙的影子从她心里抹干净，再来为郁四拉拢，事情就容易了。

“You grow younger every day!” Hu greeted her with a dose of flattery, then produced a foreign-made dressing mirror in chased silver, which he had specially asked Chen to borrow from A’zhu. “It's nothing very fine, Sister-in-Law Yu. A goose feather sent a thousand miles is a token of affection. I hope you'll find it useful.” “Thank you, Mr Hu. But I can't accept that form of address.” “Don't say that. Whatever quarrel you may have with Brother Yu, I shall always regard you as Sister-in-Law Yu.” “How could I aspire to a place in the Yu family? You do me a great honour, Mr Hu, and I'm very sorry, but you'll have to call me ungrateful for refusing it.” Finding her so guarded, Hu dared not rush matters. He invited her to sit and gave Chen a glance, signalling him to withdraw. “I'll be off, then,” Chen said. “See you tomorrow, A’qi.” “Wait.” Hu deliberately asked, “Where are you going? Is A’zhu waiting for you?” There was no need to think about the answer. Chen gave a firm, straightforward “Yes.” “Another man who'll be afraid of his wife!” Hu murmured as he watched Chen leave. A sidelong glance showed a look of emptiness and loss on A’qi's face. His little performance had worked. Once he had erased Chen's image from her heart, bringing her back to Yu would be easier.

“胡老板！”阿七定定神问道，“不晓得你有啥话要跟我说？请吩咐！”“吩咐二字不敢当。郁四嫂！说句实话，我这趟是专程来看郁四哥的，这么一把年纪，没有了一个独养儿子，你想想可怜不可怜？”阿七在恨郁四，想答一句“可怜不足惜”！话到口边，觉得刻薄，便忍住了点一点头。“阿虎我没有见过，他为人怎么样？”“郁家这位大少爷，凭良心说，总算是难得的好人。”阿七答道，“不比他那个姐姐，眼睛长在额头上。”“是啊，我听说你跟郁家大小姐不和，有没有这话？”“这话，胡老板你说对了一半，是她跟我不和！”阿七愤愤地说，“她老子听了宝贝女儿的话，要跟我分手。分就分，我也不在乎他！”“唉！郁四哥糊涂到了极点！”胡雪岩摆出为她大不平的神态，责备郁四，“你跟了他，算是委屈的，他怎么得福不知？我先当是你要跟他分手，原来是他自己糊涂，这我非好好说他几句不可！”“哪里是我要跟他分开？”阿七上当了，极力辩白，“我从来都没有起过这样的心思。都是他自己，一心还想弄两个年轻的，人老心不老，不晓得在交什么墓库运！”“好！”胡雪岩翘着大拇指说， “郁四嫂，我倒真还看不出，你一片真心，都在郁四哥身上。”“哼，有啥用？”阿七黯然摇头，“好人做不得！叫人寒心。”

“Mr Hu!” Composing herself, A’qi asked, “What did you wish to say to me? Please give me your instructions.” “I wouldn't presume to give instructions. Sister-in-Law Yu, the truth is that I came especially to see Brother Yu. At his age, to lose his only son—isn't it pitiful?” Resenting Yu, she wanted to answer that he deserved no pity. The words reached her lips, but she thought them too harsh and restrained herself, merely nodding. “I never met A’hu. What was he like?” “In all fairness, that young master of the Yu family was an exceptionally good man. Quite unlike his sister, who has her eyes on top of her forehead.” “Yes, I've heard you and the young lady don't get on. Is that true?” “You're only half right, Mr Hu. She's the one who doesn't get on with me!” A’qi said angrily. “Her father listened to his precious daughter and wanted to separate from me. Very well, then! I don't care about him either.” “Brother Yu has been a complete fool!” Hu took her side with an air of indignation. “You lowered yourself by going with him. How could he fail to appreciate his good fortune? I thought you had wanted to leave him. So he was the foolish one! I must give him a good talking-to.” A’qi fell into the trap and defended herself vigorously. “When did I ever want to leave him? The thought never entered my head. It was all his own doing. He still has his heart set on getting a couple of young ones. Old in years but young at heart—I don't know what ill-fated spell he's under!” “Excellent!” Hu raised his thumb. “Sister-in-Law Yu, I never realised how completely your heart belonged to him.” “Hmph! What good does that do?” She shook her head despondently. “There's no reward for being good. It makes one's heart turn cold.”

“那也不必。人，总要往宽处去想……”“是啊！”阿七抢着说道，“我就是这样想。心思不要太窄，难道‘死了杀猪屠，只吃带毛猪’？我说句不怕难为情的话，离了郁家，还怕找不着男人？到后来倒看看，究竟是他吃亏，还是我吃亏？”这番挟枪带棒、不成章法的话，看似豁达，其实是摆脱不掉郁四的影子，胡雪岩觉得自己的成绩不错，把她真正的心意探清楚，便已有了一半的把握了。于是他借话搭话地说：“自然是郁四哥吃亏。拿眼前来说，孤苦伶仃，一夜到天亮，睁着眼睛想儿子，那是什么味道？”地不响，息了一会才说了句：“自作自受！”“他是自作自受。不过，你也一样吃亏！”“这……”阿七大摇其头，“我没有啥吃亏。”

“There's no need for that. One must take a broader view...” “Exactly!” she interrupted. “That's what I think. There's no need to be narrow-minded. If the butcher dies, must we eat pigs with their bristles on? I'm not ashamed to say it: if I leave the Yu family, do you think I can't find another man? We'll see in the end which of us loses by it!” These disjointed words, full of jabs and thrusts, seemed broad-minded but really showed that she could not shake off Yu's hold on her. Hu felt he was doing well. Once he had discovered her true feelings, he was halfway to success. Taking up her words, he said, “Naturally, Brother Yu loses. Look at him now: lonely and miserable, lying awake all night thinking of his son. What sort of life is that?” She said nothing. After a pause, she observed, “He's brought it on himself.” “He has. But you've lost by it too.” “Well...” She shook her head emphatically. “I haven't lost anything.”

“你怎么不吃亏？”胡雪岩问道，“你今年二十几？”“我……”阿七迟疑了一下，老实答道，“二十七。”“女人象朵花，二十三四岁，就是花到盛时，一上了你现在这年纪，老得就快了。”胡雪岩说，“你想想看，你顶好的那几年，给了郁四哥，结果到头一场空，岂不是吃了亏了？”听他这一说，阿七发愣。这番道理，自己从没有想过，现在让他一点破，越想越有理，也越想越委屈，不由得就叹了口气。到此地步，胡雪岩不响了，好整以暇地取了个绿皮红心的“抢柿”慢慢削着皮，静等阿七发作。“胡老板，我想想实在冤枉！人不是生来就下贱的，说实话，跟郁老头的时候，我真是有心从良。哪晓得你要做好人，人家偏偏不许你做！”说到这里，阿七一生委屈，似乎都集中在一起爆发开来，显得异常激动，“就是胡老板你说的，我一生顶好的几岁给了他，他听了女儿的话，硬逼我分手，他这样子没良心，那就不要怪我，我也要撕撕他的脸皮。”

“How can you say that? How old are you now—twenty-something?” “I...” She hesitated, then answered honestly. “Twenty-seven.” “A woman is like a flower. At twenty-three or twenty-four, she's in full bloom. Once she reaches your age, she begins to age quickly. Think of it: you gave your best years to Brother Yu and have ended up with nothing. Isn't that a loss?” A’qi stared. She had never considered the matter in this light. Now that he pointed it out, the more she thought, the more reasonable it seemed—and the more wronged she felt. She could not help sighing. At this point, Hu fell silent. Taking a green-skinned, red-fleshed persimmon, he leisurely peeled it and waited for her feelings to break out. “Mr Hu, when I think of it, I've been treated terribly unfairly. Nobody is born degraded. To tell the truth, when I went with old Yu, I really meant to leave my trade and live respectably. Who could have imagined that, when you want to become a decent person, others refuse to let you?” As she spoke, a lifetime's grievances seemed to burst out together, and she became intensely agitated. “Just as you said, I gave him the best years of my life. Then he listened to his daughter and forced me to leave. If he can be so heartless, he mustn't blame me. I'll strip the respectability off his face.”

“噢！”胡雪岩很沉着的问：“你怎么撕法呢？”“我啊，”阿七毅然决然地说了出来，“我做我的‘老行当’，我还要顶他的姓，门口挂块姓郁的牌子，叫人家好寻得着。”这倒也厉害！果然如此，郁四的台就坍了。“阿七，”胡雪岩说，“人总不要走到绝路上去……”“是他逼得我这样子的。”阿七抢着分辩。“你这个念头是刚刚起的。是不是！”“是的。”阿七已完全在胡雪岩摆布之下，有什么，说什么：“多亏你胡老板提醒我，想想真是一口冤气不出。”“那就变成是我挑拨是非了。阿七，你要替你想想。”“对不起！”阿七满脸歉疚，“ 这件事我不能不这么做。请你胡老板体谅我！”“你无非想出口气。我另外替你想出气的办法，好不好？”阿七想了想答道：“那么，胡老板你先说说看！”她紧接着又声明，“这不是我主意已经改过，说不说在你，答应不答应在我。”

“Oh?” Hu asked calmly. “How will you do that?” “I'll...” She spoke with complete determination. “I'll go back to my old trade, and I'll still use his surname. I'll hang a sign with the name Yu at the door so that people can find me easily.” That was a formidable threat. If she carried it out, Yu's reputation would collapse. “A’qi, one mustn't drive things to a point of no return...” “He's forced me to it,” she interrupted. “You've only just thought of this, haven't you?” “Yes.” She was now completely under Hu's influence and said whatever came into her mind. “Thanks to your reminding me, Mr Hu, I can see what an intolerable wrong I've suffered.” “Then I've become the one stirring up trouble. A’qi, spare a thought for me.” “I'm sorry!” Her face was full of contrition. “But I have to do it. Please understand.” “All you want is to vent your anger. What if I find another way for you?” She thought, then answered, “Tell me what you have in mind.” She immediately added, “That doesn't mean I've changed my mind. Whether you speak is up to you; whether I agree is up to me.”

“当然。”胡雪岩说，“不要说你那口冤气不出，就是我旁边看着的人，心里也不服气。无论如何要叫你有面子，争一口气，有面子就是争气，这话对不对？”阿七并不觉得他的话对，但也不明白错在何处？只含含糊糊地答道：“你先说来看！”“我想叫郁四哥替你赔个罪。怎么样？”“赔罪？”阿七茫然地问道：“怎么赔法？”“你说要怎么赔？”胡雪岩说，“总不见得要‘吃讲茶’吧！”“吃讲茶”是江湖道上的规矩，有啥“难过”，当面“叫开”，象这种家务事，从没有吃讲茶的规矩。但此外阿七也想不出如何叫郁四赔罪，只睁大了一双黑多白少的眼睛，望青胡雪岩发怔。“阿七，什么赔罪不赔罪，都是假的，一个人的感情才是真的。只要郁四哥把真心给了你，也就差不多了！”阿七一方面觉得他这话不无道理，另一方面又觉得他这话或有深意。两个念头加在一起，得要好好想一想，所以双手按在膝上，低头垂眼，只见睫毛不住闪动，那副娴静的姿态，看起来着实动人。

“Of course. It's not only you who feels this wrong must be put right. Even as an outsider, I can't accept it. Whatever happens, you must regain your dignity and vindicate yourself. Regaining your dignity is a vindication, isn't it?” A’qi did not think his words quite right, but could not see what was wrong with them either. She answered vaguely, “Tell me your plan first.” “I mean to make Brother Yu apologise to you. How would that be?” “Apologise?” she asked blankly. “How?” “How would you like him to? Surely you don't want a formal settlement over tea?” Such a tea meeting was a custom among people of the streets and waterways: any grievance was openly stated and settled face to face. There was no precedent for using it in a domestic dispute like this. Yet A’qi could think of no other way to make Yu apologise. She merely stared at Hu, her wide eyes showing more black than white. “A’qi, apologies and all the rest are empty forms. A person's feelings are what count. If Brother Yu gives you his true heart, surely that should be enough.” On the one hand, she felt there was something in this; on the other, she suspected a deeper meaning. The two thoughts together required careful consideration. Resting her hands on her knees, she lowered her head and eyes. Only her lashes kept moving. Her quiet, composed posture was strikingly attractive.

她还在细细思量，胡雪岩却说得圈子兜得太远，自己都有些不耐烦，决定揭破谜底，略想一想，他说：“郁四嫂，其实你这口冤气也算出过了，你刚才左一个‘没良心’，右一个‘老糊涂’，骂得狗血喷头，人家一句口也不开，等于向你赔了罪，你也可以消消气了。”这一说，把阿七说莫明其妙，好半晌才说：“我是‘皇帝背后骂昏君’，他人又不在这里，怎么听得见？”“哪个说不在这里？”胡雪岩敲敲板壁：“郁四哥，你可以出来了，再来跟郁四嫂说两句好话！”“噢！”郁四应声掀帘，略带窘色，先叫一声：“阿七！”阿七这时才会过意来，“冤家”相见，先就有气，扭转身来就走。哪知道门外早有埋伏，陈世龙说到张家是假话，一直等在门外，这时笑嘻嘻地说道：“你走不得！一走，郁四叔‘跪算盘’、‘顶油灯’的把戏，都看不到了。”于是又是一气，“你好！”她瞪着眼说，“你也跟他串通了来作弄我！”“是，是！”陈世龙高拱双手，一揖到地，“是我错，你不要生气。”这一下搞得阿七无计可施！当前的局面，软硬两难，走是走不脱，理又不愿理郁四，只有回转身坐了下来，把个头偏向窗外，绷紧了脸不说话。

She was still considering his words, but Hu felt that he had gone too far round the subject and was growing impatient himself. He decided to reveal the answer. After a moment's thought, he said, “Sister-in-Law Yu, you've already had some satisfaction. You've called him heartless one moment and an old fool the next, scolding him mercilessly, and he hasn't answered a word. That's as good as an apology. You can afford to let your anger cool.” A’qi was bewildered. Only after a long pause did she say, “I've been like someone calling the emperor a fool behind his back. He isn't here. How could he hear?” “Who says he isn't here?” Hu tapped the partition. “Brother Yu, you can come out now and say a few kind words to Sister-in-Law Yu.” “Yes!” Yu answered, lifting the curtain. Slightly embarrassed, he began, “A’qi!” Only now did she understand. At the sight of her troublesome lover, her first feeling was anger. She turned to leave, only to find an ambush at the door. Chen's claim that he was going to the Zhangs had been false; he had been waiting outside all along. Smiling, he said, “You mustn't leave! If you do, you'll miss Fourth Uncle kneeling on an abacus and balancing an oil lamp on his head.” This provoked her again. “A fine fellow you are!” she said, glaring. “You've joined him in playing tricks on me!” “Yes, yes!” Clasping his hands high, Chen bowed to the ground. “I was wrong. Don't be angry.” Now she was at a loss. Neither force nor persuasion would serve. She could not get away, yet she refused to acknowledge Yu. All she could do was turn back and sit down, facing the window, her expression rigid and her lips closed.

“阿七！”郁四开口了，“算我不对……”“本来就是你不对！”阿七倏地转过身来抢白。“是，是！”郁四也学陈世龙，一味迁就，“是我不对，统统是我不对。好了，事情过去了，不必再打搅人家胡老板，我们走！““走？走到哪里去？”“你说嘛！到我那里，还是到你那里？”“到你那里？哼，”阿七冷笑道，“你们郁府上是‘高门槛’，我哪里跨得进去？”说到这样酸溜溜的话，那就只是磨工夫的事了，胡雪岩向陈世龙抛个眼色，站起身说：“好了！用不着我们在这里讨厌了！你们先谈几句，等下我送你们入洞房。”“啥个洞房不洞房？”阿七也起身相拦，“胡老板你不要走，我们要把话说说清楚，没有这样便当的事！”“我不走！我就在对面房里。”胡雪岩说，“你们自己先谈，谈得拢顶好，谈不拢招呼我一声我就来。郁四嫂你放心，我帮你。”

“A’qi!” Yu began. “Let's say I was wrong...” “You were wrong!” She turned sharply and cut him short. “Yes, yes!” Like Chen, Yu yielded on every point. “I was wrong. It was all my fault. There, it's over now. We needn't trouble Mr Hu any longer. Let's go.” “Go? Where?” “You tell me. My place or yours?” “Your place? Hmph!” She gave a cold laugh. “The Yu family has a lofty threshold. How could I ever step over it?” Once she had reached this sort of sour remark, all that remained was a matter of time and patience. Hu gave Chen a glance and rose. “Good! There's no need for us to stay here making nuisances of ourselves. Have a few words together. Later, I'll escort you to the bridal chamber.” “What bridal chamber?” A’qi stood to stop him. “Don't go, Mr Hu. We must get things straight. It isn't as easy as that!” “I'm not leaving. I'll be in the room opposite. Talk it over yourselves first. If you agree, all the better. If you don't, call and I'll come. Don't worry, Sister-in-Law Yu. I'm on your side.”

这个承诺又是一条无形的绳子，把阿七捆得更加动弹不得，除了依旧数落郁四“没良心”、“老糊涂”以外，只提出一个条件：要郁四从今以后，不准女儿上门。这如何办得到？不管郁四如何软语商量，阿七只是不允。于是非请胡雪岩来调停不可了。听完究竟，胡雪岩笑着向郁四说：“这是有意难难你。郁四嫂是讲道理的人。”这个手法叫做“金钟罩”，一句话把阿七罩住，人家恭维她“讲道理”，她总不能说“我不讲道理”，非要郁四父女继绝往来不可，因此，这时候又板着脸不响了。“我现在才晓得，郁四嫂气的不是你，”胡雪岩这样对郁四说，“是气你大小姐。这也难怪郁四嫂，换了我也要气！想想也实在委屈，照道理，当然要你有个交代，不过说来说去一家人，难道真的要逼你不认女儿？就是你肯，郁四嫂也不肯落这样一个不贤的名声在外面。这就是山东的俗话：”一块豆腐掉在灰堆里，弹不得了！‘真正有苦说不出！“这几句话，直抉阿七心底的衷曲，自己有些感觉，苦于说不出口，现在听胡雪岩替她说了出来，那一份令人震栗的痛快，以及天底下毕竟还有个知道自己的心的知遇之感，夹杂在一起，就如一盏热醋泼在心头，竟抽抽噎噎地哭了起来。

This promise was another invisible cord binding her more tightly. Apart from continuing to call Yu heartless and an old fool, she put forward only one condition: he must never let his daughter enter his house again. How could he possibly do that? However gently he reasoned with her, she would not give way. They had to call Hu back to mediate. After hearing the difficulty, Hu smiled at Yu. “She's deliberately making things hard for you. Sister-in-Law Yu is a reasonable woman.” This was the device known as the Golden Bell Shield: one sentence enclosed her completely. Having been praised for being reasonable, she could hardly declare herself unreasonable and insist that Yu sever all contact with his daughter. So once again she sat with a stiff face and said nothing. “Now I understand,” Hu told Yu. “Sister-in-Law isn't angry with you. She's angry with your daughter. And no wonder! I'd be angry too. When you consider it, she has been treated very unfairly. Naturally, she wants you to put matters right. But, after all, you're one family. Could she really force you to disown your daughter? Even if you agreed, she wouldn't want people calling her an unworthy woman. As they say in Shandong, a piece of tofu has fallen into a heap of ash: you can't flick it clean. She truly has a grievance she can't express.” These words went straight to the feelings in A’qi's heart. She had sensed them herself but had been unable to put them into words. Now Hu had spoken for her. The relief thrilled her, mingling with gratitude that there was, after all, someone in the world who understood her. It was like a cup of hot vinegar poured over her heart. She began to sob.

一路哭，一路数落，但已不是吵架，完全是诉怨。郁四虽觉得有些尴尬，心里却是一块石头落地，知道大事已定。心情闲豫，应付自然从容，也不说话，只从袖中抽出一方手帕递了过去，让她好擦眼泪。擦湿了一方手帕，收住了眼泪，阿七心里感激远多于怨恨，感激的是胡雪岩，站起来福了福：“胡老爷多谢你！费了你好半天的精神。”接着转过脸去向郁四说道：“好走了，麻烦人家胡老板好些工夫，还要赖在这里！”“走，走！”郁四一叠连声的回答，“我先问你，到哪里？”“还到哪里？自然是回家。”“对，对！回家，回家！”郁四转身看着胡雪岩，仿佛千言万语难开日，最后说了这样一句：“我们明天再谈。”一场雷雨，化作春风，胡雪岩心里异常舒畅，微微笑着，送他们出门。走到店堂，迎面遇着黄仪，胡雪岩和他都有意外之感，不由得便站住了脚。“黄先生！”阿七泰然无事，扬一扬招呼，“明朝会。”说着还回眸一笑，洋洋得意的走了。

She wept and reproached Yu as she wept, but this was no longer a quarrel: it was a pouring out of grievances. Although somewhat embarrassed, Yu felt a weight lift from his heart. He knew the great matter was settled. With his mind at ease, he could respond calmly. Saying nothing, he drew a handkerchief from his sleeve and passed it to her to dry her eyes. By the time she had soaked it and stopped crying, gratitude far outweighed resentment in her heart. Her gratitude was towards Hu. Rising, she made him a curtsy. “Mr Hu, thank you! I've taken up so much of your time and energy.” Then she turned to Yu. “It's time to go. We've troubled Mr Hu for ages, and still you sit here!” “Yes, yes, let's go!” Yu answered eagerly. “But first tell me where.” “Where else? Home, of course.” “Yes, yes! Home!” He turned to Hu, seemingly with a thousand things to say and unable to begin. At last he managed, “We'll talk again tomorrow.” A thunderstorm had turned into a spring breeze. Hu felt wonderfully at ease as, smiling faintly, he saw them out. In the front shop they came face to face with Huang Yi. Both he and Hu were surprised and stopped involuntarily. “Mr Huang!” A’qi greeted him with perfect composure, lifting a hand. “See you tomorrow.” With a smile back over her shoulder, she went away in triumph.

湖州之行，三天之内，胡雪岩替自己办了两件要紧事。第一件是约妥了黄仪，随他到杭州去办笔墨。黄仪改变了心意，一则想到外面去闯闯，二则是觉得跟了胡雪岩这样的东家，十分够味，当然也知道这位东家不会薄待，所以薪水酬劳等等，根本不谈。第二件是进一步赢得了郁四的友谊。郁四自从跟阿七言归于好，他的颓唐老态，一扫而空，不再谈衙门里辞差的话，家务也不劳胡雪岩再费心，表示自己可以打点精神来料理。胡雪岩要头寸周转，除了已经拨付的那一笔以外，另外又调动了五万两银子，让他带走。“你的事就是我的事。为你这样的朋友，倾家荡产也值得。况且，我相信你一定有办法。”他这样对胡雪岩说：“你要头寸，只要早点告诉我，我一定替你调齐。”有了郁四的十万银子和他的那句话，胡雪岩又是雄心万丈了。他目前最困难的，就是头寸，在上海堆栈里的丝，搁煞了他的大部分本钱，阜康钱庄的生意，做得极其热闹，已成“大同行”中的“金字招牌”之一，但唯其如此，决不能露丝毫捉襟见时的窘态，而海运局方面，正当新旧交替之际，亏空只能补，不能拉。在这青黄不接的当口，萌雪岩一度想把那批丝，杀价卖掉，虽仍有盈余，但已有限，费心费力的结果，变成几乎白忙一场，自是于心不甘，同时也不肯错过这个机会。左右为难之下，有郁四的这一臂之力，帮忙帮得大了。

During three days in Huzhou, Hu Xueyan accomplished two important things for himself. First, he secured Huang Yi’s agreement to accompany him to Hangzhou as his secretary. Huang had changed his mind partly because he wanted to try his fortune elsewhere, and partly because serving an employer like Hu promised to be thoroughly satisfying. He also knew that Hu would not treat him poorly, so salary and remuneration were never even discussed. Second, Hu strengthened his friendship with Yu Si. Since making peace with A’qi, Yu had lost all his dejection and signs of age. He no longer spoke of resigning his post at the yamen and told Hu not to trouble himself further about his family affairs: he could now summon the energy to manage them himself. As Hu needed working funds, Yu arranged another fifty thousand taels for him to take away, in addition to the sum already transferred. “Your business is mine. For a friend like you, even losing my entire fortune would be worthwhile. Besides, I am sure you will find a way. Whenever you need funds, give me a little notice, and I will have them ready.” With Yu’s hundred thousand taels and that assurance, Hu’s ambitions soared again. His greatest difficulty was liquidity. Most of his capital was tied up in the silk stored in Shanghai. Fukang was flourishing and had become one of the most respected names among the leading banks; for that very reason, it could not afford the slightest appearance of financial strain. Meanwhile, the Sea Transport Bureau was changing hands: its deficit must be reduced, not increased. In this interval before fresh funds became available, Hu had considered selling the silk at a heavy discount. There would still be a profit, but a small one, making all his effort almost unrewarded. He could not reconcile himself to that, nor did he wish to abandon the opportunity. Caught between these difficulties, he found Yu’s help invaluable.

“四哥！”他兴奋地说，“只要你相信我，我包你这笔款子的利息，比放给哪个都来得划算。我已经看准了，这十万银子，我还要‘扑’到洋庄上去。前两天我在杭州得到消息，两江总督怡大人，要对洋人不客气了，这是个难得的机会，一抓住必发大财。不过，机会来了，别人不晓得，我晓得，别人看不准，我看得准。这就是人家做生意，做不过我的地方。“说了半天是什么机会呢？两江总督怡良，郁四倒是晓得的，他是当权的恭亲王的老丈人，也算是皇亲国戚，如果有什么大举措，朝廷一定会支持他，然而对洋人是如何不客气？“莫非，”他迟疑地问，“又要跟洋人开仗？”“那是不会的……”胡雪岩说，他听到的消息是，因为两件事，两江总督怡良对洋人深为不满，第一，小刀会的刘丽川，有洋人自租界接济军火粮食，这是“助逆”而不是“助顺”，就算实际上对刘丽川没有什么帮助，朝廷亦难容忍，而况对刘丽川确为一大助力。第二是从上海失守以后，“夷税”也就是按值百抽五计算的关税，洋人借口虞乱影响，商务停顿，至今不肯缴纳。商务受影响自是难免，如说完全停顿，则是欺人之谈。洋商缴纳关税，全靠各国领事代为约束，现在有意不缴，无奈其何！那就只有一个办法：不跟洋人做生意。

“Brother Yu,” he said excitedly, “if you trust me, I guarantee that the return on this money will be better than you could obtain from lending it to anyone else. I have made up my mind to commit these hundred thousand taels to the foreign trade too. A few days ago in Hangzhou, I learned that Governor-General Yiliang intends to take a hard line with the foreigners. It is a rare opportunity, and whoever seizes it will make a fortune. When an opportunity comes, others do not know of it, but I do; others cannot judge it clearly, but I can. That is why they cannot match me in business.” What opportunity did he mean? Yu knew who Yiliang was: the father-in-law of the influential Prince Gong, and therefore a relative of the imperial house. If he undertook any major action, the court would certainly support him. But what did taking a hard line with the foreigners mean? “Surely,” Yu asked hesitantly, “we are not going to war with them again?” “No, not that.” Hu explained that, according to his information, Yiliang was deeply displeased with the foreigners for two reasons. First, foreigners were sending arms and provisions from the settlement to Liu Lichuan of the Small Swords Society. This was supporting rebellion instead of lawful authority. The court would scarcely tolerate it even if the supplies did Liu little practical good; in fact, they were a considerable help. Second, since Shanghai had fallen, the foreigners had refused to pay the so-called foreign tax, the customs duty levied at five percent of value. They claimed that the disturbances had brought commerce to a halt. Trade was inevitably affected, but to say it had stopped entirely was deception. Payment of customs duties by foreign merchants depended on their consuls enforcing the obligation. If they deliberately refused, what could be done? There was only one answer: cease trading with them.

“租界上的事，官府管不到，再说不跟洋商做生意，难道把销洋庄的货色，抛到黄浦江里？这自然是办不到的，所以，再退一步说，只有一个办法，这个办法也很厉害，内地的丝茶两项，不准运入租界。这是官府办得到的事。”“我懂了！还是你原来的办法，”郁四点点头说，“那样子一来，丝茶两项存货的行情，一定大涨。这倒是好主意！”“自然是好生意。”胡雪岩说，“丝我有了，而且现在也不是时候，收不到货，茶叶上面，大有脑筋可动，官府做事慢，趁告示没有出来以前，我还来得及办货。此外，我还想开一爿当铺，开一家药店，阜康也想在上海设分号……”“老胡，”郁四打断他的话，“我说一句，怕不中听，不过我声明在先，决不是我有啥别的心思，无非提醒你，事情还是你去做，你说怎么办就怎么办。”“四哥，我们的交情，你这番表白是多余的。”话虽多余，不能不先交代，这就是江湖上的“过节”，其实就是郁四以下要说的话，也近乎多余，他劝胡雪岩说，一个人本事再大，精力有限，头绪太多，必有照顾不到的地方。而且他的生意，互相关联，牵一发而动全身，一垮下来，不可收拾。不如暂时收敛，稳扎稳打。这番话语重心长，见得郁四的关切，但胡雪岩自己何尝不知道？其间的利害关系，他远比郁四了解得更透彻，不过他自己足以应付得了，哪一处出了毛病，该如何急救？也曾细细策划过，有恃无恐，所以我行我素。只是郁四说到这样的话，休戚相关，虽不能听，亦不宜辩，因而不断点头，表示接受。

“The authorities cannot control affairs inside the settlement. And even if we say we will stop trading with foreign merchants, are we to throw all our export goods into the Huangpu River? Obviously not. So there is only one practicable step left, and it is a powerful one: prohibit silk and tea from the interior from entering the settlement. That is something the authorities can enforce.” “I see!” Yu nodded. “Your original plan again. The price of silk and tea already held there would certainly soar. A fine idea!” “A fine business, certainly. I already have silk, and this is not the season to buy more. But there is plenty to be done with tea. Officials move slowly. Before the proclamation appears, I still have time to acquire stock. Besides, I want to open a pawnshop and a pharmacy, and establish a Shanghai branch of Fukang.” “Old Hu,” Yu interrupted, “I want to say something you may not like. But let me make it clear first: I have no ulterior motive. It is only a reminder. You will still conduct the business, and whatever you decide will be done.” “With our friendship, Brother Yu, such an explanation is unnecessary.” Unnecessary though it was, it had to be made. This was one of the formal observances of the brotherhood world. Indeed, what Yu went on to say was almost unnecessary too. However capable a man might be, his energy was limited. With too many undertakings, something would escape his attention. Moreover, Hu’s businesses were interconnected: pull one thread and the whole fabric moved. A collapse could become irretrievable. Better to restrain himself for the present and advance steadily. The earnest advice showed Yu’s concern. But how could Hu be unaware of these dangers? He understood the interests involved far better than Yu did. He believed he could manage them and had carefully planned emergency measures for trouble in each quarter. Confident of his resources, he intended to follow his own course. Yet when a friend whose fortunes were bound to his offered such advice, he ought not argue even if he could not follow it. He therefore nodded repeatedly, as though accepting it.

接受不是一句空话可以敷衍的，而郁四有大批本钱投在自己名下，也得替他顾虑。胡雪岩的思考向来宽阔而周密，心里在想郁四的话，可有言外之意？却是不能不问清楚的。“四哥，你的话十分实在。当铺、药店，我决定死了心，暂且丢下。不过，我要请问一句，四哥一定要跟我说实话。”“你这话也是多余的。”郁四答道，“我几时跟你说过假话？”“是的，是的，我晓得。”胡雪岩连连点头，“不过，我怕我或者有啥看不列的地方，要请四哥指点。你看，我们在上海的那批丝，是不是现在脱手比较好？““嗐！”郁四的神色和声音，大似遗憾，“你完全弄错我的意思了！你当我不放心我投在你那里的本钱，决不是！我早就说过了，我相信你，生意你去做，我不过问。”

Acceptance could not be reduced to an empty assurance. Yu had invested a large amount with him, and Hu had to consider his interests. Hu’s thoughts were always wide-ranging and thorough. Was there something behind Yu’s advice? He must find out. “Brother Yu, what you say is entirely sound. I have decided to put the pawnshop and pharmacy aside for now. But there is something I must ask, and you must answer frankly.” “That remark is unnecessary too. When have I ever lied to you?” “Of course, of course. I know.” Hu nodded repeatedly. “But I may have overlooked something and need your guidance. Do you think we should sell our Shanghai silk now?” “Ah!” Yu’s expression and voice showed deep regret. “You have completely misunderstood me. You think I am worried about the capital I have entrusted to you. Not at all! I have told you before: I trust you. You conduct the business; I do not interfere.”

“四哥是相信我，结果弄得‘鸭屎臭’，叫我怎么对四哥交代？”“不要交代！要啥交代？做生意有亏有蚀，没话可说！只有‘开口自己人，独吃自己人’的才是‘鸭屎臭’，你不是那种人。再说一句，就算你要存心吃我，我也情愿，这话不是我现在说，你问阿七。”说着便连声喊着：“阿七，阿七！胡老板有话问你。”阿七在打点送胡雪岩的土仪，正忙得不可开支，但听说是胡雪岩有话问，还是抽出身子来了。“我昨天晚上跟你谈到上海的那批丝，我是怎么跟你说的？”郁四问。“你说，那批丝上的本钱，你只当赌铜钿输掉了。赚了，你不结帐，蚀了，你也睡得着觉。”听这样一说，胡雪岩既感激，又不安，听郁四的口气，大有把那笔本钱奉送之意，这无论如何是受之有愧的。但此时无需急着表白，朋友相交不在一日，郁四果有此心，自己倒要争个面子，将来叫他大大地出个意外。于是他说：“四哥你这样说，我的胆就大了。人生难得遇着知己，趁这时候我不好好去闯一闯，也太对不起自己了。”

“You trust me, Brother Yu, but if the result is a foul mess, how could I answer to you?” “You needn’t answer for it! Business has losses as well as gains. There is nothing to complain of. The only foul men are those who call you one of their own and then swallow all the profit themselves. You are not such a man. I’ll say more: even if you deliberately took advantage of me, I would accept it. I am not saying this only now. Ask A’qi.” He called repeatedly, “A’qi! A’qi! Boss Hu has something to ask you.” A’qi was extremely busy preparing local gifts for Hu to take away, but at the mention of his request she came out. “What did I tell you last night about the silk in Shanghai?” Yu asked. “You said you treated the capital in it as money lost at gambling. If it made a profit, you would not call for a settlement; if it made a loss, you would still sleep soundly.” Hu felt both grateful and uneasy. Yu almost seemed to intend the capital as a gift, which Hu could not accept with an easy conscience. But there was no need to protest at once. Friendship was not measured in a single day. If that was indeed Yu’s intention, Hu would make a special effort and give him a great surprise in the future. “Brother Yu, that gives me courage,” he said. “It is rare to find a friend who understands one. If I don’t venture out while I have the chance, I shall scarcely be doing myself justice.”

在这一刻，胡雪岩又有了新的主意，但决定等那批丝脱手以后，把郁四名下应得的一份，替他在上海买租界上的地皮。这是一个突如其来的念头，细细想去，第一，不受炮火的影响，各地逃难到上海租界的人，一定会越来越多，市面当然要兴旺，第二，朝廷对洋人不欢迎，但既然订了商约，洋人要来，不欢迎也办不到。“五口通商”只有上海这个码头最热闹，一旦洪杨战败，逃难的人会相携还乡，但做生意的人，是不会走的。所以，趁现在把上海租界里那些无甚入息，地价便宜的苇塘空地买下来，将来一定会大发其财。不过，这是五年、十年以后，如果有闲钱无甚用处，不妨买了摆在那里，象自己现在这样，急需头寸周转，就不必去打这个主意。“老胡！”郁四见他沉吟不语，便即问道：“你在想啥？”“还不是动生意上的脑筋。”说了这一句，胡雪岩才想起郁四劝他的话，自然不宜再出花样，因而自己摇着手说：“不谈，不谈。是空想！”“不要去多想了！我们吃酒，谈点有趣的事。”

At that moment Hu had a new idea. Once the silk was sold, he would use Yu’s rightful share to buy land for him in the Shanghai settlement. The thought came suddenly, but it bore examination. First, the settlement was protected from bombardment. More and more people would flee there from troubled districts, and its commerce would flourish. Second, the court might dislike foreigners, but having signed commercial treaties, it could not prevent them from coming. Of the five treaty ports, Shanghai was the busiest. Once Hong and Yang were defeated, refugees would return home together, but businessmen would remain. Buying cheap, unproductive reed beds and vacant land in the settlement now would therefore bring a great fortune later. That, however, lay five or ten years ahead. A man with idle money could buy land and leave it. A man like Hu, urgently needing working funds, ought not to consider it for himself. “Old Hu,” Yu asked, noticing his silence, “what are you thinking about?” “Business again.” Then Hu remembered Yu’s warning. He should not propose another venture now. Waving his hand, he added, “Never mind. It is only a fancy.” “Stop thinking so much. Let’s have a drink and talk of something amusing.”

趣事甚多，胡雪岩讲了七姑奶奶逛堂子的笑话，把阿七听得出了神。郁四也觉得新奇，表示很想会一会这样一个“奇女子”。“那容易得很！”胡雪岩说，“只要你抽得出空，我陪你走一遭，尤家兄妹一定也会觉得你很对劲。”“真的，”阿七接口向郁四说，“你也该到外头走走，见见世面。年纪一大把，乐得看开些，吃吃喝喝，四处八方去逛逛，让我也开开眼界。”这番怂恿把郁四说动了心，平生足迹不出里门，外面是怎么样的一个花花世界，只听人说，未曾目睹，到底是桩憾事，如果能带着阿七去走一走，会一会江湖上的朋友，也是暮年一大乐事。只是怎么能抽得出身。因此，他又想到衙门里的差使，要找个替手这件大事，“老胡，”他毫不考虑地问了出来，“上次我跟你谈过的，想叫小和尚来当差，你可曾问过他？”“还不曾问。”胡雪岩心想，陈世龙大概不会愿意，而且有阿七在，陈世龙也实在不宜过分接近郁家，再为自己打算，也难放手，所以索性再加一句：“我想不问也罢。我看他十之八九不肯！”“那就算了。”郁四偶惘地说，“我另外物色。”

There was plenty to amuse them. Hu told the story of the Seventh Lady’s visit to a courtesan house, and A’qi listened spellbound. Yu too found it remarkable and said he would like to meet such an extraordinary woman. “Easily arranged,” Hu replied. “If you can find the time, I’ll go with you. Both Brother You and his sister would certainly take to you.” “Indeed,” A’qi urged Yu, “you ought to go out and see something of the world. At your age, why not take things easily, enjoy good food and drink, and travel about? Let me broaden my horizons too.” This tempted Yu. He had never traveled beyond his home district. All he knew of the colorful world outside came from other people’s stories, which was a real regret. Traveling with A’qi and meeting friends from the brotherhood would be a great pleasure in his later years. But how could he free himself? He thought again of finding a replacement for his work at the yamen. “Old Hu,” he asked without hesitation, “did you ask Little Monk about taking the post I mentioned last time?” “Not yet.” Hu thought Chen would probably be unwilling. Moreover, with A’qi there, it would be unwise for Chen to become too closely involved with the Yu household. Hu’s own affairs would also make it hard to spare him. He therefore added, “I think there is no need to ask. I am almost certain he would refuse.” “Then let it drop,” Yu said disconsolately. “I’ll look for someone else.”

这两句对答，使得阿七深为注意，在过去，如果谈到陈世龙，她立刻会插嘴来问，但自从有了那两番私晤，倾诉心曲的经历，变得“做贼心虚”，在郁四面前，处处要避嫌疑，所以当时不敢搭腔，过后才找个机会，悄悄问胡雪岩是怎么回事？胡雪岩也正要这样一个单独相处的机会，好问她一个明白，因而说明其事以后，紧接着便是这样一句：“郁四嫂，我有句话，不晓得能不能问？问了伯你不高兴，不问，我心里总不安稳。真正不知道该怎么办？”阿七是很聪明、也很爽荡的人，微微红着脸说：“我晓得你要问的是啥？那件事我做错了。不过当时并不晓得做错。““这话怎么说？”胡雪岩觉得她的话，很有意味，“是你跟郁四哥讲和以后，才晓得自己错了？”“是的！”阿七羞涩地一笑，别具妩媚之姿，“想想还是老头子好，样样依我，换了别人，要我样样依他，这在我，也是办不到的。”

A’qi listened closely to this exchange. In the past, she would immediately have asked questions whenever Chen was mentioned. But since their two private meetings, when she had poured out her feelings, she had developed a guilty conscience and took care to avoid suspicion in Yu’s presence. She dared not join in then. Only later did she find an opportunity to ask Hu privately what it was about. Hu had wanted just such a chance to question her. After explaining, he went straight on: “Sister-in-Law Yu, there is something I do not know whether I may ask. If I ask, I fear you will be displeased; if I don’t, I cannot feel at ease. I really do not know what to do.” A’qi was intelligent and candid. Blushing slightly, she said, “I know what you want to ask. I was wrong about that. But at the time I did not know it was wrong.” “What do you mean?” Hu found this interesting. “Did you realize you were wrong only after making peace with Brother Yu?” “Yes.” She gave a shy, charming smile. “When I think it over, the old man is best after all. He gives way to me in everything. With someone else, I would have to give way to him in everything, and I could never do that.”

胡雪岩觉得以她的脾气和出身，还有句话提出来也不算太唐突，所以接着又问：“那么你去看世龙之前，是怎么个想法？”一听这话，阿七有些紧张：“小和尚把我的话，都告诉你了？”这下胡雪岩倒要考虑了，看阿七的神气，是不愿意让第三者晓得她的秘密，如果为了叫她心里好过，大可否认。只是这一来，就不会了解她对陈世龙到底是怎么一种感情？想一想，还是要说实话。于是他点一点头，清清楚楚地答道：“源源本本地告诉我了。”阿七大为忸怩，“这个死东西！”她不满地骂，“跟他闹着玩的，他竟当真的了！真不要脸！”这是掩饰之词，胡雪岩打破沙锅问到底，又刺她一句：“你说闹着玩，也闹得太厉害了，居然还寻上门去，如果让阿珠晓得了，吃起醋来，你岂不是造孽？”“那也要怪他自己不好。”阿七不肯承认自己的错处，“无论如何香火之情总有的。那时候我心里一天到晚发慌，静不下来，只望有个人陪我谈谈。他连这一点都不肯，我气不过，特为跟他罗嗦，叫他的日子也不好过！“说着，她得意地笑了。这翻话照胡雪岩的判断，有十分之七可靠，不可靠的是她始终不承认对陈世龙动过心！然而事过境迁可以不去管它，只谈以后好了。“以后呢？”他问，“你怎么样看待陈世龙？”“有啥怎么样？”阿七说得很坦率，“我死心塌地跟了老头子，他也要讨亲了，还有啥话说？”于是胡雪岩也没话说了，神色轻松，大可放心。

Given her temperament and background, Hu felt that another question would not be too presumptuous. “Then what were you thinking before you went to see Shilong?” A’qi grew tense. “Did Little Monk tell you everything I said?” Now Hu had to consider. Her expression showed that she did not want a third person to know her secret. To spare her feelings, he could deny it. But then he would never discover exactly what she felt for Chen. After reflecting, he decided to tell the truth. He nodded and said clearly, “Everything, from beginning to end.” She was deeply embarrassed. “The wretch!” she complained. “I was only teasing him, and he took it seriously. How shameless!” It was an excuse. Determined to get to the bottom of it, Hu pressed her again. “Even if you were teasing, you went very far—actually calling on him! If A’zhu had found out and become jealous, wouldn’t you have done harm?” “Then he would have been partly to blame himself.” A’qi would not admit fault. “Whatever else, there was still a bond between us. At that time I was anxious all day and could not settle down. All I wanted was someone to talk to. He wouldn’t grant me even that. I was angry, so I deliberately bothered him to make his life uncomfortable too.” She smiled with satisfaction. Hu judged her account about seven-tenths credible. The doubtful part was her continued refusal to admit having felt an attraction to Chen. But circumstances had changed; there was no need to pursue the past. They need only discuss the future. “What about now?” he asked. “How do you regard Shilong?” “What is there to regard?” she answered frankly. “I have settled my heart on the old man, and Shilong is going to marry. What more is there to say?” Hu had nothing further to ask. His expression relaxed; he could be at ease.

“胡老板，”阿七出了难题给他来回答，“张家阿珠这样的人品，你怎么舍得放手？”“这话，”胡雪岩想了想答道，“说来你不会相信，只当我卖膏药、说大话。不过我自己晓得，我做这件事就象我劝郁四哥把你接回来一样，是蛮得意的。““得意点啥？”阿七有意报复，“刚开的一朵鲜花，便宜了小和尚。你倒不懊悔！”“要说懊悔，”胡雪岩也有意跟她开玩笑，“我懊悔不该劝郁四哥把你接回来，我自己要了你好了，大不了象黄仪一样，至多讨一场没趣。”阿七笑了，“好样不学，学他！”接着，神色一正，“胡老板，我规规矩矩问你一句话。”“好！我规规矩矩听。”“你太太凶不凶？”“你问她作啥？”胡雪岩笑道：“是不是要替我做媒？”“对！不然何必问？”

“Boss Hu,” A’qi said, posing a difficult question in return, “how could you let a girl like the Zhang family’s A’zhu go?” Hu considered. “If I explain, you won’t believe me. You will think I am a quack selling his remedies and boasting. But I know for myself that I am as pleased with arranging that affair as I am with persuading Brother Yu to bring you back.” “What is there to be pleased about?” she asked, deliberately retaliating. “A flower just coming into bloom, and Little Monk gets the benefit. Aren’t you sorry?” “If I have any regrets,” Hu replied, teasing in turn, “it is that I persuaded Brother Yu to take you back. I ought to have tried for you myself. At worst I would have been rebuffed like Huang Yi.” A’qi laughed. “Of all the examples you might follow, you choose his!” Then she grew serious. “Boss Hu, let me ask you a proper question.” “Very well. I shall listen properly.” “Is your wife fierce?” “Why do you ask?” Hu laughed. “Are you going to find me a match?” “Exactly. Why else would I ask?”

“那么，你打说来听听，是怎么样一个人？”“人是比我胜过十倍，不过命也比我苦。”阿七说道，“是个小孤孀。”接着，阿七便夸赞这个“小孤孀”的品貌，胡雪岩被她说得心思有些活动了，试探着问道：“她家里怎么样？守不住改嫁，夫家娘家都要答应，麻烦很多。”“麻烦是有一点，不过也没有料理不好的。”阿七说道，“她夫家没有人。倒是娘家，有个不成材的叔叔，还有个小兄弟，如果娶了她，这个小兄弟要带在身边。”“那倒也无所谓。”胡雪岩沉吟着，好半天不作声。“胡老板，”阿七怂恿着说，“你湖州也常要来的，有个门口在这里，一切方便，而且，说人品真正是又漂亮、又贤惠！要不要看看？”“那好啊！怎么个看法，总不是媒婆领了来吧？”“当然不能这么青。”阿七想了想说，“这样吧，明天一早我邀她到北门天圣寺烧香，你在那里等，见了装作不认识我，不要打招呼。我也不跟她说破，这样子没有顾忌，你就看得清楚了。”“也好！准定这么办。”

“Then tell me about her. What sort of person is she?” “Ten times better than I am, though her life has been harder. She is a young widow.” A’qi went on to praise the widow’s beauty and character. Hu began to feel interested and asked cautiously, “What is her family situation? If she chooses to remarry instead of remaining a widow, both her husband’s family and her own must agree. There could be a great deal of trouble.” “Some trouble, but nothing that cannot be managed. There is no one in her husband’s family. On her own side, there is a worthless uncle and a younger brother. Whoever marries her must take the boy into the household too.” “That would not matter.” Hu pondered in silence. “Boss Hu,” she urged, “you often come to Huzhou. Having a household here would make everything convenient. And she really is both beautiful and good. Would you like to see her?” “Certainly. How would we arrange it? Surely not by having a matchmaker bring her round?” “Of course we cannot be so blunt.” A’qi thought for a moment. “Tomorrow morning I’ll invite her to burn incense at Tiansheng Temple by the North Gate. Wait there. When you see me, pretend not to know me and don’t greet me. I won’t tell her the purpose either. With no reason for self-consciousness, you will be able to see her as she is.” “Very well. Let us do that.”

到了第二天，胡雪岩找陈世龙陪着，到了北门天圣寺，先烧香，后求签，签上是这样一首诗：暮云千里乱吴峰，落叶微闻远寺钟；目尽长江秋草外，美人何处采芙蓉？胡雪岩看不懂这首诗，只看签是“中平”，解释也不见得高明，便一笑置之，跟阵世龙寺前寺后，闲步随喜。陈世龙却有些奇怪，只听胡雪岩说要到天圣寺走走，未说是何用意？他这样的一个大忙人，力何忽发雅兴，来游古刹。先是心里打算，他既不说，自己也不必问，但等到了天圣寺，自然明白，这时看不出名堂，就忍不住要问了。“胡先生，你是不是等什么人？还是……”“对！我正是等人。跟你说了吧！”一说经过，陈世龙笑道：“幄。我晓得了！”他说，“一定是何家的那个小孤孀，不错！阿七的眼光不错，不过，这个媒做得成，做不成，就很难说了。”“原来你也晓得。”胡雪岩颇有意外之感，“来，我们到那里坐一坐。”

The next day Hu took Chen Shilong with him to Tiansheng Temple. He first burned incense, then drew a fortune slip. It bore a poem: “Evening clouds for a thousand li blur the peaks of Wu; through falling leaves, a distant temple bell is faintly heard. Beyond the autumn grass, the gaze follows the Yangtze as far as sight can reach; where does the beauty gather lotus blooms?” Hu did not understand the verse. He saw only that the fortune was rated middling, and its explanation seemed no more illuminating. He dismissed it with a smile and strolled around the temple with Chen. Chen was puzzled. Hu had said that he wanted to visit Tiansheng Temple but had given no reason. Why had such a busy man suddenly developed a taste for ancient temples? At first Chen thought that, since Hu had not explained, he need not ask; once they arrived, the purpose would become clear. Now, seeing no sign of it, he could not help inquiring. “Mr Hu, are you waiting for someone, or…” “Exactly. I am waiting for someone. I may as well tell you.” When Hu explained, Chen laughed. “Ah, I understand! It must be the young widow from the He family. A’qi has a good eye. Whether the match can be made is another question.” Hu was rather surprised. “So you know about her too. Come, let us sit over there.”

两人在庙门口一家点心摊子上坐了下来，一面吃汤圆，一面谈何家的小孤孀。据陈世龙说，此人颇有艳名，自从居孀以后，很有些人打她的主意，但夫家还好说话，娘家有个胞叔，十分难，所以好事一直不谐。“无非是多要几两银子。”胡雪岩问，“有什么难的？”“那家伙嫖赌吃着，一应俱全，哪个跟他做了亲戚，三天两头上门来罗嗦，就吃不消了。”“这倒不必怕他。”胡雪岩又问，“她娘家姓啥？”“娘家姓刘。他叔叔叫刘三才，人家把他的名字改了一个字，叫做刘不才。由这上头，胡先生就可以晓得他的为人了。”“总有点用处吧！”“用处是有点的。不过没有人敢用他。这个人太滑、太靠不住。”“不管它！你倒说来我听听，刘不才有何用处？”“他能说会道，风花雪月，无不精通，是做篾片的好材料。”陈世龙接着又用警告的语气说，“就是银钱不能经他的手。说句笑话，他老子死了，如果买棺材的钱经他的手，他都会先用了再说。”胡雪岩笑了，“有这样的人？”是不甚相信的语气。“就有这样的人！”陈世尤特为举证：“我跟他在赌场里常常碰头，诸如此类的事，见得多了。”

They sat at a refreshment stall by the temple gate and talked over bowls of sweet rice dumplings. According to Chen, the widow was celebrated for her beauty. Many men had been interested since her husband’s death. His family was reasonably accommodating, but her father’s brother was extremely difficult. That was why no match had yet succeeded. “He can only want a little more money,” Hu said. “What is difficult about that?” “Every indulgence—women, gambling, fine food and clothes—he enjoys them all. Anyone who becomes his relative will have him at the door every few days making trouble. It would be intolerable.” “There is no need to fear him. What was her maiden surname?” “Liu. Her uncle is Liu Sancai. People change a character of his name and call him Liu Bucai—Liu the Good-for-Nothing. That tells you what he is like.” “Surely he is useful in some way?” “In some ways, yes. But nobody dares employ him. He is too slippery and unreliable.” “Never mind that. Tell me what he is good at.” “He is an eloquent talker, thoroughly versed in every romantic and fashionable amusement—the very material for a rich man’s hanger-on.” Chen added a warning. “Only never let money pass through his hands. To put it as a joke, if his father died and he were given money for the coffin, he would spend it on himself first.” Hu laughed incredulously. “Can anyone be like that?” “He is exactly like that. I often met him in gambling houses and saw plenty of such behavior.”

胡雪岩点点头，抛开陈世龙的话，管自己转念头。他心里在想，篾片有篾片的用处，帮闲的人，官场中叫清客，遇着纨袴子弟便叫篾片，好似竹篓子一样，没有竹筐片，就拧不起空架子。自己也要几个篾片，帮着交际应酬。如果刘不才本心还不坏，只是好拆烂污，倒不妨动动脑筋，收服了他做个帮手。“来了，来了！”陈世龙突然拉着他的衣服，轻轻说道。胡雪岩定定神，抬头望去，这一望，心里立刻便是异样的味道。何家的小寡妇是个“黑里俏”，除了皮肤以外，无可批评。腰肢极细，走几步路，如凤摆杨柳，却又不象风尘中人的有意做作，而是天然袅娜。她下了轿子，扶着个十一二岁的小丫头。一步一步的走过点心摊子。胡雪岩的脸便随着她转，一直转到背脊朝陈世尤为止。陈世龙已会过了帐，悄悄的拉了他一把，两个人跟着又进了山门。阿七是早就看到了他们的，此时落后一步，微微转近身来摇一摇手。

Hu nodded, put Chen’s words aside and pursued his own thoughts. A hanger-on had his uses. Among officials, such a companion was called a cultivated guest; among wealthy young idlers, he was a miepian, a strip of bamboo.
