约定了地方，尤五陪着胡雪岩安步当车，到了怡情院。怡情老二出堂差去了，新用的一个娘姨阿巧姐十分能干，一面应酬着把客人引入大房间，一面派“相帮”去催怡情老二回来。“怎么玩法？”尤五问道，“是邀人来吃酒，还是打牌？”“打牌不必了。”胡雪岩看那阿巧姐白净俏刮，一口吴侬软语，比怡情老二说得还道地，大有好感，所以自告奋勇，“我来做个‘花头’。摆个‘双台’吧！”“胡老爷有多少客人？”阿巧姐说：“客人少了，摆双台不象呢。”“摆双台”不一定摆两桌，她这样说是表示当客人“自己人”，替他节省，胡雪岩对花丛的规矩还不大在行，不知如何回答？尤五却懂她的意思，同时料知胡雪岩一时不会有什么客人要请！便老实说道：“阿巧姐的话不错！要做花头，有的是辰光。等老二来了再说。“阿巧姐也附和着，胡雪岩只好作昙。两个人在套房里，隔着一只烟盘，躺在红木炕床上闲谈着，等候怡情老二。“这个陈巧娘姨倒还不错。”胡雪岩说，“今年快三十岁了吧？”“怎么样？”尤五笑道：“我替你做个媒，好不好？”

Their meeting place arranged, You accompanied Hu on foot to Yiqing House. Second Miss had gone out to entertain at a banquet. A capable newly hired house attendant, A’qiao, welcomed them, conducted them into the main room, and sent a male attendant to hurry Second Miss back. “How shall we amuse ourselves?” You asked. “Invite people to drink, or play cards?” “No need for cards.” Hu found A’qiao fair, neat and pretty. Her soft Wu speech was even more authentic than Second Miss's, and he took a strong liking to her. He volunteered a proposal. “I'll provide a little excitement. Let's arrange a double-table party.” “How many guests have you invited, Mr Hu?” A’qiao asked. “A double-table party won't look right with too few.” Such a party did not necessarily require two actual tables. Her remark showed that she treated him as one of the household and wanted to save him expense. Hu was not yet familiar with the customs of courtesan society and did not know how to reply. You understood her intention, and guessed that Hu had no guests ready to invite. He spoke frankly. “Sister A’qiao is right. There's plenty of time for a special entertainment. Let's wait until Second Miss comes.” A’qiao agreed, and Hu had to let the matter rest. In the inner room, the two men reclined on a rosewood couch, an opium tray between them, talking while they waited. “This attendant A’qiao is rather good,” Hu said. “She must be nearly thirty?” “Well?” You laughed. “Shall I make a match for you?”

胡雪岩笑而不答，自是默许之意，正想开口说什么，只见门帘掀处，怡情老二翩然出现，见了胡雪岩少不得有一番殷勤的问讯。接着，古应春也到了，他要抢着作东，北里冶游，有套不成文的法则，作主人必在相好的地方，吃了这家到那家，名为“翻台”，古应春为了生意上交际的需要，有个相熟的户头，名叫“虹影楼老七”，就在前一条弄堂“铺房间”，约胡雪岩先到那里吃一台酒，再翻回来在怡情院吃消夜。“没有这个规矩。”怡情老二反对，“自然是先在这里摆酒，再翻到虹影楼去。”。胡雪岩也认为应该这样，但尤五另有打算，摇手说道：“照老古的办法。回头来吃消夜。小爷叔不回丝栈了，今天晚上在你们这里‘借干铺’。“既然如此，当然是先到别处吃花酒，最后回到怡情院，吃完消夜，就可安歇，不必再挪动了。所以怡情老二点头同意，而且打算着陪尤五住到“小房子”去，将自己在怡情院的房间，让给胡雪岩住。

Hu smiled without answering, giving his tacit consent. He was about to say something when the curtain lifted and Second Miss appeared gracefully. Naturally, she greeted him with attentive inquiries. Gu arrived soon afterwards and insisted on playing host. Courtesan entertainment had its unwritten rules: one entertained at the establishment of one's own favourite, and going from a feast at one house to another was called ‘turning tables’. For the sake of business sociability, Gu had an established acquaintance, Seventh Miss of Hongying House, whose rooms were in the next lane. He invited Hu to dine there first, then return to Yiqing House for a late supper. “That isn't the rule,” Second Miss objected. “Naturally, you should dine here first and then move to Hongying House.” Hu agreed, but You had another plan. He waved his hand. “Let's do as Gu suggests and come back for supper. Little Uncle isn't returning to the silk warehouse. He'll borrow an empty bed here tonight.” In that case, it made sense to enjoy the courtesan banquet elsewhere and return to Yiqing House last. After supper, Hu could rest without moving again. Second Miss agreed. She planned to stay with You at their small separate house and leave her own rooms at Yiqing House for Hu.

于是一起到了虹影楼，进门落座，古应春就叫取纸笔写请客票。胡雪岩征尘甫卸，惮于应酬之繁，便阻止他说：“算了，算了！就我们三个人玩玩吧！”这一来改了写局票，第一张是怡情老二，写完了，古应春拈笔问胡雪岩，“小爷叔，”他改了称呼，“叫哪个？是不是以前的那个眉香老四？”“市面勿灵！”虹影楼老七接口，“眉香老四上一节就不做了。”“这样吧，”尤五代为做主，向古应春说道：“你们做个‘联襟’吧，叫老九来陪小爷叔。”“老九？”古应春说，“老九是‘清倌人’！”虹影楼老九是只以歌艺陪客的“清倌人”。古应春的意思是提醒尤五，胡雪岩如果叫“虹影楼老九”的局，只能欣赏她的歌艺，而胡雪岩却了解尤五的用心，赶紧说道：“就是清倌人好。”这一说，主随客意，古应春便把局票发了出去，一个在楼上，一个隔一条弄堂，不费工夫，所以等席面摆好，怡情老二和虹影楼老九都到了，各人跟着一名提了胡琴的“乌师”，准备清唱下酒。

They went together to Hongying House. As soon as they were seated, Gu called for paper and brush to write invitations. Hu, scarcely recovered from his journey and reluctant to face elaborate sociability, stopped him. “No, no. Let the three of us enjoy ourselves.” Instead, Gu wrote summonses for the entertainers. The first was for Second Miss. Holding his brush, he asked Hu, adopting a different form of address, “Little Uncle, whom shall we call? Fourth Miss of Meixiang House, as before?” “Business is poor,” Seventh Miss put in. “Fourth Miss left the profession at the last festival.” You decided for Hu. “Why don't you two become ‘brothers-in-law’? Call Ninth Miss to keep Little Uncle company.” “Ninth Miss?” Gu said. “She's a qingguan.” Ninth Miss of Hongying House was a qingguan, a young performer who entertained guests through her singing. Gu was reminding You that if Hu summoned her, he could only enjoy her performance. Hu, however, understood You's intention and quickly said, “A qingguan is just what I want.” The host deferred to his guest and sent out the summonses. One performer was upstairs and the other only a lane away, so no time was lost. By the time the table was laid, Second Miss and Ninth Miss had arrived, each accompanied by a musician carrying a huqin, ready to sing without theatrical costume as the men drank.

席面甚宽，“小姐”不必按规矩坐在客人身后，夹杂并坐，胡雪岩拉青虹影楼老九细看，见她刘海覆额，稚气未脱，便问：“你今年几岁？”“十五。”胡雪岩看一看虹影楼老七，再回脸看她，一个鸭蛋脸，一个圆脸，面貌神情，完全两路，因又问道：“你们是不是亲姐妹？”问到这话，虹影楼老九笑而不答，古应春接口说道：“哪里来这么多亲姐妹？不过，老九的事，老七做得了主。”胡雪岩懂他的意思，但并无另外安排的打算，就不接口了。“老九！”古应春就，“你唱一段什么？”“胡老爷喜欢听啥，我就唱啥。”“唷！”胡雪岩笑道，“看样子老九肚里的货色还不少。”“不错！”古应春说，“女大十八变，她现在年纪还小，论艺，将来一定行。”“谢谢你。姐夫！”虹影楼老九嫣然一笑，现在两个酒窝，显得很甜。“将来一定会更出色，值得在技艺上下功夫培养。”“全靠胡老爷捧场。”虹影楼老七，接着胡雪岩的话说，然后又轻声去问古应春，他住在哪里？

The table was spacious enough for the women to sit among the guests instead of behind them, as custom otherwise required. Hu drew Ninth Miss nearer for a look. Her fringe covered her forehead, and she still had a child's air. “How old are you?” “Fifteen.” Hu looked from Seventh Miss back to her. One had an oval face, the other a round one; their looks and expressions were wholly different. “Are you actual sisters?” Ninth Miss smiled without answering. Gu replied, “Where would so many actual sisters come from? But Seventh Miss can make decisions for her.” Hu understood, but had no intention of arranging anything further and let the matter drop. “Ninth Miss,” Gu said, “what will you sing?” “Whatever Mr Hu would like to hear.” “Oh!” Hu smiled. “It seems you have quite a repertoire.” “Indeed. Girls change greatly as they grow up, and she's still very young. As for her art, she's certain to do well.” “Thank you, Brother-in-Law.” Ninth Miss smiled, showing two dimples that made her look sweet. “She'll certainly grow more accomplished. Her talents are worth cultivating.” “She'll depend on your support, Mr Hu,” Seventh Miss answered. Then she quietly asked Gu where Hu was staying.

“你问这话做啥？”古应春笑道：“是不是担心胡老爷没安排好住处？”“狗嘴里长不出象牙！”虹影楼老七，捏起粉拳在他背上捶了一下，“我跟你说！”说得很轻，咕咕噜噜听不清什么，尤五有些不耐烦，大声说道：“有话不会到枕头上去说！吃酒！吃酒。”虹影楼老七见客人发话，急忙赔笑道歉，亲自执壶敬酒，又叫她妹妹唱了一段小调，这才把席面槁得热闹了起来。一曲既罢，来了张局票，交到虹影楼老九手里，她说一声：“对不起！回头请过来会。“起身而去，这一下席面顿时又显得冷清清了。尤五大为不满，“凳子都没有坐热，就要转局。”他说，“这种花酒吃得真没有味道！”这一说，虹影楼老七自然不安，说好话，赔不是。尤五爱理不理，胡雪岩懒得答话，一时场面上弄得很尴尬，虹影楼老七面子上有些下不来，便嗔怪古应春不开口帮她，是存心要她的好看。“我不怪你，你还怪我！”古应春也有些光火。“好了，好了！”怡情老二开口相劝，“都看我的薄面，七阿姐决不敢故意怠慢贵客的。”一面说，一面将尤五拉了一把。

“Why do you ask?” Gu said with a smile. “Are you worried that Mr Hu hasn't arranged somewhere to stay?” “No ivory ever comes out of a dog's mouth!” Seventh Miss made a little fist and tapped him on the back. “Let me tell you...” She spoke so softly that the others could not make out her murmuring. You grew impatient. “Can't you save your private talk for the pillow? Drink! Drink!” Seeing that a guest was displeased, Seventh Miss hastily smiled and apologized. She took the wine pot herself to serve them and had her younger sister sing a popular tune. Only then did the table become lively. As soon as the song ended, another summons arrived for Ninth Miss. “Forgive me. Please come and see me later,” she said, rising to leave. The company immediately seemed subdued again. You was deeply displeased. “She hadn't even warmed her seat before moving on to another party. There's no pleasure in a banquet like this.” Naturally uneasy, Seventh Miss tried soothing words and apologies. You scarcely acknowledged her, while Hu could not be bothered to answer. The atmosphere became awkward. Unable to maintain her dignity, she reproached Gu for saying nothing in her support, as though he wanted to see her humiliated. “I haven't blamed you, and now you're blaming me!” Gu, too, was becoming angry. “Now, now,” Second Miss intervened. “For my sake, please. Seventh Sister would never deliberately neglect honoured guests.” As she spoke, she tugged at You.

这个不曾开口，胡雪岩倒觉得老大过意不去，“都怪我！”他举杯向古、尤二人说道，“罚我一杯。”这罚的是什么名堂？古应春正想发问，胡雪岩抛过一个眼色来，暗示息事宁人，倒使得他越觉歉然，想了想，对怡情老二说道：“到你那里去吧！”“这，怎么好意思！”怡情老二为了“小姐妹”的义气，面有难色。“这里很好！”胡雪岩故意说道：“老七，请你拿块热手巾给我。”等她一走，胡雪岩便劝告古应春和尤五，逢场作戏，不必认真。那两个没有表示，怡情老二却大为感动，说他脾气好，能体谅人，不知道哪个福气的，做着这一号好客人。这一说提醒了尤五，把她拉到一边，附耳低语，怡情老二一双俏眼，只瞟着胡雪岩，一面听，一面点头，最后说了句：“包在我身上。”“听见没有？”尤五笑道，“包在老二身上。”胡雪岩会意，报以感谢的一笑，古应春却不明白，但察言观色，料知是一桩有趣的事，而这桩趣事，决不会发生在虹影楼，便站起身来说，“走吧！”这一走，让虹影楼老七的面子过不去，怡情老二和胡雪岩便都相劝，总算又坐了下来，但意兴已颇阑珊。

You said nothing, but Hu felt thoroughly uncomfortable. “It's all my fault,” he said, raising his cup to Gu and You. “I'll drink a penalty cup.” What was the penalty for? Gu was about to ask when Hu gave him a look urging him to let the matter rest. This only made Gu more apologetic. After considering, he said to Second Miss, “Let's go to your place.” “How could I?” She looked troubled, out of loyalty to her fellow courtesan. “We're very comfortable here,” Hu said deliberately. “Seventh Miss, would you bring me a hot towel?” Once she had gone, he advised Gu and You not to take a passing entertainment so seriously. Neither answered, but Second Miss was deeply moved. He was so good-tempered and considerate, she said; what fortunate woman would have such a patron! This reminded You of something. He drew her aside and whispered in her ear. Her bright eyes kept glancing at Hu as she listened and nodded. At last she said, “Leave it to me.” “Did you hear?” You laughed. “Second Miss has it in hand.” Understanding, Hu returned a grateful smile. Gu did not understand, but their expressions suggested an amusing development, and one that certainly would not occur at Hongying House. He rose. “Let's go.” To leave like this would embarrass Seventh Miss, so both Hu and Second Miss persuaded him to stay. He sat down again at last, but their pleasure was nearly spent.

勉强坐到钟敲十下，才算终席。等回到怡情老二的小房子里，不曾再摆酒，煮茗清谈，反倒有良朋聚首之乐。胡雪岩便讲他在湖州的遭遇，与刘不才的妙闻。尤五听了，只觉得有趣，古应春却是别有会心。“这位刘老兄倒是难得的人才。”他说：“能不能叫他到上海来？”“当然可以。”胡雪岩问：“莫非你有用他之处？”“对！这个人是‘篦片’的好材料。”古应春说，“十里夷场，光怪陆离，就要这样的人，才有办法。我想请他专门来替我们陪客，贵家公子，纨袴子弟，还有些官场红员，都喜欢到夷场上来见识见识，有个人能陪着他们玩，说什么话都容易了。“这个看法与胡雪岩相近，因而欣然同意，决定第二天就写信把刘不才找来。

They endured until the clock struck ten, when the feast could finally end. Back at Second Miss's small separate house, they served no further wine. Over tea and quiet conversation, they found instead the pleasure of good friends gathered together. Hu told them about his experiences in Huzhou and Liu Bucai's amusing exploits. You simply found the stories entertaining; Gu saw a further significance. “This Mr Liu is a rare talent. Could he be brought to Shanghai?” “Certainly. Have you a use for him?” “Yes. He would make an excellent professional companion to guests. This ten-mile foreign settlement is full of extraordinary sights; it takes just such a man to find his way about. I'd like him to do nothing but entertain our visitors. Sons of great families, pampered young gentlemen and influential officials all like to see something of the foreign settlement. If someone can keep them amused, everything becomes easier to discuss.” His view was close to Hu's own. Hu readily agreed and decided to write for Liu the following day.

接下来又是大谈生意，古应春的主意很多，从开戏馆到买地皮，无不讲得头头是道。但所有的生意，都寄托在上海一定会繁荣这个基础上，而要上海繁荣，首先要设法使上海安定。夷场虽不受战火的影响，但有小刀会占领县城，总是肘腋之患。同时江苏官方跟洋人在暗中较劲，阻隔商贩，夷场的市面，也要大受影响。这样联想下来，胡雪岩便有了一个新的看法。“老古，”他说，“我看我那票丝，还是趁早脱手的好。”“怎么？”古应春很注意地问：“你是怎么想了想？”“我在想，禁止丝茶运到上海，这件事不会太长久的。搞下去两败俱伤，洋人固然受窘，上海的市面也要萧条。我们的做法，应该在从中转圜，把彼此不睦的原因拿掉，叫官场相信洋人，洋人相信官场，这样子才能把上海弄热闹起来。那时开戏馆也好，买地皮也好，无往不利，你们说，我这话对不对？”

They went on to talk business at length. Gu had ideas for everything from opening a theatre to buying land, and explained them all persuasively. Yet every venture rested on Shanghai's future prosperity, and prosperity first required stability. Though the foreign settlement escaped the fighting, the Small Swords Society's occupation of the county town remained a danger close at hand. Meanwhile, the Jiangsu authorities were quietly contending with the foreigners and obstructing traders, which would seriously damage the settlement's market. Following this train of thought, Hu reached a new conclusion. “Old Gu, I think I'd better sell that consignment of silk soon.” “Why?” Gu asked attentively. “What's led you to that view?” “The ban on sending silk and tea to Shanghai cannot last long. If it continues, both sides will suffer. The foreigners will be in difficulty, certainly, but Shanghai's trade will also decline. We ought to mediate and remove the causes of their hostility, so that officials trust the foreigners and foreigners trust the officials. Only then can Shanghai flourish. At that point, whether we open a theatre or buy land, everything will prosper. Am I right?”

古尤二人，都深深点头，“小爷叔，”古应春不胜倾服地说，“你看得深了！做大生意就要这样。帮官场的忙，就等于帮自己的忙。现在督、扰两衙门，都恨英国人接济刘丽川。这件事有点弄僵了，仿佛斗气的样子，其实两方面都在懊悔，拿中国官场来说，如果真的断了洋商的生路，起码关税就要少收。所以禁制之举，也实在叫万不得已。如果从中有人出来调停，就此言归于好，不是办不到的事。不过说来说去是一介商人，洋人那里是很看得起商人的，一定说得上话，就是我们自己官场里，这条线不知怎么样搭法？”“有条路子，我看可以试试。”尤五慢吞吞的说道：“何学台那里！”“对，对！”古应春说，“这条路子好！何学台虽然管的是考秀才，也常常上奏折讲江苏军务的，我看能见他一面，一定有些好处。”

Gu and You nodded gravely. “Little Uncle, you've seen further,” Gu said with deep admiration. “That is how to do great business. Helping the authorities is helping ourselves. At present, both the governor-general's and the governor's yamens resent the British for supplying Liu Lichuan. They've reached something of a deadlock, almost a contest of temper. In fact, both sides regret it. The Chinese authorities, for instance, would at least lose customs revenue if they really cut off the foreign merchants' livelihood. The restrictions are a last resort. If someone mediated, a reconciliation would by no means be impossible. But when all is said and done, we're merely merchants. Foreigners respect merchants, so we can certainly make ourselves heard there. The difficulty is how to make contact with our own officials.” You spoke slowly. “There's one avenue we might try: Provincial Education Commissioner He.” “Exactly!” Gu agreed. “An excellent avenue. Though his work concerns the licentiate examinations, he often submits memorials on military affairs in Jiangsu. A meeting with him is sure to help.”

“要见他也容易，不过请王大老爷写信引见，费些周折。”胡雪岩想了想说，“我看这样，索性你自己去一趟，当面投王大老爷的那封信，不就见着了吗？”这件事如果能做成功，古应春的声名，立刻便可大起，所以他颇有跃跃欲试之意，欣然接纳了胡雪岩的建议。只是贸贸然跑了去，空谈无益，总得先在英国领事那里作个接触，探明意向，估量有没有谈得拢的可能，才好下手。这一来，就不是三两天的事了。“这封信也是要紧的。”古应春决定多吃一趟辛苦，“我先去走一趟，认识了何学台，见机行事，一方面仍旧请小爷叔写信给王大老爷，请他出一封荐函来，备而不用。”“都随你。那封荐函上怎么说法，你索性起个稿子，我寄到湖州，请他抄一遍，盖印寄来，岂不省事？”

“Seeing him should be easy enough. But asking Prefect Wang for a letter of introduction will take some arranging.” Hu considered. “Then why don't you go yourself and deliver that letter from Prefect Wang in person? That would gain you a meeting.” If this undertaking succeeded, Gu's reputation would rise at once. Eager to try, he gladly accepted the suggestion. Yet rushing off with nothing but empty talk would serve no purpose. He must first contact the British consul, ascertain his intentions and judge whether agreement was possible. Only then could he act. This meant the matter would take more than two or three days. “The letter is urgent too,” Gu said, deciding to undertake an extra journey. “I'll go first, make Commissioner He's acquaintance and act as the opportunity offers. Meanwhile, please write to Prefect Wang for a letter recommending me, so we have it ready even if we don't need it.” “As you wish. Why not draft the recommendation yourself? I'll send it to Huzhou and ask him to copy it, affix his seal and return it. Wouldn't that save trouble?”

兴致勃勃的古应春，当时便要动笔，尤五看时过午夜，不愿误了胡雪岩的良宵、因而劝阻，说等明天再办也不迟。接着，便跟怡情老二一起伴着胡雪岩去“借干铺”。“今天实在怠慢，”古应春歉意地说，“虹影楼那顿酒扫兴之至。老七还要托我请你捧场，真正不识相。”“那也无所谓。”胡雪岩说，“反正花几个钱的事。我也要有个地方好约朋友去坐，就做了那个清倌人吧！”“算了，小爷叔！”尤五说道，“我劝你象我这样子也蛮好。”这句话古应春不甚明白，胡雪岩却懂，如果对阿巧姐中意，不妨也借一处小房子。湖州立了个门户已经在打饥荒了，何苦再惹一处麻烦？不过当着怡情老二，不便明言拒绝，只好敷衍着说：“再看吧！”

Full of enthusiasm, Gu was ready to take up his brush at once. You saw that it was past midnight and did not wish to spoil Hu's pleasant night. He stopped Gu, saying tomorrow would be soon enough. Then he and Second Miss accompanied Hu to his borrowed bed. “We've really neglected you today,” Gu said apologetically. “That dinner at Hongying House was thoroughly disappointing. Seventh Miss even wanted me to ask for your patronage. She has no sense of occasion.” “It doesn't matter,” Hu replied. “It's only a matter of spending a little money. I need somewhere to meet friends as well. I might as well become that young singer's patron.” “Forget it, Little Uncle,” You said. “I'd advise you to do as I do. It works very well.” Gu did not quite understand, but Hu did. If A’qiao pleased him, he might rent a small separate house too. Establishing a household in Huzhou had already strained his funds. Why bring another burden upon himself? With Second Miss present, however, he could not refuse openly. He merely put the matter off. “We'll see.”

到了怡情院，已经灯火阑珊，只有楼上前厢房还有一台酒在闹。到了怡情老二的大房间略坐一坐，古应春首先告辞，接着是尤五道声“明朝会”，怡情老二诡秘地一笑，相偕离去。阿巧姐却始终不曾露面，一个小大姐名叫阿翠的，替胡雪岩铺衾安枕，接着端了热水来，服侍他洗脚。杂事已毕，掩上房门，管自己走了。胡雪岩有些心神不安，不知怡情老二是怎么一个安排？只凝神静听房门外面，脚步声倒有，都是由远而近再由近而远，不曾见有人推门进来，而自鸣钟已经打了数下，自笑是“痴汉等老婆”，懒洋洋地上了床。这一天相当累，心里有事，眼皮却酸涩得很，蒙蒙胧胧地睡了去。也不知过了多少时候，突然发觉被中伸进一口冰冷的手来，“啊！地一声，不等他开口，又有一只冰冷的手，掩在他嘴上。胡雪岩会意，身子往里面一缩，腾出地方来容纳阿巧姐。她钻进被窝，牙齿冻得“格格”发抖，同时一把抱往了他，前胸紧贴着他的后背，意在取暖。“怎么冻得这样子？”胡雪岩转过脸悄悄问说。“前厢房断命客人，到三点钟才走。”阿巧姐说，“今天轮着我值夜，风又在，冻得我来！”说着吸了口气，把他抱得更紧了。胡雪岩好生怜惜，翻个身伸手把被掖一掖，阿巧索性把头钻在他胸前，他的一双手自然也就不老实了。

By the time they reached Yiqing House, most of the lights had dimmed. Only a drinking party in the front room upstairs was still making a noise. They sat briefly in Second Miss's large room. Gu Yingchun left first; then You Laowu said, “See you tomorrow.” Second Miss gave a mysterious smile and went away with him. A’qiao had not appeared at all. A young maid called A’cui arranged Hu's bedding, brought hot water, and helped him wash his feet. Her work finished, she shut the door and went off. Hu felt uneasy, wondering what Second Miss had arranged. He listened intently outside. There were footsteps, approaching and receding, but nobody opened the door. The striking clock had sounded several times. Laughing at himself as a fool waiting for a wife, he climbed languidly into bed. The day had been tiring. Though his mind was occupied, his eyelids ached, and he drifted into sleep. He did not know how much later it was when an icy hand suddenly entered the bedding. Before his startled exclamation could become a word, another cold hand covered his mouth. Understanding, he moved farther into the bed to make room for A’qiao. She slipped under the quilt, her teeth chattering, and clasped him, pressing her chest against his back for warmth. “How did you get so cold?” he whispered, turning his head. “Those wretched guests in the front room didn't leave until three. It was my turn on night duty, and the wind was fierce. I'm frozen!” She drew a breath and held him tighter. Filled with tenderness, Hu turned over and tucked the quilt around her. She buried her head against his chest, and his hands naturally began to wander.

一面膜索着，他一面问：“阿巧，你今年几岁？”“猜猜看呢？”“二十三。”胡雪岩说，“至多二十四。”“二十四是要来生了。”“那么多少呢？”“我属羊的。”“属羊？”胡雪岩在多底拿起阿巧姐的纤纤五指，扳数着说，“今年咸丰四年甲寅，道光二十七年丁未，十五年乙未，正好二十岁。”“越算越好了！”阿巧姐当然知道他是有意这样算法，但心里总是高兴的。“阿巧，”胡雪岩做了反面文章，又做正面，“你真正看不出三十二岁。”“大家都说胡老爷一双眼睛厉害，会看不出？”“真的看不出！”胡雪岩问道：“象你这样的人才，为啥不自己铺房间，要帮人家？”“吃这碗饭，三十二岁就是老太婆了！人老珠黄不值钱，啥人要？”“我要，”胡雪岩不假思索的回答。阿巧姐见多识广，当然不会拿他的话当真，接口答道：“既然有人要，我还要铺啥房间？”“这话倒也不错。”胡雪岩又问：“你家里有些什么人？”问到这话，近乎多余，而偏偏客人常喜欢问这句话，阿巧姐都腻烦回答了，“问它作啥！”她说，“总不见得是千金小姐出身。”言语简峭，胡雪岩又多一层好感，不由得想起了尤五的话，认真地开始考虑。

As he caressed her, he asked, “A’qiao, how old are you?” “Guess.” “Twenty-three. Twenty-four at most.” “I'll have to wait for another life to be twenty-four.” “How old, then?” “I was born in the Year of the Goat.” “The Goat?” Taking her slender fingers beneath the quilt, he counted on them. “This is the fourth year of Xianfeng, jiayin. The twenty-seventh of Daoguang was dingwei, and the fifteenth was yiwei. That makes you exactly twenty.” “Your reckoning gets better and better!” She knew he was doing it deliberately, but it pleased her all the same. Having taken the playful approach, Hu now spoke seriously. “You really don't look thirty-two.” “Everyone says Master Hu has such sharp eyes. Could you really fail to see?” “I truly couldn't. A woman of your qualities—why don't you set up a room of your own instead of working for someone else?” “In this trade, thirty-two makes you an old woman. Old age and faded looks are worth nothing. Who would want me?” “I would,” Hu answered without thinking. A’qiao had seen too much of the world to take that seriously. “If someone wants me, why would I need to set up my own room?” “True enough. Who is there in your family?” It was an unnecessary question, yet one customers often asked. She was tired of answering. “What do you want to know that for? I can hardly have been brought up as a young heiress.” Her crisp reply increased his liking for her. Remembering You's suggestion, he began to consider it seriously.

此时此地，忽然既不动口，又不动手，那是大为反常的事，阿巧狙不由得有些奇怪，伸一只手去摸在他的胸前，左一按，右一按，这使得胡雪岩也奇怪了。“做什么？”“看看可能摸得出你的心事？”“心事怎么摸得出？只能猜。你倒猜猜我的心事看。”“我不用猜，我摸得出。”阿巧姐说，“你不喜欢我。”“奇了！哪有这话？你倒讲个道理给我听听。”“你喜欢我就会心跳。现在心一点不跳，是‘当伊煞介事’。”“妙！”胡雪岩笑道，“还有这么一套说法？不晓得你这样子摸过几个男人？”这句话说得失于检点，阿巧姐恼怒伤心，兼而有之，慢慢抽开手，背脸向外。胡雪岩这才发觉，说了句极无趣的话，深为失悔，扳她身子不动，仰头去看，梳妆台上一只洋灯的残焰映照，阿巧姐两粒泪珠，晶莹可见。“生气了是不是？”胡雪岩尴尬地说，“说说笑话，何苦当真！”说着，拿手指替她拭去眼泪，顺势就亲着她的脸。阿巧姐不作声，但也没有再作何不快的表示，她只是尽力为自己譬解，敷衍怡情老二和尤五的面子，好歹应付了这一夜。胡雪岩却是由于这个言语上的波折，失去了兴趣，同时也累得懒于说话，一合上眼，便觉双目酸涩，真的借了一夜“干铺”。

At such a time and in such a place, suddenly to cease both talking and touching was decidedly unusual. Puzzled, A’qiao put a hand on his chest, pressing here and there until he too was puzzled. “What are you doing?” “Seeing whether I can feel what's on your mind.” “You can't feel a thought. You can only guess it. Go on, guess mine.” “I needn't guess. I can feel it. You don't like me.” “How extraordinary! What makes you say that? Give me a reason.” “If you liked me, your heart would beat faster. It isn't stirring at all. You're merely going through the motions.” “Wonderful!” Hu laughed. “What a theory! I wonder how many men's chests you've tested like that.” It was a thoughtless remark. Hurt and angry, she slowly withdrew her hand and turned her face away. Only then did Hu realise how unpleasantly he had spoken. He regretted it deeply. When he tried to turn her towards him, she would not move. He raised his head. By the dying flame of the foreign lamp on the dressing table, he could see two shining tears. “You're angry, aren't you?” he said awkwardly. “It was a joke. Why take it seriously?” He wiped her tears with his fingers and kissed her face. She said nothing, but showed no further displeasure. She merely did her best to reason herself out of her distress and, for Second Miss's and You's sake, get through the night somehow. The awkward exchange had dampened Hu's interest too. He was tired and disinclined to talk. As soon as he closed his eyes, they ached with fatigue. In the end, he really did spend the night in a “dry bed.”

到第二天一觉醒来，时已近午，侧身一望，阿巧姐自然不在，枕边却遗下一根长长的头发，拈到手里，想起宵来的光景，倒有无端的怅惆，同时也觉得有些歉疚，心想阿巧姐一定很不高兴，并且也辜负了尤五和怡情老二玉成的美意。这样转着念头，便打算要跟阿巧姐先谈一谈，披衣起床，咳嗽一声，房门随即“呀”地推开，进来的正是阿巧姐，梳一个极光极亮的头，脸却是不施脂粉的清水脸，新象牙似的皮肤，淡红的嘴唇，颊上有几点茶叶未似的雀斑，徐娘丰韵，别有动人之处。“起来了！”她说，眼睛一瞟，撮两个手指放在嘴唇，示意禁声。看她这个姿态，明雪岩自然什么话都不敢说，而实在有些困惑，不知道要顾忌的是哪些话？“夜里的事，不要漏出来！”原来如此！胡雪岩不知是不是因为她来相伴，不合于“长三”。的规矩，所以有所忌讳。只觉得这样子倒有偷情的趣味，越发觉得昨夜的机会可惜。

When he awoke, it was nearly noon. Turning over, he found A’qiao gone, as he had expected, but a long hair remained beside the pillow. He picked it up. The memory of the night brought an unaccountable wistfulness and a sense of guilt. She must be very unhappy; he had also disappointed You and Second Miss in their kindly attempt to bring them together. He decided to speak to her first. Putting on his clothes, he rose and coughed. The door immediately creaked open, and A’qiao herself entered. Her hair was dressed smooth and glossy, but her face was bare of powder or rouge. With skin like new ivory, pale red lips, and a few freckles like specks of tea on her cheeks, she had the distinctive charm of a mature woman. “You're up.” She glanced at him, then put two fingers to her lips to enjoin silence. He dared say nothing, though he was puzzled about which words required caution. “Don't let last night's business slip out.” So that was it! He wondered whether her coming to him had broken some rule of the changsan establishment. In any case, the secrecy gave the affair the flavour of a clandestine romance and made him regret the lost opportunity all the more.

要再找这样一个机会也不难。等小大姐打了脸水进来，阿巧姐理好了床，来替他打辫子时，胡雪岩便说：“今天晚上我仍旧要借干铺。”“随便你。”阿巧姐淡淡地应声。“还跟昨天一样。”“啥个一样？”他不知她是真不明白，还是有意装傻？想了想笑道，“来摸摸我的心跳不跳？”阿巧姐不响，把眼垂了下去，似乎专心一致在他那条辫子上。“还在生我的气？”“哪有这话？我们什么人，敢生贵客的气？”阿巧姐正色说道：“胡老爷，你千万不能说这话，传到二小姐耳朵里，一定会说我。”“不会，不会！”胡雪岩灵机一动，“你能不能请一天假？”“为啥？”“我带你到一个地方去玩。”停了一会，见她不作声，便知不是不能请假的，因而又加了一句：“我来跟老二说，放你一天假。”“不！”阿巧姐说，“我自己跟二小姐讲。不过，胡老爷，你要带我到啥地方去玩？”“玩就是玩。看戏，吃大菜，再到外国洋行看看，有什么新样子的首饰？”这一说，阿巧姐不由得露了笑容，昨夜那一言之夫所引起的不愉快，至此才算消除。“胡老爷！”小大姐走了来说：“尤五少说，请胡老爷到小房子去吃中饭。”“好。我就去。”胡雪岩暗示阿巧姐说，“我吃完饭就要走了。”

Another opportunity would not be hard to arrange. Once the maid had brought washing water and A’qiao had straightened the bed and begun to braid his queue, Hu said, “Tonight I shall borrow a dry bed again.” “As you please,” she replied indifferently. “Just like last night.” “What is to be the same?” Was she genuinely puzzled or pretending not to understand? After a moment, he smiled. “Come and feel whether my heart is beating.” She lowered her eyes without answering, apparently intent on his braid. “Still angry with me?” “How could you say that? What are we, to dare be angry with distinguished guests?” She spoke seriously. “Mr Hu, you must never say that. If Second Miss heard, she would blame me.” “She won't!” An idea came to him. “Could you take a day off?” “Why?” “I'd like to take you out.” When she remained silent, he concluded that leave was possible and added, “I'll ask Second Miss to give you the day.” “No. I'll ask her myself. But where would you take me?” “Just out for pleasure: a play, a Western meal, then a look at a foreign shop to see what new jewellery they have.” At that, she could not help smiling. The unhappiness caused by his thoughtless words was finally dispelled. The maid came in. “Mr Hu, Fifth Master You asks you to lunch at his little house.” “Very well. I'll go now.” Hu gave A’qiao a hint. “I'll be leaving as soon as lunch is over.”

等胡雪岩一到，只见古应春也在那里，踉尤五和怡情老二的脸上一样，都挂着愉悦的笑容，仿佛正在谈一件很有趣的事，看到胡雪岩出现，笑容更浓了，显然的，所谈的这件趣事，与他有关。“昨晚我竟蒙在鼓里。”古应春迎着他说，“这也算‘小登科’，恭喜，恭喜！”“怎么样？”尤五问了这一句，又说：“老二说，她在床上……”“瞎三话四！”怡情老二赶紧拦住，同时又给了尤五一个白眼，“胡老爷自己不知道，要你来说？”“是啊！阿巧姐好在哪里，小爷叔身历其境，最清楚不过，何用旁人告诉他？”古应春这一说，胡雪岩才完全懂得，急于求得补偿的心也更热了，然而口中却不知道该怎么说才好？唯有笑而不答。“先吃饭，还是先谈事？”古应春一面问，一面从怀里掏出两张纸来。“先谈事吧！”胡雪岩望着一窗的好太阳，兴致勃勃地问：“老古，你的马车坐了来没有？”“在弄堂口。你要到哪里去？”“难得有空，又是好天气，我想好好去逛半天。”那三个人互相望了望，仍旧是古应春开口动问：“你预备怎么逛法？我来替你安排。”“回头再说。”胡雪岩指着他手中的纸问：“这是什么？”“两通信稿子。你看吧！”一通是致王有龄的，请他出信给何桂清，介绍古应春去谒见，一通是致刘不才的，要他到上海来。胡雪岩看完，仍旧交了回去，请古应春誉正发出。

When Hu arrived, Gu was there too. He, You, and Second Miss all wore delighted smiles, as though discussing something amusing. At Hu's appearance their smiles broadened: clearly he was the subject. “I was completely in the dark last night,” Gu greeted him. “A little wedding celebration, eh? Congratulations!” “How was it?” You asked. “Second Miss says that in bed she...” “Nonsense!” Second Miss hurriedly stopped him and gave him a sidelong glare. “Doesn't Mr Hu know for himself? Must you tell him?” “Exactly,” Gu said. “Little Uncle has experienced A’qiao's merits first-hand. Who could know better? He hardly needs anyone else to explain.” Only now did Hu fully understand, and his desire to make up for the lost opportunity grew stronger. Yet he did not know what to say. He could only smile. “Shall we eat first or discuss business?” Gu drew two sheets of paper from his clothes. “Business first.” Looking at the sunshine filling the window, Hu asked eagerly, “Did you bring your carriage, Old Gu?” “It's at the lane entrance. Where do you want to go?” “Such good weather, and a rare free afternoon! I'd like a proper outing.” The three exchanged glances. Gu spoke again. “What have you in mind? I'll arrange it.” “We can discuss that later.” Hu pointed to the papers. “What are those?” “Two draft letters. Read them.” One asked Wang Youling to write to He Guiqing, introducing Gu and securing him an audience; the other summoned Liu Bucai to Shanghai. Hu read them and handed them back, asking Gu to make fair copies and send them.

要谈的事，就是这些。开出饭来，正在喝酒，阿巧姐到了，大大方方的一招手，最后向怡情老二抛了个眼色，两人走到后房会谈心。“真不错！”古应春望着阿巧姐的苗条背影说，“是扬州‘瘦马’的样子。““什么‘瘦马’？活马！”尤五笑道：“小爷叔，你怎么谢媒？”“谢你，还是谢老二？”“我当差应该，自然是谢老二。”“那容易。回头我要到洋行里去，挑点首饰，老二一起去好了，她喜欢什么，我就买什么送她。”“说说笑话的，何用你如此破费？不过，”尤五向后房望了一眼，放低了声音说：“你买首饰给哪个？阿巧是厉害角色，你不要做‘洋盘’！”“如果她是厉害角色，就不会当我洋盘。”“对！”古应春击节称赏，“小爷叔这句话，真是一针见血，深极了。”“也好！”尤五笑着对胡雪岩说，“你也难得做一回洋盘，就带着她去好了。老二就不必了。”“一起去，一起去！”胡雪岩说。“打搅老二的地方很多，我本来想送她点东西，表示表示我的意思。”“回来再说吧！”尤五不置可否。

That completed their business. Lunch was served. While they were drinking, A’qiao arrived, greeted them with an easy gesture, and finally gave Second Miss a glance. The two went into a back room to talk privately. “Very fine indeed!” Gu said, watching A’qiao's slender retreating figure. “She has the look of one of Yangzhou's ‘slender horses.’” “Slender horse? A lively horse!” You laughed. “Little Uncle, how will you thank your matchmaker?” “You, or Second Miss?” “It's my duty to serve. Second Miss, naturally.” “Easy enough. I'm going to the foreign shop to choose jewellery. She should come too. Whatever she likes, I'll buy her.” “We were joking. Why put you to such expense? Still...” You glanced towards the back room and lowered his voice. “Whom are you buying jewellery for? A’qiao is a shrewd one. Don't let yourself be taken for a gullible customer.” “If she's truly shrewd, she won't take me for one.” “Exactly!” Gu applauded. “That goes straight to the heart of it. Very profound!” “Very well,” You laughed. “It's rare enough for you to play the gullible customer. Take her along. Second Miss needn't go.” “Let her come too! I've troubled her often enough. I already meant to give her something as a token of appreciation.” “We'll see later,” You said, committing himself neither way.

于是喝着酒谈些夷场趣事。不久，看见怡情老二和阿巧姐一前一后走了出来，一个是春风满面，一个是故作矜持，反正神色之间，都显得不平常。“都坐下来吃吧！”怡情老二坐下来当女主人，阿巧则无论如何不肯，说“没有这个规矩”，侍立在旁，递菜热酒，三个男的主客，视线都断断续续地跟着她转，倒把她看得不好意思了。“二小姐！”她说，“没有事情我就转去了。”“不要走，不要走！”尤五首先就喊。“让她走吧！”怡情老二向尤五抛过去一个眼色。等阿巧姐走了，才便于说话，她说，阿巧姐把昨夜的事都告诉她了。阿巧姐不知道胡雪岩是打的什么主意？如果真的喜欢她，她愿意陪着一起玩，倘或以为是尤五和怡情老二的面子，不能不对她敷衍敷衍，那就大可不必了。

They drank and discussed amusing incidents in the foreign settlement. Before long, Second Miss and A’qiao emerged, one beaming, the other affecting reserve, both looking noticeably different. “Sit down and eat.” Second Miss took her place as hostess, but A’qiao refused. “It isn't the rule.” She stood beside them, passing dishes and warming wine. The three men's eyes kept following her until she grew embarrassed. “Second Miss, if there's nothing else, I'll go back.” “Don't go!” You called first. “Let her,” Second Miss said, signalling to him with a glance. Only once A’qiao had gone could she speak freely. A’qiao had told her what happened the night before. She could not understand Hu's intentions. If he really liked her, she was willing to keep him company. But if he merely felt obliged, for You's and Second Miss's sake, to be agreeable to her, there was no need.

“人在这里”，尤五指着胡雪岩对怡情老二说，“你自己问他。”“胡老爷，”怡情老二笑嘻嘻地问道：“昨天夜里是怎么想了想，不愿意理她了？”“我没有什么不愿意，我是怕她不愿，心想不必勉强。”“怎么？”尤五大为诧异，“昨夜你没有理她？真的是‘干铺’？”胡雪岩点点头说：“这也是常事！”“叫我就煞不住车。”尤五看一看怡情老二说，“我是怕她‘三礼拜、六点钟’，不然我早就动脑筋了。”“你不要扯到我身上！”怡情老二讥嘲地说：“你动得上脑筋，尽管去动。阿巧姐眼界高得很，不见得看得上你，现在有胡老爷一比，你更加‘鼻头上挂盐鱼——嗅鲞’！”她这样一说，古应春和尤五都笑了，胡雪岩却有点不明白，“什么叫‘三礼拜、六点钟’？”他问。“这是夷场上兴出来的一句俗话，”古应春为他解释， “三礼拜‘廿一日’，六点钟‘酉’正，合起来是个什么字？你自己去想。”“原来是说老二会吃醋！”胡雪岩说：“老二不是那种人，再说，尤五哥也不会让老二吃醋，不然，我们在旁边的人也不服。”由这两句话，怡情老二对胡雪岩更有好感，决心要促成他与阿巧姐的姻缘，便趁尤五和古应春谈他们都相识的一个熟人，谈得起劲时，招招手把胡雪岩找到一边，探问他的意思。

“The man is here,” You said, pointing at Hu. “Ask him yourself.” “Mr Hu,” Second Miss asked smilingly, “what made you change your mind last night and leave her alone?” “I had no objection. I was afraid she did. I thought there was no need to force things.” You was astonished. “What? You left her alone? It really was a dry bed?” Hu nodded. “These things happen.” “I couldn't have put on the brakes.” You glanced at Second Miss. “If I weren't afraid of her ‘three weeks, six o'clock,’ I'd have made my plans long ago.” “Don't drag me into it!” she retorted. “Make all the plans you like, if you've a chance. A’qiao sets her sights high. She might not fancy you. Now she has Mr Hu to compare you with, you're like a man with salted fish hanging under his nose—sniff away, but forget your hopes!” Gu and You laughed, but Hu was puzzled. “What's ‘three weeks, six o'clock’?” “A new saying in the settlement,” Gu explained. “Three weeks give twenty-one days; six in the evening is the middle of the you hour. Combine the written components for ‘twenty-one days’ with the character for you, and what character do you get? Think it out.” “Vinegar! You mean Second Miss gets jealous. She isn't that sort of woman. Besides, Brother You wouldn't give her cause. The rest of us would object if he did.” Those two remarks made Second Miss like Hu still more. Determined to bring him and A’qiao together, she waited until You and Gu were absorbed in talking about a mutual acquaintance, then beckoned Hu aside to ask his intentions.

“胡老爷，你是预备长局，还是短局？”“长局如何，短局又如何？”“短局呢？我另外用人，你借一处小房子，或者就在楼下，那家房客就要搬了，大家住在一起热闹些。长局呢？事情比较麻烦，阿巧姐是有男人的，在木渎种田，不过也不要紧，包在我身上，花个二三百两银子：就可了结。阿巧姐身上没有什么亏空，胡老爷，“怡情老二很热心的说，”这件事，只要胡太太那里没有麻烦，你大可做得。“胡雪岩一时无从回答，事情倒是好事，但窒碍甚多，必须好好打算，但直说了怕扫了怡情老二的兴，所以考虑了好半天这样答道：“长也好，短也好，总要成局。你的好意，我十分领情，哪一天空了，我们好好谈一谈。眼前请你放在心里好了。”“我晓得。”怡情老二连连点头，“这件事本来也是急不得的。不过，胡老爷，我还有句话。你不要多花冤枉钱。”这话与尤五的忠告，如出一辙，可见得大家都拿他当自己人看待，这一点是胡雪岩最感到安慰的。

“Mr Hu, are you thinking of a permanent arrangement or a temporary one?” “What would each involve?” “For a temporary one, I'd employ someone else. You could rent a little house—or the rooms downstairs. The present tenant is leaving, and we'd have company living together. A permanent arrangement would be more troublesome. A’qiao has a husband, farming in Mudu. Still, that needn't matter. Leave it to me. Two or three hundred taels would settle it. She has no substantial debts. So long as Mrs Hu raises no difficulty, you could quite well do it.” Hu could not answer at once. It was an attractive prospect, but there were many obstacles, and he must think carefully. To say so plainly might dampen Second Miss's enthusiasm. After long consideration, he replied, “Permanent or temporary, I certainly want an arrangement. I deeply appreciate your kindness. When there's time, we must discuss it properly. For now, please keep it in mind.” “I understand.” She nodded repeatedly. “It can't be hurried. But one more thing, Mr Hu: don't spend money needlessly.” Her advice matched You's exactly. Clearly, they all regarded him as one of themselves. Nothing pleased Hu more.

因此，他的兴致越发好了，“今天的天气实在不坏。”他怂恿着怡情老二说，“一起出去兜兜风，痛痛快快玩它半天。”“到哪里去呢？总要想好一个地方。”这时他们说话的声音响了，古应春已经听到，便插嘴提议：“到龙华去看桃花如何？”“龙华？”胡雪岩对上海还不熟，便即问道：“那里地方安静不安静？”“怎么不安静？离着县城还有十八里路呢！再说，有五哥在，怕什么。”“好吧！”尤五接口，“你们有兴，我就保驾。”这一说，大家的兴致都提了起来，古应春亲自到弄堂口去雇好马车，怡情老二则派人去找阿巧姐来，就在她那里梳妆换衣服，都是素雅的淡妆，但天然丰韵，已是出人头地，胡雪岩颇为得意。

His spirits rose still further. “The weather really is fine. Come out for a drive and enjoy half a day properly.” “Where? We must choose somewhere first.” Their voices had grown louder, and Gu heard them. “How about Longhua, to see the peach blossoms?” Hu did not yet know Shanghai well. “Longhua? Is it peaceful there?” “Why wouldn't it be? It's eighteen li from the county town. Besides, with Brother Five along, what is there to fear?” “Very well,” You said. “If you're all keen, I'll be your escort.” Everyone's enthusiasm mounted. Gu went himself to the lane entrance to hire a carriage, while Second Miss sent for A’qiao to dress and change clothes at her rooms. Both women dressed with simple elegance, but their natural grace already set them above the crowd. Hu felt well pleased.

马车一共是两部，古应春自己的那部亨斯美，载了胡雪岩和阿巧姐，出了弄堂，向南疾驰，经斜桥、高昌庙，一条官道，相当宽广。这个天气，都愿郊游，一路轿马纷纷，极其热闹，但象这两部马车，敞着篷，俪影双双，招摇而过的，却不多见，因此轮声鞭影中，不断有人指指点点。阿巧姐视而不见，只是稳稳地坐着，不轻言笑，怎么也看不出风尘气息。等望见了龙华寺的塔影，同时也望见了一道长桥。这道桥也是上海的一胜，称为百步桥，长二十四丈，阔二丈有余，马蹄得得，轮声辘辘，过了百步桥不远，便是龙华寺。这座古刹，以一座七级浮屠著名，是上海唯一的古塔。马车就在塔前停下，怡情老二和阿巧姐先忙着请香烛烧香。胡雪岩想起在湖州与芙蓉初见，也是在佛像之前，当时还求了一张签，“江上采芙蓉”成为姻缘前定的佳签，此时也不妨如法炮制一番。不过，自己不必再求，“阿巧姐，”他说，“你无妨求张签看。”“问啥呢？”阿巧姐想了想说，“好，我来求它一张。”于是烧了香求签，签条拿到她手里，不肯给胡雪岩看，她不识多少字，只知道这张签，是“下下”，当然不是好签，怕扫了胡雪岩的兴，所以不愿公开。怡情老二也求了一张，倒是“上上”，说得妻财子禄，无一不好，如果是妇人求得这张签，主得贵子，古应春便向尤五道贺，而实际上是拿怡情老二开玩笑。就这样说笑着，闲步桃林，随意浏览，五个人分做两起，古应春不知是有意，还是无意，引着尤五和怡情老二，越走越远，留下胡雪岩和阿巧姐在后面，正好谈话。

There were two carriages. Gu's own hansom carried Hu and A’qiao. Leaving the lane, they sped south, past Xieqiao and Gaochang Temple along a broad public road. The fine weather had brought everyone into the countryside, and the route was busy with chairs and horses. But two open carriages displaying their couples so conspicuously were an unusual sight. Amid rattling wheels and flashing whips, people continually pointed and commented. A’qiao appeared not to notice. Sitting steadily, with no ready chatter or laughter, she showed nothing of the woman of the pleasure quarters. When Longhua Temple's pagoda came into view, so did a long bridge. This too was a Shanghai landmark: Hundred-Pace Bridge, twenty-four zhang long and over two wide. Hooves clattered and wheels rumbled across it. The temple lay a short distance beyond. The ancient monastery was famous for its seven-storey pagoda, Shanghai's only old tower. The carriages stopped before it, and the women first bought incense and candles to make their offerings. Hu remembered meeting Furong before a Buddha image in Huzhou. The fortune he had drawn then, “Gathering lotus blooms upon the river,” had become an auspicious sign of their destined union. Why not do the same here? He need not draw one himself this time. “Sister A’qiao, why don't you try a fortune?” “What should I ask?” She considered. “Very well, I'll draw one.” After burning incense, she drew a slip but refused to show Hu. She knew few written characters, yet could recognise its rating: “lowest of the low.” It was plainly unlucky. Afraid of spoiling his pleasure, she kept it to herself. Second Miss drew one too, rated “highest of the high”: wife, wealth, children, and official advancement were all favourable. For a woman, it predicted a distinguished son. Gu congratulated You, really teasing Second Miss. Talking and laughing, they strolled among the peach trees. The five divided into two groups. Whether deliberately or by chance, Gu led You and Second Miss farther and farther ahead, leaving Hu and A’qiao free to talk.

“累了吧！”胡雪岩看她双足纤纤，不免怜惜，便指着一处茶座说：“喝碗茶再走！”白布棚子下的茶座，几乎都是官客，有一两桌有女眷，也是坐在僻隐之处，而且背朝着外，不肯以面目示人。阿巧姐却无此顾忌，拣了张干净桌子坐下来，正在通道旁边，人来人往，无不注以一瞥，也有已走过去了，又借故回头，好再看一眼的。而阿巧姐是视如不见，等茶博士拿了茶来要斟时，她赶紫摇手阻止：“谢谢你，我们自己来。”茶博士住了手，阿巧姐才用茶涮了茶碗，抽出一条来路货的雪白麻纱手绢，将杯口里外擦净，然后斟得八分满，双手捧到胡雪岩面前，到她自己喝时，也是这样一丝不苟，极讲究洁净。“我在想，人生在世，实在奇妙难测。我敢说，没有一个人，今天能晓得明天的事。”胡雪岩对景生情，发了这么一段感慨，阿巧姐目然莫名其妙，一双俏伶伶的眼睛看着他不断眨动，示意他说下去。“譬如昨天，我做梦也想不到今天会在龙华看桃花，更想不到会跟你在一起。”“我算啥！”阿巧姐说，“名字生得不好，说破了不值钱，不会有啥‘巧’事落到我头上。这段话令人有突兀之感，胡雪岩细辨了辨，觉得意味深长，可能也是在试探，便先不追究，只问：“你是七月初七生的？”

“Tired?” The sight of her delicate little feet stirred Hu's tenderness. He pointed towards some tea tables. “Let's have tea before going on.” Beneath the white cloth awning, almost all the customers were men. At the one or two tables with women, the women sat out of the way, their backs turned towards the public, unwilling to display their faces. A’qiao had no such scruples. She chose a clean table beside the passage. Everyone passing glanced at her; some who had gone by found an excuse to turn back for a second look. She took no apparent notice. When the waiter brought the tea and was about to pour, she stopped him. “Thank you. We'll do it ourselves.” Once he withdrew his hand, she rinsed the cups with tea, took out a spotless imported linen handkerchief, and wiped the rims inside and out. She filled one cup four-fifths full and offered it to Hu with both hands. She showed the same scrupulous care for cleanliness with her own. “Life is truly strange and unpredictable,” Hu said, moved by the scene. “I'll wager nobody today can know what tomorrow will bring.” Naturally, she could not make out his meaning. Her bright eyes blinked at him, inviting him to continue. “Yesterday, for instance, I never dreamed that today I'd be admiring peach blossoms at Longhua—still less with you.” “What am I?” she replied. “My name is ill chosen. Once it's explained, there's nothing much to it. No happy coincidence is likely to come my way.” The remark seemed abrupt. Considering it, Hu detected deeper meaning, perhaps even a test. He did not pursue that yet. “Were you born on the seventh day of the seventh month?”

“不然怎么叫这个名字？”“好！你的生日好记得很。今年我替你做生日。”“啊唷唷！”阿巧姐有些受宠若惊，“真正不敢当，折煞我了。”“日子过来快得很，桃花开过开荷花，七月初七转眼就到。”胡雪岩问：“那时候我接你到杭州去逛西湖、看荷花，好不好？”“怎么不好！”阿巧姐双眼凝望着茶碗，口中不断在吹着茶水，茶已经不烫，可以上得口了，何需再吹？可见碍她是在想心事。当然，胡雪岩自己也知道，这话可以解释为一种暗示，有把她娶回杭州的意思，阿巧姐所想的必也是这一点。自己是无心的一句话，如果她真有此误会，未免言之过早，转念到此，微生悔意，同时也更留心她的脸色和言语了。“胡老爷这一趟有多少日子耽搁？”她问。“说不定，少则半个月，多则二十天，一定得回杭州。”“我晓得了。跟胡太太说好了来的，不能误卯。”胡雪岩笑而不答，他的笑容是经过做作的，特意要显得令人莫测高深。阿巧姐很能观察，见此光景，便不再多说，只望着悠悠的塔影，慢慢地品茗，样子十分闲适。胡雪岩看她的态度，倒有些不明究竟，心里七上八下的放不下。但转念却又自笑，自己没有应付不了的人，也很少心浮气躁过，此刻是怎么回事？这样一想，硬生生的把杂念抛开，也是抱着“偷得浮生半日闲”的心情，品茗看花，只求自适，阿巧姐看他这样，当然更不便多说什么。两个人等于都在肚子里做功夫。

“How else would I have got this name?” “Good! Your birthday is easy to remember. This year I'll celebrate it for you.” “Oh, you honour me too much! I could never deserve it.” “Time passes quickly. After peach blossoms come lotuses. The seventh day of the seventh month will soon be here. Shall I take you to Hangzhou then, to enjoy West Lake and the lotuses?” “Of course!” She gazed into her cup, continually blowing on the tea. It was already cool enough to drink. Plainly she was thinking of something else. Hu himself knew that his words could be taken as a hint that he meant to marry her and bring her to Hangzhou. That must be what she was considering. His remark had been unpremeditated. If she misunderstood it that way, he had spoken too soon. He felt a little regret and watched her expression and words more closely. “How long will you be staying this time?” she asked. “I can't say. At least half a month, twenty days at most. Then I must return to Hangzhou.” “I see. You've agreed it with Mrs Hu and mustn't miss your roll call.” He smiled without answering, deliberately making the smile inscrutable. A’qiao was observant. She said no more, but gazed towards the distant pagoda and sipped her tea with a leisurely air. Her attitude puzzled him. He felt unsettled. Then he laughed at himself inwardly. There was nobody he could not handle, and he seldom lost his composure. What was the matter with him now? He forcibly dismissed these distractions and adopted the spirit of stealing half a day of leisure from life's bustle. He drank tea and admired the blossoms, seeking only his own contentment. Seeing this, she naturally refrained from further comment. Both were, in effect, conducting their manoeuvres inwardly.

看看日色偏西，桃林中潋滟红霞，如火如荼，真叫“夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏”，再流连不走，天一黑，路上就不好了，于是仍旧照原来的样子，坐着马车，疾驰而回。胡雪岩兴犹未央，同时要“守信用”，说了带阿巧姐去挑首饰，也要送怡情老二“做媒”的谢礼，一定要做到，所以特意关照古应春，先到黄浦滩禅臣洋行。尤五记起胡雪岩的话，便特别注意阿巧姐，可是拿客人当“洋盘”？只见她初入店内，望着成排的玻璃柜和闪闪生光的珠宝首饰，颇有目迷五色之概，但很快的恢复了常态，看看古应春说道：“古大少爷，请你问问洋人，有没有男用的表链？”“男人用的？”“是呀！”阿巧姐笑着问，“怎么了？”“没有什么。我只当我没有听清楚。”于是古应春跟洋人一说，立刻便捧出一只皮盒子来，打开来一看，里面有十几副表链，金银粗细，各式俱备。阿巧姐伸出手去，一条一条挑，最后挑了一根十八开金的，链子一端坠着一只铸得很玲珑的小金羊。“这东西不错！”胡雪岩在一旁说，“再挑！”“不挑了。”阿巧姐走开两步，同时招招手把古应春邀了过去，悄悄说道：“这是我自己买的东西，千万不好叫胡老爷惠钞。请你替我付一付。”说着，手一伸，一张折得小小的银票，塞到了古应春手里。古应春明白了，这是阿巧姐买给她乡下的丈夫的，自然不便让胡雪岩出钱，便点点头说：“我知道了。”胡雪岩还在坚持着，要阿巧姐再挑一两年首饰，她只是袖手不动。又再三问怡情老二喜欢什么？她却不过情，挑了一瓶法国香水。

The sun was sinking westward. Among the peach trees, rippling crimson radiance blazed like fire: truly, “The setting sun is infinitely lovely, only evening is near.” If they lingered until dark, the journey would be less safe. They took their original places in the carriages and drove swiftly back. Hu's pleasure was not yet exhausted, and he meant to keep his word. He had promised jewellery shopping for A’qiao and a matchmaker's gift for Second Miss. He specially asked Gu to stop first at Chanchen Trading House on the Huangpu waterfront. Remembering Hu's remark, You watched A’qiao closely. Would she treat her customer as a gullible spender? On entering, she seemed dazzled by the rows of glass cases and glittering jewellery, but soon recovered. “Young Master Gu, please ask the foreigner whether they have watch chains for men.” “For men?” “Yes.” She smiled. “What's the matter?” “Nothing. I only wondered whether I'd heard correctly.” Gu spoke to the shopkeeper, who brought out a leather case containing more than a dozen chains, gold and silver, thick and thin. She examined them one by one and finally chose an eighteen-carat gold chain with a delicately cast little goat hanging from one end. “Very nice!” Hu said. “Choose something else.” “No more.” Moving a few steps away, she beckoned Gu and whispered, “I'm buying this myself. You mustn't let Mr Hu pay. Please settle it for me.” She slipped a tightly folded banknote into his hand. Gu thought he understood: the chain was for her husband in the country, so she naturally could not let Hu pay. “I understand.” Hu still insisted that she choose a piece or two of jewellery, but she kept her hands tucked in her sleeves. He repeatedly asked Second Miss what she wanted. Unable to refuse his kindness, she chose a bottle of French perfume.

“算帐吧！”胡雪岩取了一百两的银票，交给古应春。接到手里，古应春也不作声，到帐台上跟洋女人结了帐，上车回到怡情老二的小房子，古应春才把他的银票交了回去，“你还阿巧姐六块洋钱。”他说，“表链子阿巧姐自己买，不叫你惠钞。”“岂有此理。”“日子长了，何争一时？”尤五这样说，心里也有替他们作撮合的打算了。胡雪岩听得这么一说，也就一笑置之。在那里吃了饭，怡情老二拉着尤五到一边说了几句，尤五又转达给胡雪岩：阿巧姐今天既然休息，就不想回怡情院，问胡雪岩的意思如何？“那好办！”他说，“跟我走好了。”“要走就早走！不必在这里泡了。”“时候还早，”胡雪岩踌躇着说：“我们一起看戏去？”这个提议没有人接受，古应春说明天要动身到苏州去见何桂清投信，尤五表示倦了，不想出门。其实都是托同，目的是要让胡雪岩踉阿巧姐早圆好梦。

“Settle the bill.” Hu handed Gu a hundred-tael note. Gu took it without comment and paid the foreign woman at the counter. Only after they had driven back to Second Miss's little house did he return Hu's note. “You owe A’qiao six foreign silver dollars. She bought the chain herself and won't let you pay for it.” “That's absurd!” “There are many days ahead. Why dispute this moment?” You said, now intending to help bring them together himself. Hu smiled and let it pass. They dined there. Second Miss drew You aside for a few words, which he then conveyed to Hu: since A’qiao had the day off, she did not want to return to Yiqing House. What did Hu think? “Easy enough. She can come with me.” “Then go early. Don't linger here.” Hu hesitated. “It's still early. Why don't we all go to the theatre?” Nobody accepted. Gu said he was leaving for Suzhou the next day to deliver the letter to He Guiqing, and You said he was tired and did not want to go out. Both were making excuses to let Hu and A’qiao fulfil their hopes sooner.

这当然不宜在裕记丝栈双宿双飞。他由于尤五的推荐，住进一家新开的“仕宦行台”大兴客栈，是个小小的跨院，一明两暗三间房。阿巧姐认为太大了用不着，胡雪岩认为房间一定要多，会客才方便，有时客人来访，只为说一句知心话，稠人广众，大家都憋在肚子里不便说，结果高朋满座，尽是空谈，如果多一间空屋子作为退步，就方便得多了。“照这个样子说，胡老爷，你是预备长住？”“是啊！”胡雪岩说，“丝栈里诸多不便，我想在这里长住，比较舒服。”“你不是说，”阿巧姐指出他的前言不符后语，“半个月、二十天就要回杭州吗？”“ 不错！”胡雪岩很从容地答道，“去了马上要来的，房间留着也不要紧，不过多花几个房钱，有限的。”阿巧姐不作声，心里在盘算，既然如此，不妨备办一些动用什物，于是喊进茶房来，有条不紊地吩咐他去买办风炉锅碗等等，吃的、用的一大堆。胡雪岩心想，照此看来，已不用多说，至少一个“短局”已经存在了。

Naturally, they could not spend the night together at Yuji Silk Warehouse. On You's recommendation, Hu took rooms at the newly opened Daxing Inn, an establishment catering to travelling officials. He had a small side courtyard with three rooms, a central reception room and two private rooms. A’qiao thought it unnecessarily large. Hu replied that ample rooms made receiving visitors easier. Sometimes a guest came only to exchange a word in confidence. In a crowd, everyone kept such thoughts to himself, and a gathering of distinguished friends produced nothing but empty conversation. An extra room into which one could withdraw made all the difference. “Then you're planning to stay a long time, Mr Hu?” “Yes. The warehouse has many inconveniences. A longer stay here would be more comfortable.” “Didn't you say you'd return to Hangzhou in half a month or twenty days?” she asked, pointing out the contradiction. “Quite right,” he answered calmly. “But I'll soon come back. Keeping the rooms costs only a little more, not much.” She said nothing. Thinking that they might as well acquire some household necessities, she called the attendant and gave orderly instructions to buy a stove, pots, bowls, and a host of other things to eat and use. Watching, Hu thought there was no need to say more. At least a temporary arrangement was already in existence.

阿巧姐也真是“做人家”的样子，为他打开行李，将日用杂件，布置妥贴，然后铺好了床，请胡雪岩安置。等胡雪岩上床，她却不睡，将一盏洋灯移到窗前方桌上，背着身子，不知在做些什么？胡雪岩等得不耐烦，便即催问：“你怎么不来睡？我有好些话跟你说。”“来了，来了！”于是阿巧姐移灯到梳妆台前，洗脸卸妆，又检点了门窗，才披了一件夹袄，掀开帐子，跟胡雪岩并头睡下。“你晓得我刚才在做啥？”“我怎么晓得？”“你看！”她伸手从夹袄口袋中掏出一个金表交到胡雪岩手里。表是他的，却多了一条金链子，正就是她在禅臣洋行自己花钱买的那一条。“我送你的。”“你送我的？”胡雪岩大感意外，接着浮起满怀的喜悦和感动，把表链子上坠着的那只小金羊，凑近眼前，仔细观玩，才领悟她特为挑选这一条链子的深意，她是属羊的，这只玲珑的小金羊，就是她的化身，怀中相伴，片刻不离，这番深情，有如食蜜，中边皆甜。“喏！”她又塞过来一个纸包，“大概是胡太太替你打的丝绦子，好好带回去，不然胡太太问起来，设法交帐。”她猜得一点不错，原来系表的一条黑丝绦，是胡太太亲手所织，难为她想得这么周到。“这条丝绦子，龌龊是龌龊得来！”阿巧姐皱着眉说，“本来我想拿它洗洗清爽，深怕你太太会问，是哪个洗的？就露了马脚了。男人决不会想到，拿这条丝绦子洗洗干净！”心细如发，人情透切，胡雪岩对阿巧姐刮目相看了。

A’qiao truly behaved as though setting up a household. She unpacked his luggage, put the everyday articles in their places, made the bed, and invited him to retire. Once he was in bed, however, she did not join him. She moved a foreign lamp to the square table by the window and sat with her back towards him, doing something he could not see. Impatient, he called, “Why don't you come to bed? I've a great deal to say to you.” “Coming!” She moved the lamp to the dressing table, washed off her make-up, checked the doors and windows, and at last, wearing a lined jacket, lifted the bed curtains and lay beside him. “Do you know what I was doing?” “How should I?” “Look.” From her jacket pocket she took a gold watch and placed it in his hand. It was his own, now fitted with the gold chain she had bought with her own money at Chanchen Trading House. “My gift to you.” “To me?” Astonishment gave way to delight and gratitude. Bringing the little gold goat close to his eyes, he studied it and understood her purpose. Born in the Goat year, she had chosen this delicate animal as her own likeness, to remain close to him in his pocket, never parted for a moment. The tenderness was like honey, sweet from edge to centre. “Here.” She passed him a paper packet. “I expect Mrs Hu braided that silk cord for you. Take it home carefully, or you'll have no answer if she asks.” She was exactly right. His wife had made the black silk cord that had held the watch. How thoughtful of A’qiao to consider it! “It's filthy,” she said, frowning. “I thought of washing it, but your wife might ask who had done it, and then the secret would be out. A man would never think of washing his watch cord!” Her meticulous care and understanding of people made him regard her with new respect.

一手把玩着“小金羊”，一手轻抚着活的“白羊”，胡雪岩才真的领略到了温柔乡中的滋味，“阿巧，”他忽然问道：“你把我当作什么人？”这话的意思欠明确，阿巧姐只有这样答道：“好人。”“是相好的好，还是好坏的好？”“好坏的好。”“那种好人我不要做。”胡雪岩说，“我是说，你把我当作你的什么人？”这话就更难回答了，如果说是客人，则私赠表记，变作笼络客人的虚情假意，即有此意，阿巧姐也不肯承认，若说是心上人，又觉得肉麻碍口，想了想有个说法：“你是胡老爷，我自然当你老爷！”“老爷”的意思是双关，下人称男主人为老爷，妻妾称男主人亦是老爷。阿巧姐这样回答，要自己去体会，才有意味，胡雪岩当然懂，但为了逗乐，有怠误解。“你骂我‘赤佬’？”上海话称“鬼”为“赤化”，苏州人则对邪魔外道的鬼祟，如“五通神”之类，为了忌讳，有时亦称“老爷”，意义与上海话的“赤佬”相近，所以胡雪岩这样歪缠。“啥人骂你？”阿巧姐真的骂了，“你自己下作，好的人不要做，要做赤佬。”“赤佬自然不想做，老爷也不必。”胡雪岩涎着关脸道，“阿巧，我做你的‘姘头’好不好？”“要死快哉！”阿巧姐打了他一下，用道地的苏州话娇嗔着，“闲话阿要难听！”

With one hand he played with the little gold goat; with the other he gently caressed the living “white goat.” Only now did he fully appreciate the pleasures of tenderness. “A’qiao,” he asked suddenly, “what sort of man do you take me for?” The meaning was unclear. She could only answer, “A good man.” “Good as in a man you're fond of, or good as opposed to bad?” “Good as opposed to bad.” “I don't want to be that sort of good man. I mean, what am I to you?” That was harder still. To call him a customer would make her personal gift seem a calculated attempt to win favour. Even if that had been her intention, she would not admit it. To call him her beloved felt embarrassingly sentimental. After a moment, she found a way. “You're Master Hu. Naturally, I regard you as my master.” The word had two meanings: servants used it of the head of a household, and wives and concubines used it of their husband. The charm of her answer lay in leaving him to understand it himself. Of course he did, but for amusement he deliberately misunderstood. “Are you calling me a devil?” In Shanghai speech, a ghost was called chilao. In Suzhou, people sometimes respectfully called sinister spirits, such as the Five Powers, “masters” to avoid offending them. The sense was close to chilao, and Hu was twisting her words accordingly. “Who's calling you names?” Now she really scolded him. “You're the shameless one. You won't be a decent man; you insist on being a devil.” “I don't want to be a devil, and I needn't be a master.” With an ingratiating smile, he asked, “A’qiao, may I be your lover?” “You wicked thing!” She struck him lightly, scolding in broad Suzhou speech. “Must you say such improper things?”

越是如此，胡雪岩越觉得乐不可支，调笑闲话，几乎闹了一整夜。睡到第二天上午十一点，阿巧姐才起身，胡雪岩则还在呼呼大睡。也不过是她刚刚漱洗好，有人来敲门，开开一看，是尤五和古应春。“怎么？”尤五探头一望，脱口问道：“小爷叔到此刻还不起来！你们一夜在干什么？”阿巧姐脸一红，强笑道：“我是老早起来了，哪个晓得他这么好困？”古应春走了过来，摸一摸那只洋瓷脸盆，余温犹在，笑一笑说道：“对！阿巧姐老早起来了。“谎话拆穿，阿巧姐更窘，不过她到底经验丰富，不至于手足无措，依旧口中敷衍，手头张罗，把客人招待到外面坐下，然后去叫醒胡雪岩。睡眼惺松的胡雪岩，还恋着宵来的温馨，一伸手就拉住了她往怀里抱，急得阿巧姐恨恨地骂：“人家已经在笑了，你脸皮厚，我可吃不消！”“谁，谁在笑？”“尤五少、古大少都来了，坐在外头，你快起来吧！”阿巧姐又说，“说话当心些。”一面说，一面服侍他起床，胡雪岩只是回忆着昨夜的光景又发愣、又发笑、傻兮兮的样子，惹得阿巧姐更着急。“求求你好不好！越是这样，人家越会跟你开玩笑。”“怕什么！”胡雪岩说，“你不理他们就是了。”见了面还是有一番调笑，甚至可说是谑，尤五和古应春这一双未来的郎舅，象逼问犯人口供似地，要胡雪岩“招供”衾底风情。急得里屋的阿巧姐，暗地里大骂“杀千刀”！幸好胡雪岩一问三不知，只报以满脸笑容，阿巧姐总算不至于太受窘，当然，对胡雪岩这样的态度是满意的，同时也对他有了深一层的认识，嘴上尽管不听她的劝，做出事来，深可人意，是要这样的男人才靠得住。

The more she protested, the more Hu enjoyed himself. They teased and laughed almost the whole night. It was eleven the next morning before A’qiao rose; Hu still slept soundly. She had scarcely finished washing when someone knocked. Opening the door, she found You and Gu. You peered in. “What? Little Uncle still isn't up? What were you two doing all night?” Blushing, she forced a smile. “I've been up ages. Who knew he'd sleep so long?” Gu came over and touched the enamel basin, which was still warm. He smiled. “Yes, Sister A’qiao has been up ages.” Exposed, she grew more embarrassed, but she was too experienced to become flustered. Still exchanging civilities, she settled the visitors in the outer room, then went to wake Hu. Sleepy-eyed and still relishing the night's warmth, he reached out and drew her towards him. She scolded him anxiously. “They're laughing already! You may have a thick skin, but I can't bear it.” “Who? Who's laughing?” “Fifth Master You and Young Master Gu. They're outside. Get up quickly—and mind what you say.” As she helped him dress, he kept remembering the night, staring and smiling foolishly, which only increased her anxiety. “Please! The more you behave like that, the more they'll tease you.” “What is there to fear? Just ignore them.” When they met, there was indeed more teasing, almost mockery. You and Gu, the prospective brothers-in-law, questioned him like interrogators demanding a prisoner's confession, insisting he reveal what had passed beneath the quilt. In the inner room, A’qiao silently cursed the pair. Fortunately, Hu answered every question with a smile and professed to know nothing. She was spared the worst embarrassment. Naturally, she approved, and understood him a little better. He might refuse her advice in words, yet his actions were deeply considerate. That was the kind of man one could rely on.

“好了，好了！”胡雪岩终于开了口，“再说下去，有人要板面孔了。我请你们吃番菜去，算是替老古饯行。“古应春未曾应声，先看一看尤五，两人相视一笑，又微微点头，是莫逆于心的样子，倒使得胡雪岩困惑了。“你们捣什么鬼？”“不与你相干。”古应春说，“我今天不走，明天一早动身。”“怎么回事？”胡雪岩更要追问。“跟洋人还有点事要谈。”胡雪岩不甚相信，但也没有理由不相信，说过抛开，重申前请，邀他们俩去吃番菜。“阿巧姐呢？”古应春说，“一起去吧！”“谢谢！”里面高声应答，苏州话最重语气，阿巧姐的声音，峭而直，一听就知道是峻拒之意。胡雪岩微感不安，而尤、古二人却夷然不以为忤，“阿巧姐！”尤五也提高了声音说，“既然你不肯去，那么转去一趟，老二在想念你。”“要的，要的！”这一下她的声音缓和了，“我本来要转去的。”

“Enough, enough!” Hu Xueyan finally said. “Keep this up and someone will lose her temper. I'll take you out for a Western meal, as a farewell dinner for Gu.” Before answering, Gu Yingchun glanced at You. They exchanged smiles and slight nods, apparently understanding each other perfectly, which puzzled Hu. “What are you two plotting?” “Nothing to do with you,” Gu replied. “I'm not leaving today. I'll set off first thing tomorrow.” “What's happened?” Hu persisted. “I still have something to discuss with the foreigners.” Hu was not entirely convinced, but had no reason to disbelieve him. He let the matter drop and repeated his invitation. “What about Sister A’qiao?” Gu asked. “Come with us!” “Thank you!” came a loud reply from inside. Intonation mattered greatly in Suzhou speech, and the sharp, abrupt sound of her voice made the refusal unmistakable. Hu felt a little uneasy, but neither You nor Gu took offence. “Sister A’qiao!” You raised his voice too. “If you won't come, go back for a visit. Second Miss has been missing you.” “Yes, of course!” Her tone softened at once. “I meant to go back anyway.”

一面说，一面走了出来，手里捧着长袍、马褂。胡雪岩倒也会享福，只张开双手，让她替他穿好，为他一粒一粒扣纽子。然后拘出表来看了一下说：“走吧，一点钟了。”“咦！”古应春眼尖，“这条表链，怎么到了你手里？”这是胡雪岩最得意的事，向古应春使个眼色，表示回头细谈，果然，在番菜馆里，他把阿巧姐的情意，津津有味地细说了给他们两人听。“小爷叔！”尤五笑道，“你真要交鸿运了，到处都有这种艳福。”这一说，胡雪岩的脸色反严肃了，“现在我自己都不知道怎么办了？”他说，“你们倒替我出个主意看。”尤五和古应春又相视而笑，“事缀则圆！”古应春答道，“等我苏州回来再说，如何？”“你哪一天回来？”“现在还说不定，会见那些大人先生要等，光是投封信，见不着面，又何必我自己去？”“这话也不错，不过我希望你早点回来，”胡雪岩紧接着说，“倒不是为这件事，怕洋人那里有什么话，你不在这里，接不上头。”“不要紧。我托了个人在那里，尤五哥也认识的，如果洋人那里有什么话，他会来寻尤五哥，不会耽误。”

As she spoke, A’qiao came out carrying Hu's long gown and riding jacket. He certainly knew how to enjoy being waited on: he merely spread his arms and let her dress him and fasten every button. Then he took out his watch. “Let's go. It's one o'clock.” “Hello!” Sharp-eyed Gu had noticed something. “How did that watch chain come into your hands?” This was what Hu was proudest of. He gave Gu a look promising to tell him later, and at the restaurant he did indeed describe A’qiao's loving thoughtfulness to the two men in delighted detail. “Little Uncle!” You laughed. “Your good fortune is really beginning. Everywhere you go, the women favour you.” Hu's expression grew serious instead. “I don't know what to do myself now. Give me some advice.” You and Gu exchanged another smile. “Give a matter time and it will come right,” Gu replied. “Let's talk when I get back from Suzhou. How about that?” “When will you be back?” “I can't say yet. You have to wait to see those high officials. If I merely leave a letter without meeting anyone, why go myself?” “True enough. Still, I hope you'll return soon,” Hu added quickly. “Not on account of this. I'm afraid that if the foreigners have something to say while you're away, we won't be able to make contact.” “Don't worry. I've entrusted someone with that. Brother Five knows him too. If there's any word from the foreigners, he'll come to find Brother Five. Nothing will be delayed.”

话说到这里，西息已端来了“尾食”，吃罢算帐，是一桌鱼翅席的价钱，而尤五却说未曾吃饱。“番菜真没有吃头，又贵，又不好。”尤五笑道，“情愿摊头上一碟生煎馒头，还吃得落胃些。”当然，这也不过口发怨言而已，没有再去吃一顿的道理，出了番菜馆，访友的访友，办事的办事，各自分手，约定晚上在恰情院吃花酒。

By this time the waiter had brought dessert. When they finished, the bill came to the price of a whole shark's-fin banquet, yet You declared that he had not eaten enough. “There's nothing satisfying about Western food. Expensive and no good!” he said with a laugh. “I'd rather have a plate of pan-fried buns at a street stall. At least they'd sit comfortably in my stomach.” This was only a complaint, of course; there was no question of eating another meal. Outside the restaurant they parted, some to visit friends, others to attend to business, agreeing to meet that evening for a courtesan banquet at Yiqing House.

胡雪岩这两天的心有点野了，正经事虽有许多，却懒得去管，仍旧回到客栈，打算静下心来，将公私杂务，好好想它一想。等一走进屋，非常意外地，发现陈世龙在坐等。“咦！你怎么来了？啥辰光到的？”“来了不多一会。”陈世龙答道，“一下船先到裕记丝栈，说胡先生搬到这里来了，”“坐，坐！湖州怎么样？”胡雪岩问道，“到上海来作啥？”“王大老爷叫我来的。有封信在这里。”

Hu's thoughts had strayed from work these past two days. Though there was plenty of serious business to attend to, he could not be bothered with it. He went back to the inn, intending to settle his mind and think properly through his public and private affairs. The moment he entered, however, he was astonished to find Chen Shilong waiting. “Why, what brings you here? When did you arrive?” “Not long ago. I went straight from the boat to Yuji Silk Warehouse, and they told me you'd moved here.” “Sit down, sit down. How are things in Huzhou? What have you come to Shanghai for?” “Prefect Wang sent me. I have a letter here.”

拆开信一看，又是求援。为了漕米改为海运，原来粮船上的旗丁水手，既无口粮，又少人约束，所以往往聚众闹事，甚至发生抢案，黄宗汉颇为头涌。由于王有龄在筹办海运时，对这方面曾有建议，要为旗丁水手，妥筹生计，所以黄宗汉仍旧责成他设法安抚。王有龄在信中说，如果当初照他的条陈，拨出一笔费用来办理这事，比较容易收功，因循未办，如今看形势不妙，再来安抚，显得是受了此辈的威胁挟制，事倍功半，十分棘手。同时湖州的团练，正在密锣紧鼓地编练，而江浙交界的平望、泗安两处防务，又相当重要，经常耍去察看，他实在无力来顾及此事。本来想推给嵇鹤龄，再又想到，推给了嵇鹤龄，他仍旧要求助于胡雪岩，与其如此，不如直接写信乞援。希望胡雪岩能请尤五一起到浙江去一趟，以同为漕帮的情谊，设法排解。“王大老爷叫了我去，当面跟我说，他也晓得胡先生很忙，如果真的分不开身，叫我陪了尤五爷去。”“这件事有点麻烦。他们槽帮里面的事，外人不清楚。尤五跟浙江漕帮的头脑，是不是有交情，还不晓得。说不定不肯插手。”胡雪岩又说，“你郁四叔怎么说？”“请尤五爷去排解，就是郁四叔出的主意。”“喔！”胡雪岩欣慰的说，“那就不错了。走！我们到恰情院去。”

Hu opened it and found another appeal for help. Since the tribute grain had been transferred to the sea route, the transport servicemen and sailors formerly employed on the grain boats had lost their rations and were largely without supervision. They frequently gathered to make trouble, and there had even been robberies. Huang Zonghan found the situation a serious headache. During the preparations for sea transport, Wang Youling had proposed making proper arrangements for these men's livelihood, so Huang now made him responsible for finding a way to pacify them. Wang wrote that success would have been relatively easy if funds had been allocated as he originally recommended. Instead, the matter had been allowed to slide. To offer relief now that the situation looked dangerous would seem to be yielding to their threats and pressure, doubling the effort for half the result. It was a most awkward business. Meanwhile, the Huzhou militia was being organised and trained at a furious pace. The defences at Pingwang and Si’an, on the Jiangsu-Zhejiang border, were important too and required frequent inspections. He simply could not attend to this as well. At first he had thought of passing it to Ji Heling; then he realised that Ji would still have to seek Hu's help, so he might as well write directly. He hoped Hu could invite You to accompany him to Zhejiang and use the bonds of their common brotherhood to settle the trouble. “Prefect Wang summoned me and told me himself that he knew how busy you were,” Chen added. “If you really can't get away, I'm to accompany Fifth Master You.” “This could be troublesome. Outsiders don't understand the internal affairs of their brotherhood. We don't even know whether You has any connection with its leaders in Zhejiang. He may refuse to get involved.” Hu added, “What did your Uncle Four say?” “It was Uncle Four's idea to ask Fifth Master You to mediate.” “Oh!” Hu was reassured. “Then that sounds promising. Come along. Let's go to Yiqing House.”

于是一起到了怡情老二的小房子里，尤五还没有回来，胡雪岩便趁此机会，向陈世龙细问湖州的情形，知道今年因为洋庄可能不动，时世又不好，养蚕的人家不多。不过陈世龙又说了他的看法，认为这是一时的现象，如果有钱，可以放给蚕农，明年以新丝作抵，倒是一笔好生意。“有钱，好做的生意多得很，眼前还谈不到明年的事。”胡雪岩说，“你这趟回去，先打听今年的行情，湖属有多少人养蚕？大概能出多少丝？打听确实了，赶紧写信来。这什事要做得秘密，请人去办，不可省小钱。”

They went together to Second Miss's little house. You had not yet returned, and Hu used the opportunity to question Chen closely about Huzhou. He learned that comparatively few households were raising silkworms that year: the foreign buyers might not enter the market, and the times were unsettled. Chen thought this was only temporary. Anyone with money could make a good business of lending to the silkworm farmers against the following year's new silk. “With money, there are plenty of good businesses to be done. It's too soon to discuss next year,” Hu replied. “When you go back, find out about this year's market first. How many households in Huzhou Prefecture are raising silkworms? Roughly how much silk will they produce? Get reliable figures and write to me at once. This must be done discreetly. Hire people to make the inquiries. Don't try to save a few small coins.”

“是的。”陈世龙接着提起他的亲事，说岳家已经跟他谈过，日子想挑在端午节前后，问胡雪岩的意思怎么样？“那时候不正是新丝上市吗？”“我也是这么说，生意正忙的时候办喜酒，‘又是灯笼又是会’，何必夹在一起？他们说，如果不是端午前后，就要延后到秋天。”“与其延后，何不超前？”胡雪岩以家长的口吻说：“你们早点‘圆房’倒好。”“阿珠的娘不肯马虎，一定要把嫁妆办好。除非……”陈世龙说，“胡先生说一句。”“说一句还不容易，你早跟我说了，我早就开口了。这趟你回去跟他们老夫妇说，生意要紧，家也要紧，趁新丝上市以前让你办了喜事成了家，定定心在生意上巴结，岂不是两全其美？”胡雪岩又说，“今年秋天局面会变动，我的场面也要扯得更大，那时人手越嫌不够，一办喜事，忙上加忙，这把算盘打不通。”

“Yes.” Chen then mentioned his marriage. His future in-laws had spoken to him about choosing a date around the Dragon Boat Festival. What did Hu think? “Isn't that just when the new silk comes on the market?” “That's what I said. Holding a wedding when business is busiest would be like having both a lantern display and a fair at once. Why crowd everything together? They say that if it isn't around the festival, we'll have to wait until autumn.” “Why postpone it when you could bring it forward?” Hu spoke with the authority of a family elder. “You'd do better to begin married life sooner.” “A’zhu's mother won't do things carelessly. She insists on having the dowry ready first. Unless...” Chen hesitated. “Unless you put in a word.” “That's easy enough. If you'd told me sooner, I'd have spoken sooner. When you go back, tell the old couple this: business matters, but so does a home. Let you have your wedding and set up your household before the new silk reaches the market; then you can concentrate on working hard. Wouldn't that serve both purposes?” Hu went on, “Things will change this autumn. I mean to expand my operations too, and I'll be shorter of people than ever. A wedding then would add to the rush. That calculation doesn't work.”

他说一句，阿世龙应一句，也不过刚刚谈完，尤五和古应春联诀而至，跟陈世龙寒暄了一番，问起来意，陈世龙只有目视胡雪岩示意。“尤五哥，你的麻烦来了！”胡雪岩将浙江漕帮不遵约束，聚众滋事的情形，以及王有龄的要求都说给他听。“事情很麻烦！”尤五说了这一句，紧接着表示：“不过上刀山我也去。”“尤五爷真是够朋友。”陈世龙立即表现了不胜倾眼的神态。在胡雪岩，觉得他这样豪爽地答应，倒不无意外之感，想到尤五去杭州，古应春去苏州，上海剩下自己一个人，与洋人言语不通，万一有事，虽说古应春托有一个人在这里，但素昧平生，而且有些事只有古、尤二人清楚，自己还是等于孤立无助，此事十分不妥。“老古！”他当机立断他说：“上海一定要你坐镇。我跟你换一换，我到苏州去看何学台，你留在上海。”

Chen assented to every point. They had scarcely finished when You and Gu arrived together. After exchanging greetings, they asked what had brought him. Chen could only look towards Hu to explain. “Brother Five, here's trouble for you!” Hu described the Zhejiang brotherhood's refusal to submit to discipline, the gatherings that had turned into disturbances, and Wang's request. “It's a difficult business,” You said, then added immediately, “But I'd go even if I had to climb a mountain of blades.” “Fifth Master You, you're a true friend!” Chen's manner showed unbounded admiration. Hu himself was rather surprised by this ready and generous agreement. But if You went to Hangzhou and Gu to Suzhou, he would be left alone in Shanghai, unable to speak to the foreigners. True, Gu had someone here to help if anything happened, but Hu had never met the man. Besides, there were matters only Gu and You understood. In effect, he would be isolated and helpless. That would never do. He decided at once. “Gu, you must stay here to hold things together. Let's exchange places. I'll go to Suzhou to see Education Commissioner He, and you remain in Shanghai.”

这番变化将古应春和尤五的“密谋”完全推翻，说起来也是很扫兴的一件事，是尤五的提议，认为郁四他们在湖州为胡雪岩谋娶芙蓉这件事，确是够好朋友的味道，不妨如法炮制，古应春特为迟一天走，就是要等着看胡雪岩和阿巧姐的态度，如果妾有情，郎有意，古应春就预备趁去苏州之便，专诚到木渎去访阿巧姐的夫家跟娘家，拿大把银子来为他们结成连理。刚才他们就是从怡情院来，据怡情老二说，阿巧姐不但已经点头答应，而且还提供了许多情况，指出着手进行的办法，“火到猪头烂”，最多花上三五百银子，就可买得阿巧姐的自由之身，如今胡雪岩这一说，岂非无趣？

This change overturned the two friends' “secret plot” completely, and was a considerable disappointment. It had been You's suggestion. What Yu Si and the others had done in Huzhou to help Hu marry Furong had been a fine act of friendship; why should they not follow the same example? Gu had deliberately postponed his departure by a day to observe Hu and A’qiao. If the affection was mutual, he intended to take advantage of his journey to Suzhou to visit both her husband's family and her own family at Mudu, and spend freely to bring the couple together. They had just come from Yiqing House, where Second Miss told them that A’qiao had not only agreed but supplied a great deal of information and explained how to proceed. Given enough fire, even a pig's head would cook tender. Three to five hundred taels at the very most would buy her freedom. Now Hu's proposal had spoiled it all.

“怎么回事？”胡雪岩看他态度有异，追问着说：“老古，你有什么难处？”“唉！”古应春笑着叹口气，“好事多磨！”“怎么呢？”“事情有缓急，”尤五抢着对古应春说，“你就守老营吧。过些日子专程跑一趟，也算不了什么。”“那也只好如此。”“你们讲啥？”胡雪岩大惑不解，“何妨说出来大家商量！”“说出来就没有味道了。”古应春摇摇头。

“What's the matter?” Hu noticed their altered expressions and pressed them. “Gu, is there some difficulty?” “Ah!” Gu sighed with a smile. “The course of a good thing never runs smooth.” “What do you mean?” “Some matters are more urgent than others,” You said quickly to Gu. “Stay and guard the home camp. It won't hurt to make a special trip later.” “I suppose that's what we'll have to do.” “What are you talking about?” Hu was thoroughly puzzled. “Why not tell me so we can discuss it?” Gu shook his head. “If we told you, it would spoil the pleasure.”

尤五也是微笑不作声。这就很明显了，虽不知他们葫芦里卖的什么药，但必与他跟阿巧姐有关。理解到这一点，不免又把这段倘来艳福思量了一下，诚然，阿巧阻的情味，与他过去所遇到的任何女人不同，真可以说一句“牡丹花下死，做鬼也风流”！但世界上天生有一种福气人，什么事都不必做，席丰履厚，多的是闲情，专门可以消耗在阿巧姐这种尤物身上，而自己不同，自己天生来就是做生意的，而且是做大生意的，虽然也能欣赏阿巧姐的好处，并且有办法使得阿巧姐这样的人，心甘情愿随自己摆布，然而到底不是“正业”，不可为她耗费工夫，更不可为她神魂颠倒，忘记了自己应该是干什么的！这样想着，觉得手心上都有汗了，内心相当不安，从到上海以来，似乎一直迷恋着阿巧姐，还不曾好好办过一件正经事。因此，他收敛笑容，正色说道：“两位的心思，我有点猜到了。我不是味着良心说话，这不过逢场作戏，要看机缘，总要顺乎自然，不可强求。湖州那件事我做得有点冒失，现在还有麻烦，当然，说句狂话，什么麻烦我都不怕，但要工夫来料理，我现在少的就是工夫。”这段话颇引起尤五的警惕，古应春的脸色也不同的，“我们晓得了。”他说，“听你的意思办，目前按兵不动。”

You too merely smiled and said nothing. That made it plain enough. Hu still did not know exactly what they were concealing, but it must concern him and A’qiao. Realising this, he reconsidered the amorous good fortune that had fallen into his lap. Certainly, A’qiao had a charm unlike any woman he had known. One could truly say, “Die beneath the peony blossoms, and even as a ghost you remain a lover.” But some people were born fortunate, with wealth and comfort assured and nothing to do. They had abundant leisure to spend on a captivating woman like her. He was different. He had been born for business, and big business at that. He could appreciate her attractions, and could make a woman like her willingly submit to his wishes, but that was not his proper occupation. He must not waste time on her, still less lose his head and forget what he was meant to be doing. At this thought his palms grew damp. He was deeply uneasy. Ever since coming to Shanghai, it seemed, he had been infatuated with A’qiao and had not properly attended to a single serious matter. His smile vanished. “I can guess something of what you're thinking. I'm not speaking against my conscience, but this is only a passing romance. It depends on opportunity; things must take their natural course. We mustn't force them. I acted a little rashly in that Huzhou affair, and there's trouble still. To boast a little, I'm afraid of no trouble at all—but dealing with it takes time, and time is what I lack.” This was a warning to You, and Gu's expression changed too. “We understand,” Gu said. “We'll do as you wish and make no move for the present.”

“这样最好。到我觉得可以办了，‘我一定拜托你们费心。”胡雪岩忽然想到，“五哥，你这趟正好把七姐带了去，将我们所议的那件事办一办。”这件事就是请王有龄与七姑奶奶认作义兄妹。机会倒是好机会，但事先要谈妥当，行礼要有胡雪岩在场，就这样带了去，登门认亲，未免太冒昧了。尤五说了他的意思，古应春亦以为然，胡雪岩也就不再多说。但这一下倒提醒了尤五，认为这趟到杭州去，应该多备礼物结交王家，以为将来结干亲的地步，于是由此开始，商量杭州的行程，决定在第三天动身。“小爷叔，你呢？”“我随时可走。没有事的话，我明天就动身，早去早回。”“不行！”尤五说，“这条路上，不怎么安静，我叫人替你打听一下，雇一只专船，派人陪了你去。”“不要紧！”胡雪岩因为尤五此行，琐琐碎碎的事情也很多，不愿再麻烦他，这样说道：“这条路，我不熟，老古熟，我请他帮忙，你就不必管了。”“对！”古应春立即应声，“这件事交给我，包管妥贴。”

“That's best. When I feel the time is right, I'll certainly ask you both to take the trouble.” Then something occurred to Hu. “Brother Five, why not take Seventh Sister with you this time and settle that matter we discussed?” He meant asking Wang Youling and the Seventh Lady to become sworn brother and sister. It was a good opportunity, but everything ought to be settled beforehand, and Hu should be present at the ceremony. To bring her along and arrive at Wang's door asking to form the relationship would be too presumptuous. You explained this, Gu agreed, and Hu said no more. It did remind You, however, that he ought to take plenty of gifts to Hangzhou and cultivate the Wang family, preparing the way for the future bond. From this they turned to his journey and decided he would leave the day after next. “What about you, Little Uncle?” “I can leave at any time. If nothing comes up, I'll go tomorrow. The sooner I go, the sooner I'm back.” “No,” You said. “The route isn't very peaceful. I'll have someone make inquiries, hire a boat for your exclusive use, and send men to escort you.” “Don't worry.” Knowing how many small arrangements You already had to make, Hu did not want to trouble him further. “I don't know the route, but Gu does. I'll ask him to help. You needn't bother with it.” “Exactly!” Gu immediately agreed. “Leave it to me. I guarantee everything will be properly arranged.”

这样说定了，各自散去。陈世龙住在裕记丝栈，胡雪岩先把他送到那里，有许多话叮嘱他，主要的是为尤五，他是王有龄请去排难解纷的上客，但在官面上的身分不同，而且将来还要结成干亲，所以为了双方的面子，决不可叫尤五受了委屈，他关照陈世龙当面将这些情形跟王有龄讲清楚。“顶要紧的一句话，尤五爷这趟去，完全是私人面子，所以他只是王大老爷一个人的客人，跟浙江官面上，不必交结。这一点，你要跟王大老爷说清楚，省得尤五爷受窘。”陈世龙心领神会，诺诺连声。等胡雪岩说完要走，陈世龙终于忍不住问了一声：“胡先生，那阿巧姐是怎么回事？”“说来话长，慢慢你就知道了。”胡雪岩倒被提醒了，“回去不必多说。”“知道，知道，我不能不晓得轻重，”

With this settled, they parted. Chen was staying at Yuji Silk Warehouse, and Hu took him there first, giving him many instructions, chiefly about You. Wang had invited You as an honoured guest to resolve a difficult dispute, but his status in official society was another matter. Since they also hoped to form a sworn family relationship, neither side must lose face, and You must on no account be slighted. Hu told Chen to explain all this to Wang in person. “The most important point is that Fifth Master You is coming entirely as a personal favour. He is Prefect Wang's guest alone. There's no need for him to form connections with other Zhejiang officials. Make that perfectly clear to the prefect, so Fifth Master You won't be put in an awkward position.” Chen understood and repeatedly agreed. When Hu had finished and was about to leave, he could not resist a question. “Mr Hu, what exactly is the situation with Sister A’qiao?” “A long story. You'll learn in time.” The question reminded Hu of something. “There's no need to talk about it when you get back.” “Of course, of course. I know what should and shouldn't be said.”

回到大兴客栈，阿巧姐正在灯下理燕窝，用心专注，竟不萝发觉胡雪岩。她已经卸了妆，解了髻，一头黑发，松松地挽成一条极粗的辫子，甩在一边，露出雪白的一段头颈。胡雪岩忍不住低头闻了一下。这一下把阿巧姐吓碍跳了起来，脸都急白了，看清是胡雪岩才深深透了口气，拍着胸以白眼相向。“何至于如此！”胡雪岩歉意地笑道，“早知你这么胆小，我不跟你闹着玩了。”“ ‘人吓人，吓煞人’！你摸摸看！”阿巧姐拉着他一只手在左胸上探试，果然心还在跳。“你胆这么小，怎么办？”胡雪岩说：“后天我要到苏州去两三天，本来想留你一个人在这里住，现在看起来，你还是回怡情院吧！”答复大出胡雪岩意外，“我不回去。”她说，声音虽平静，但每个字都象摸得出梭角似地。“怎么？”胡雪岩问道：“是啥缘故。”“我已经算过工钱了，”阿巧姐说：“那种地方只有出来的，没有回进去的。”“好志气！”胡雪岩赞了她一句，心里却有些着急，阿巧姐决心从良，是跟定了自己了，这件事只有往前走，不容自己退步，看来还有麻烦。

Back at Daxing Inn, A’qiao was cleaning bird's nest by lamplight, so absorbed that she did not notice Hu's arrival. She had removed her make-up and undone her hair, gathering its black abundance into a loose, thick braid cast to one side, which exposed a length of snow-white neck. Unable to resist, Hu bent down to breathe its scent. She jumped up in fright, her face turning white. Only when she saw who it was did she let out a long breath, patting her chest and glaring at him. “Surely not such a fright!” He smiled apologetically. “If I'd known you were so timid, I wouldn't have teased you.” “People can frighten each other to death! Feel!” She took his hand and pressed it to the left side of her chest. Her heart was still racing. “What am I to do with someone so timid?” he asked. “I'm going to Suzhou the day after tomorrow for two or three days. I meant to leave you here alone, but perhaps you'd better return to Yiqing House.” Her answer astonished him. “I'm not going back.” Her voice was calm, but every word had hard, unmistakable edges. “Why? What's the reason?” “I've already settled my wages. Once you leave a place like that, you don't go back.” “Good for you!” Hu praised her, but inwardly grew anxious. If she was determined to leave that life, she had committed herself to him. This affair could only move forward; there was no room for him to withdraw. More trouble seemed likely.

“你到苏州去好了。”阿巧姐坦然他说，“我一个人住在这里好了。我只怕人装鬼吓我，真的鬼，我反而不怕。”“这又是你这时候说说。真的有鬼出现，怕不是吓得你半死。”“我不相信鬼。总要让我见过，我才相信。”“自然有人见过。”胡雪岩坐在她对面，两手支颐，盯着她看，“我讲两个鬼故事你听！”“不要，不要！”阿巧姐赶紧站起身来，“看你这样子瞪着人看，就怕人。吃了燕窝粥睡吧！”茶几上有一只“五更鸡”，微微的几星火，煨着一盂燕窝拣得一根毛都看不见，且不说滋补的力量如何，光是她这份细心料理，就令人觉得其味无穷了。两人上了床，阿巧姐紧抱着他说：“现在你可以讲鬼故事了。”“奇了！”胡雪岩笑着问：“何以刚才不要听，现在要听？”“现在？现在我不怕了！”说完，把他搂得更紧。这是胡雪岩所从未有过的经验，太太是“上床”亦是“君子”，芙蓉的风情也适可而止，只有阿巧姐似乎每夜都是新鲜的。于是胡雪岩添枝加叶他讲了两个鬼故事，吓得阿巧姐在他胸前乱钻。又怕听，又胆小，原是听讲鬼故事的常情，只不如她这般矛盾，胡雪岩也知道她有些做作，但做作得不惹人厌。

“Go to Suzhou,” A’qiao said serenely. “I can stay here alone. It's people pretending to be ghosts that frighten me. Real ghosts don't.” “That's easy to say now. If a ghost really appeared, you'd probably be half dead with fright.” “I don't believe in ghosts. I'll have to see one before I believe.” “Some people certainly have seen them.” Sitting opposite her with his chin in his hands, Hu stared at her. “Let me tell you two ghost stories.” “No, no!” She hurried to her feet. “The way you're staring is frightening enough. Have some bird's-nest congee and go to bed.” On the tea table, a few embers glowed in a small “fifth-watch cock” stove beneath a bowl of bird's nest. She had picked it so thoroughly that not a single feather remained. Whatever its nourishing virtues, the care she had taken alone made it seem infinitely delicious. Once they were in bed, she clasped him tightly. “Now you can tell me your ghost stories.” “How strange!” He laughed. “Why didn't you want them before, but want them now?” “Now? Now I'm not afraid!” She held him still closer. This was a new experience for Hu. His wife remained a model of propriety even in bed; Furong's amorous playfulness went only so far. With A’qiao, every night seemed fresh. He embellished two ghost stories until she burrowed against his chest in alarm. To be afraid yet unable to resist listening was common enough in those who heard ghost stories, though few were as contradictory as she. He knew she was putting it on a little, but her performance did not annoy him.

一宵缱绻，胡雪岩第二天仍旧睡到很晚才起身。这天他知道尤五去杭州之前，有许多杂物要安排，古应春替他去雇船找人护送，也在忙着，都不会到大兴来。自己没有急事要料理，便又懒得出门，愿意在妆台边守伺阿巧姐的眼波。“可有人会来吃饭？”阿巧姐说，“今天我们要开伙食了！”“那有多麻烦，馆子里叫了来就是了。”“那不象做人家。”阿巧姐挽起一只篮子，“我上小菜场去，顺便雇个小大姐来。”胡雪岩实在不愿她离开，但又无法阻拦，只好怏怏然答应。一个人在旅馆里，觉得百无聊赖，做什么都没有兴致。勉强把烦躁的心情按捺了下来，静坐着细想，突然发觉，这是从来不曾有过的事，哪怕是王有龄到京里，他被钱庄辞退，在家赋闲的那段最倒霉的日子，也没有这样意兴阑珊过！“这是什么道理？”胡雪岩喃喃自语，暗暗心惊，“怎么一下子卸掉了劲道？”

After a night of tenderness, Hu again slept late. He knew You had many miscellaneous arrangements to make before leaving for Hangzhou, while Gu was busy hiring a boat and finding escorts for him. Neither would visit Daxing Inn. With no urgent business himself, he felt too lazy to go out and preferred to linger beside A’qiao's dressing table, watching the play of her eyes. “Will anyone be coming to eat?” she asked. “We're starting our own cooking today.” “Why take all that trouble?
